FAIS CATALOG - every source file in one text file

######## ./FAIS.ps1.txt ########
#FAIS
# cd C:\Users\1595161645A\Desktop\FAIS7.1
#
# Run order:
#   1. Open MasterData / OutputSchedule workbooks are saved in Excel so the latest edits are read
#   2. Pre-run pop-ups: log hooked (unsat) / incomplete events from the last schedule, HOLD status,
#      Add Student Absence (all saved right away)
#   3. Puck board: lines come from MasterData's Schedule sheet, a tab for each day it has lines for
#      (re-read whenever MasterData is saved), or are typed; hardcode IPs and students, see the + / - and rule flags.
#      Add Student Absence blocks students off (saved to MasterData's StudentAbsences sheet right away)
#   4. "Fill this day" or "Fill all days": the scheduler fills the open lines, you review it
#   5. Export, all or nothing, for the filled days: OutputSchedule.xlsx (MasterSchedule, other exported
#      days kept, + each student's syllabus tab), SimDebt + cleaned-up unsats to MasterData, and
#      ATIS.xlsx (one tab per day: flights, then sims). Excel files are saved and closed first.
#      A window then says what was written (or why nothing was), with buttons to open the files.
#
# -Trace prints every scheduling decision to the console.
param (
    [switch]$Trace
)


# =================================================================================
#  ____ ___  _   _ _____ ___ ____ _   _ ____      _  _____ ___ ___  _   _
# / ___/ _ \| \ | |  ___|_ _/ ___| | | |  _ \    / \|_   _|_ _/ _ \| \ | |
#| |  | | | |  \| | |_   | | |  _| | | | |_) |  / _ \ | |  | | | | |  \| |
#| |__| |_| | |\  |  _|  | | |_| | |_| |  _ <  / ___ \| |  | | |_| | |\  |
# \____\___/|_| \_|_|   |___\____|\___/|_| \_\/_/   \_\_| |___\___/|_| \_|
# =================================================================================


# ==========================================
#       STARTUP CHECKS
# ==========================================
# The puck board is a WPF window: it needs full language mode and an STA thread.
if ($ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode -ne 'FullLanguage') {
    Write-Host "FAIS needs PowerShell in FullLanguage mode (the puck board uses WPF). Current mode: $($ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return
}
if ([System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() -ne [System.Threading.ApartmentState]::STA) {
    Write-Host "Restarting PowerShell in STA mode for the puck board..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $exe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
    $argList = @('-NoProfile', '-STA')
    $policy = Get-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process
    if ($policy -ne 'Undefined') { $argList += @('-ExecutionPolicy', [string]$policy) }
    $argList += @('-File', "`"$PSCommandPath`"")
    if ($Trace) { $argList += '-Trace' }
    Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $argList -Wait -NoNewWindow
    return
}


# ==========================================
#       CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
$excelInputPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "MasterData.xlsx"
$desktopPath = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')
$excelOutputPath = Join-Path -Path $PSScriptRoot -ChildPath "OutputSchedule.xlsx"
$atisOutputPath = Join-Path -Path $desktopPath -ChildPath "ATIS.xlsx"

# Puck board
$BoardSettings = @{
    OBReturnOffsetMinutes = 180                                 # typing "1015 O&B" adds its return line this many minutes later
    ReturnSortieType      = 'O&B Return'                        # SortieType written on return lines
    SimInstructor         = 'SIM IP'                            # IP shown on OFT / IFT lines with no IP
    BoardDir              = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Boards'    # autosaved boards, one file per day
    TemplateDir           = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Templates' # saved wave templates
    Trace                 = [bool]$Trace                        # print every scheduling decision while filling
}

# Output (the student tabs and MasterData are always written on Export)
$OutputSettings = @{
    WriteAtis              = $true                      # ATIS.xlsx on the Desktop: one tab per day, flights then sims
    KeepPastDays           = 0                          # MasterSchedule keeps exported days from today on (plus this many days back)
    SaveAndCloseExcel      = $true                      # save and close a workbook in Excel before FAIS writes it (no "file is open" errors)
    ReopenExcel            = $true                      # open those workbooks again once FAIS has written them
    CloseAllExcelWorkbooks = $false                     # $true = save and close EVERY open workbook before writing, not just FAIS's
    PublishToTeams         = $false                     # also write the daily sheets to the Teams / OneDrive workbook
    TeamsFolder            = ''                         # e.g. C:\Users\...\OneDrive - United States Air Force\ATIS - E Flight - E Flight
    TeamsFileName          = 'TESTING ATIS NOT OFFICIAL.xlsx'
}


# ==========================================
#      IMPORT MODULES AND FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================
# Makes sure you have excel
try {
    Import-Module ImportExcel -ErrorAction Stop
}
catch {
    Write-Host "Please install or copy the ImportExcel module, then try again." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return
}

# Order matters: later modules call earlier ones
$ModuleOrder = @('DataManipulation', 'ExcelFiles', 'Syllabus', 'DataDownload', 'SchedulingEngine', 'DataUpload', 'SyllabusImport', 'PreRunMenu', 'BoardModel', 'Assessment', 'PuckBoard')
foreach ($moduleName in $ModuleOrder) {
    $modulePath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "Modules\$moduleName.psm1"
    try {
        Import-Module $modulePath -Force -DisableNameChecking -Global -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        Write-Host "Could not load $modulePath : $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
        return
    }
}


# ==========================================
#       INGEST DATA
# ==========================================
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $excelInputPath)) {
    Write-Host "MasterData.xlsx was not found at $excelInputPath" -ForegroundColor Red
    return
}
# Workbooks open in Excel are saved first, so edits not saved yet are read too
[void](Close-FaisExcelFiles -Path @($excelInputPath, $excelOutputPath) -SaveOnly)
$Ingested = IngestData -excelInputPath $excelInputPath -excelOutputPath $excelOutputPath
if ($Ingested.OutputError) {
    # Carrying on would start every student from the blank syllabus and overwrite their tabs on export
    Write-Host "OutputSchedule.xlsx could not be opened, so the students' progress can't be read: $($Ingested.OutputError)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "Nothing was changed. Fix or close $excelOutputPath, then run FAIS again." -ForegroundColor Red
    return
}
$ScheduleSheet = $Ingested.ScheduleSheet
$Instructors = $Ingested.Instructors
$Students = $Ingested.Students
$Formations = $Ingested.Formations
$SoftWeights = $Ingested.SoftWeights

if ($null -eq $SoftWeights) {
    Write-Host "The SoftWeights sheet could not be read, so nothing can be scored. Fix MasterData.xlsx and run again." -ForegroundColor Red
    return
}
Write-Host ("Loaded {0} students, {1} IPs, {2} formation callsigns from {3}." -f @($Students).Count, @($Instructors).Count, @($Formations).Count, $excelInputPath) -ForegroundColor Cyan


# ==========================================
#      PRE RUN MENU
# ==========================================
# Brings in the previous schedule (with the complex objects attached) so lines can be
# marked hooked (unsat) or incomplete before anything is scheduled
$PrevSchedule = @(DownloadPrevSchedule -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors -excelOutputPath $excelOutputPath)
# Add Student Absence (the same window as the board's button), on the board's first day
$AddAbsence = { param($prompt) Invoke-FaisAddAbsence -Students $Students -MasterDataPath $excelInputPath -LockedPrompt $prompt }
if (-not (Invoke-PreRunMenu -Schedule $PrevSchedule -Students $Students -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -MasterDataPath $excelInputPath -OutputPath $excelOutputPath -AddAbsence $AddAbsence)) {
    return
}


# ==========================================
#      PUCK BOARD
# ==========================================
# Build the lines, hardcode anyone, then "Fill this day" / "Fill all days" runs the scheduler
# (Invoke-FillSchedule) and shows the result for review
$BoardData = @{
    Students       = $Students
    Instructors    = $Instructors
    SoftWeights    = $SoftWeights
    Formations     = $Formations
    PrevSchedule   = $PrevSchedule
    ScheduleSheet  = $ScheduleSheet
    MasterDataPath = $excelInputPath
    OutputPath     = $excelOutputPath
}
$FirstDay = (Get-NextFlyingDay).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
$BoardResult = Show-PuckBoard -Data $BoardData -Days @($FirstDay) -Settings $BoardSettings

if ($null -eq $BoardResult -or $BoardResult.Action -ne 'Export') {
    Write-Host "Puck board closed without exporting - nothing was written. Your lines are saved for next time." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    return
}
$FillResult = $BoardResult.FillResult
if ($Trace) {
    foreach ($entry in $FillResult.Log) { Write-Host "  $entry" -ForegroundColor DarkGray }
}


# =====================================================================================
#   ____ _     _____    _    _   _      _    _   _ ____     ___  _   _ _____ ____  _   _ _____
#  / ___| |   | ____|  / \  | \ | |    / \  | \ | |  _ \   / _ \| | | |_   _|  _ \| | | |_   _|
# | |   | |   |  _|   / _ \ |  \| |   / _ \ |  \| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |_) | | | | | |
# | |___| |___| |___ / ___ \| |\  |  / ___ \| |\  | |_| | | |_| | |_| | | | |  __/| |_| | | |
#  \____|_____|_____/_/   \_\_| \_| /_/   \_\_| \_|____/   \___/ \___/  |_| |_|    \___/  |_|
# ====================================================================================
# Only shown when FAIS could not save and close the file itself (a cell still being edited,
# a dialog open in Excel, or someone else has it open)
$LockedPrompt = {
    param($path)
    $answer = [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show("$path is still open and FAIS could not close it (a cell may be in edit mode, a dialog may be open in Excel, or someone else has it open).`n`nClose it, then press OK to try again.", 'File is open',
        [System.Windows.MessageBoxButton]::OKCancel, [System.Windows.MessageBoxImage]::Warning)
    return ($answer -eq [System.Windows.MessageBoxResult]::OK)
}

# Unsat flags the export will change and absences it adds (read before it writes them), and its
# warnings (why it failed, or names MasterData did not have) for the result window
$UnsatChanges = Get-UnsatFlagUpdates -Students $FillResult.Students
$PendingAbsences = @(Get-PendingStudentAbsences -Students $FillResult.Students)
$ExportWarnings = @()
$Exported = Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $FillResult -OutputPath $excelOutputPath -MasterDataPath $excelInputPath -AtisPath $atisOutputPath -Settings $OutputSettings -LockedPrompt $LockedPrompt -Days @($BoardResult.Days) -Instructors $Instructors -WarningVariable ExportWarnings
$AtisWritten = if ($OutputSettings.WriteAtis) { $atisOutputPath } else { '' }
$ExportSummary = Get-FaisExportSummary -Ok ([bool]$Exported) -FillResult $FillResult -Days @($BoardResult.Days) -OutputPath $excelOutputPath -MasterDataPath $excelInputPath `
    -AtisPath $AtisWritten -UnsatChanges $UnsatChanges -Absences $PendingAbsences -Warnings @($ExportWarnings | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Message })
if (-not $Exported) {
    Write-Host "Nothing was written (OutputSchedule, MasterData and ATIS are as they were). Your board is saved; run FAIS again and Export once the files are closed." -ForegroundColor Red
    try { Show-FaisExportResult -Summary $ExportSummary } catch { Write-Host "Could not show the export result window: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    return
}

$Stats = $FillResult.Stats
Write-Host ""
Write-Host ("Schedule written to {0} ({1})" -f $excelOutputPath, (@($BoardResult.Days | ForEach-Object { Format-BoardDayLabel $_ }) -join ', ')) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ("  {0} lines: {1} hardcoded, {2} filled by the scheduler, {3} wingmen, {4} return legs, {5} direct support, {6} for sale" -f `
        $Stats.Lines, $Stats.Pinned, $Stats.Filled, $Stats.Wing, $Stats.Return, $Stats.DS, $Stats.ForSale) -ForegroundColor Green
foreach ($o in $FillResult.Overrides) {
    Write-Host ("  OVERRIDE {0} {1}: {2}" -f (Format-EtdShort $o.ETD), $o.Student, ($o.Violations -join '; ')) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
# The same in a window, with buttons that open the files
try { Show-FaisExportResult -Summary $ExportSummary -OutputPath $excelOutputPath -AtisPath $AtisWritten }
catch { Write-Host "Could not show the export result window: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }

######## ./Modules/Assessment.psm1.txt ########
# ASSESSMENT.PSM1 DIRECTORY:
#             "What if this student goes on this line?" for the puck board.
#             Runs the real hard rules and soft rules against the board's other pins.
# Clear-AssessmentCache
# Get-BoardEvalRows / Get-BoardStudentContext
# Get-PlacementAssessment
# Get-AssessmentLines (text for tooltips / popups)
# Get-MissionChoiceTexts / ConvertFrom-MissionChoiceText / Get-MissionAdvice (the mission dropdown)
# Get-StudentPuckInfo / Get-StudentDayAbsences / Get-InstructorPuckInfo


$script:AssessCache = @{
                Version  = -1
                BoardKey = $null
                Rows     = $null
                Lines    = @{}
                Results  = @{}
}

function Clear-AssessmentCache {
                $script:AssessCache.Version = -1
                $script:AssessCache.BoardKey = $null
                $script:AssessCache.Rows = $null
                $script:AssessCache.Lines = @{}
                $script:AssessCache.Results = @{}
}

function Sync-AssessmentCache {
                param ($Board)

                $key = [System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers]::GetHashCode($Board)
                if ($script:AssessCache.Version -ne $Board.Version -or $script:AssessCache.BoardKey -ne $key) {
                                Clear-AssessmentCache
                                $script:AssessCache.Version = $Board.Version
                                $script:AssessCache.BoardKey = $key
                }
}

# Board lines as engine rows with instructor objects resolved (cached per board version)
function Get-BoardEvalRows {
                param ($Board, $Data)

                Sync-AssessmentCache $Board
                if ($null -eq $script:AssessCache.Rows) {
                                $rows = @(ConvertTo-ScheduleRows -Board $Board)
                                foreach ($r in $rows) { $r.Instructor = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $Data.Instructors -Instructor $r.Instructor }
                                $script:AssessCache.Rows = $rows
                }
                return $script:AssessCache.Rows
}

# A copy of the student as they would be on -TargetRow's day: their other pins earlier
# than the target are flown (marked complete), later ones hold the time as reservations.
function Get-BoardStudentContext {
                param (
                                [array]$Rows,
                                $Student,
                                $TargetRow,
                                [string[]]$ExcludeLineIds = @(),
                                $Data
                )

                $clone = Copy-StudentForEval $Student
                $targetStart = Parse-ETD $TargetRow.ETD
                $pins = @($Rows | Where-Object {
                                (Get-NameText $_.Student) -ieq [string]$Student.Name -and
                                $_.BoardLineId -ne $TargetRow.BoardLineId -and
                                $ExcludeLineIds -notcontains $_.BoardLineId
                } | Sort-Object -Property { Parse-ETD $_.ETD })

                foreach ($pin in $pins) {
                                $start = Parse-ETD $pin.ETD
                                $ipName = Get-NameText $pin.Instructor
                                $isOB = Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$pin.SortieType)
                                $ret = if ($isOB) { Get-LinkedReturnRow -Sortie $pin -Schedule $Rows -StudentName $Student.Name } else { $null }

                                if ($null -ne $start -and $null -ne $targetStart -and $start -lt $targetStart) {
                                                # The same pick the fill makes: explicit mission, else the best-scoring event that passes
                                                $pick = Select-PinnedMission -Student $clone -Sortie $pin -Rows $Rows -Students $Data.Students -Instructors $Data.Instructors -SoftWeights $Data.SoftWeights `
                                                                -FormLookAhead (Get-Weight $Data.SoftWeights 'FormLookAhead' 22)
                                                $m = $pick.Mission
                                                if ($null -ne $m -and -not (Test-MissionComplete $m)) {
                                                                [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $clone -Mission $m -InstructorName $ipName -ETD $pin.ETD -SoftWeights $Data.SoftWeights -SortieType ([string]$pin.SortieType))
                                                }
                                                else {
                                                                # No event could be flown: the student still occupies that time
                                                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $clone -LineId ([string]$pin.BoardLineId) -ETD $pin.ETD -SortieType ([string]$pin.SortieType) -Mission (Get-NameText $pin.Mission) -Instructor $ipName
                                                }
                                                if ($null -ne $ret) {
                                                                $rm = @(Get-ValidOptedEvents -Student $clone -Sortie $ret -NoLookahead) | Select-Object -First 1
                                                                if ($null -ne $m -and $null -ne $rm) { [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $clone -Mission $rm -InstructorName $ipName -ETD $ret.ETD -SoftWeights $Data.SoftWeights -SortieType ([string]$ret.SortieType)) }
                                                                else { Add-StudentReservation -Student $clone -LineId ([string]$ret.BoardLineId) -ETD $ret.ETD -SortieType ([string]$ret.SortieType) -Instructor $ipName }
                                                }
                                }
                                else {
                                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $clone -LineId ([string]$pin.BoardLineId) -ETD $pin.ETD -SortieType ([string]$pin.SortieType) -Mission (Get-NameText $pin.Mission) -Instructor $ipName
                                                if ($null -ne $ret) {
                                                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $clone -LineId ([string]$ret.BoardLineId) -ETD $ret.ETD -SortieType ([string]$ret.SortieType) -Instructor $ipName
                                                }
                                }
                }
                return $clone
}

function Get-AssessmentStatus {
                param ($StudentViolations, $Chosen, $Notes)

                foreach ($v in @($StudentViolations)) { if ($v.Severity -eq 'Hard') { return 'Hard' } }
                if ($null -eq $Chosen) { return 'Hard' }
                foreach ($v in @($Chosen.Violations)) { if ($v.Severity -eq 'Hard') { return 'Hard' } }
                if (@($StudentViolations).Count -gt 0 -or @($Chosen.Violations).Count -gt 0 -or @($Notes).Count -gt 0) { return 'Warn' }
                return 'Clean'
}

# Evaluates one student on one board line.
# Returns {Status 'Clean'|'Warn'|'Hard'|'Error', Violations, Notes, AutoMission, Mission, Score,
#          BestScore, EligibleEvents, EventDetails, Summary, LineId, StudentName, BoardVersion}
function Get-PlacementAssessment {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Board,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$LineId,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$StudentName,
                                [string]$MissionName = '',
                                [string[]]$ExcludeLineIds = @(),
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Data,
                                [switch]$Quick
                )

                Sync-AssessmentCache $Board
                $cacheKey = "$LineId|$StudentName|$MissionName|$([bool]$Quick)|$($ExcludeLineIds -join ',')"
                if ($script:AssessCache.Results.ContainsKey($cacheKey)) { return $script:AssessCache.Results[$cacheKey] }

                $result = [PSCustomObject]@{
                                LineId         = $LineId
                                StudentName    = $StudentName
                                BoardVersion   = $Board.Version
                                Status         = 'Error'
                                Violations     = @()
                                Notes          = @()
                                AutoMission    = ''
                                Mission        = ''
                                Score          = $null
                                BestScore      = $null
                                EligibleEvents = @()
                                NotOptedEvents = @()
                                EventDetails   = @()
                                Summary        = ''
                                Quick          = [bool]$Quick
                                RequestedMission = $MissionName
                }

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $LineId
                if ($null -eq $line) { $result.Summary = 'Line not found'; return $result }
                if (Test-IsReturnSortieType ([string]$line.SortieType)) {
                                $result.Status = 'Hard'
                                $result.Violations = @(New-RuleViolation 'RETURN_LINE' 'O&B Return lines are filled from their O&B')
                                $result.Summary = 'Return lines follow their O&B'
                                return $result
                }
                $student = Resolve-StudentByName -Students $Data.Students -Name $StudentName
                if ($null -eq $student) {
                                $result.Status = 'Hard'
                                $result.Violations = @(New-RuleViolation 'UNKNOWN_STUDENT' "'$StudentName' is not in MasterData")
                                $result.Summary = $result.Violations[0].Message
                                return $result
                }

                $rows = Get-BoardEvalRows -Board $Board -Data $Data
                $target = $null
                foreach ($r in $rows) { if ($r.BoardLineId -eq $LineId) { $target = $r; break } }
                $probe = $target.PSObject.Copy()
                $probe.Student = $null
                $probe.Mission = $null

                $clone = Get-BoardStudentContext -Rows $rows -Student $student -TargetRow $probe -ExcludeLineIds $ExcludeLineIds -Data $Data
                $formLookAhead = Get-Weight $Data.SoftWeights 'FormLookAhead' 22
                if (-not $script:AssessCache.Lines.ContainsKey($LineId)) { $script:AssessCache.Lines[$LineId] = @{} }
                $lineCtx = $script:AssessCache.Lines[$LineId]
                $isWing = Test-IsPairedWing -Sortie $probe -Schedule $rows
                $missionArg = if ($MissionName -ne '') { $MissionName } else { $null }

                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $clone -Sortie $probe -Schedule $rows -Students $Data.Students -Instructors $Data.Instructors `
                                -FormLookAhead $formLookAhead -Mission $missionArg -IsWingCandidate:$isWing -Explain:(-not $Quick) -LineContext $lineCtx

                $details = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                $best = $null
                foreach ($er in @($hr.EventResults)) {
                                $d = [PSCustomObject]@{
                                                Mission    = $er.Mission
                                                Type       = [string]$er.Event.Type
                                                Passed     = $er.Passed
                                                Score      = $null
                                                Breakdown  = @()
                                                Violations = @($er.Violations)
                                                Notes      = @($er.Notes)
                                }
                                if (-not $Quick) {
                                                $sr = Get-EventScore -Student $clone -Sortie $probe -Evt $er.Event -SoftWeights $Data.SoftWeights -Instructors $Data.Instructors
                                                $d.Score = [math]::Round([double]$sr.Score, 1)
                                                $d.Breakdown = @(foreach ($k in $sr.Breakdown.Keys) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Label = $k; Points = [math]::Round([double]$sr.Breakdown[$k], 1); Text = [string]$sr.Reasons[$k] } })
                                                $d.Notes = @(@($er.Notes) + @($sr.Notes) | Select-Object -Unique)
                                                if ($er.Passed -and (-not $isWing -or $d.Type -like '*Form*')) {
                                                                $cand = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = $student; Event = $er.Event; Score = $sr.Score; Detail = $d }
                                                                if (Test-CandidateBetter $cand $best) { $best = $cand }
                                                }
                                }
                                elseif ($er.Passed -and $null -eq $best) {
                                                $best = [PSCustomObject]@{ Detail = $d }
                                }
                                $details.Add($d)
                }

                $chosen = $null
                if ($MissionName -ne '') { $chosen = $details | Where-Object { $_.Mission -ieq $MissionName } | Select-Object -First 1 }
                elseif ($null -ne $best) { $chosen = $best.Detail }
                elseif ($details.Count -gt 0) { $chosen = $details[0] }

                $notes = @(@($hr.Notes) + @(if ($null -ne $chosen) { $chosen.Notes }) | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -Unique)
                $violations = @(@($hr.Violations) + @(if ($null -ne $chosen) { $chosen.Violations }) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })

                $result.Status = Get-AssessmentStatus -StudentViolations $hr.Violations -Chosen $chosen -Notes $notes
                $result.Violations = $violations
                $result.Notes = $notes
                $result.AutoMission = if ($null -ne $best) { [string]$best.Detail.Mission } else { '' }
                $result.Mission = if ($null -ne $chosen) { [string]$chosen.Mission } else { '' }
                $result.Score = if ($null -ne $chosen) { $chosen.Score } else { $null }
                $result.BestScore = if ($null -ne $best) { $best.Detail.Score } else { $null }
                $result.EventDetails = $details.ToArray()
                if (-not $Quick) {
                                $result.EligibleEvents = @(Get-ValidOptedEvents -Student $clone -Sortie $probe | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Mission })
                                $result.NotOptedEvents = @(Get-NotOptedChoices -Student $clone -SortieType ([string]$line.SortieType))
                }

                $flagCount = @($violations | Where-Object { $_.Severity -eq 'Hard' }).Count
                $scoreText = if ($null -ne $result.Score) { ' {0:+0.0;-0.0;0}' -f $result.Score } else { '' }
                $flagText = if ($flagCount -eq 1) { ', 1 rule flag' } elseif ($flagCount -gt 1) { ", $flagCount rule flags" } else { '' }
                $result.Summary = "{0} -> {1} {2}: {3}{4}{5}" -f $student.Name, (Format-BoardTime $line.ETD), $line.SortieType, $(if ($result.Mission) { $result.Mission } else { 'no event' }), $scoreText, $flagText

                $script:AssessCache.Results[$cacheKey] = $result
                return $result
}

# Assessment as display lines: {Kind 'Title'|'Hard'|'Warn'|'Note'|'Plus'|'Minus'|'Info'; Text}
function Get-AssessmentLines {
                param ($Assessment)

                $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                if ($null -eq $Assessment) { return }
                $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Title'; Text = $Assessment.Summary })

                foreach ($v in @($Assessment.Violations)) {
                                $kind = if ($v.Severity -eq 'Hard') { 'Hard' } else { 'Warn' }
                                $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = $kind; Text = $v.Message })
                }
                foreach ($n in @($Assessment.Notes)) { $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Note'; Text = $n }) }

                $chosen = $Assessment.EventDetails | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq $Assessment.Mission } | Select-Object -First 1
                if ($null -ne $chosen) {
                                foreach ($b in @($chosen.Breakdown | Sort-Object -Property { [math]::Abs($_.Points) } -Descending)) {
                                                # The descriptive reason when the soft rules gave one, else the rule's label
                                                $label = [string](Get-OptionalProperty $b 'Text' '')
                                                if ($label -eq '') { $label = $b.Label }
                                                if ($b.Points -gt 0) { $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Plus'; Text = ('{0} +{1:0.#}' -f $label, $b.Points) }) }
                                                elseif ($b.Points -lt 0) { $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Minus'; Text = ('{0} {1:0.#}' -f $label, $b.Points) }) }
                                }
                }

                $others = @($Assessment.EventDetails | Where-Object { $_.Mission -ne $Assessment.Mission })
                if ($others.Count -gt 0) {
                                $parts = foreach ($o in $others) {
                                                if ($o.Passed -and $null -ne $o.Score) { '{0} {1:0.0}' -f $o.Mission, $o.Score }
                                                elseif ($o.Passed) { "$($o.Mission) ok" }
                                                else {
                                                                $why = @($o.Violations | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.Message })
                                                                "$($o.Mission) blocked ($($why -join ''))"
                                                }
                                }
                                $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Info'; Text = 'Other events: ' + ($parts -join '; ') })
                }
                if (-not $Assessment.Quick) {
                                $out.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Info'; Text = 'Based on pinned lines only; auto-filled lines can change turns.' })
                }
                return $out.ToArray()
}

# =================================================================================
#  CHOOSING A MISSION BY HAND
#  The mission dropdown offers the events the student can fly on the line, then the
#  next ones they aren't opted for yet, then "Type a mission..." for anything else.
#  A choice that breaks a rule is checked with Get-MissionAdvice before it goes on.
# =================================================================================

$script:MissionChoice = @{
                Auto      = '(auto)'
                Type      = 'Type a mission...'
                NotOpted  = ' (not opted)'
}

# The next events of a line's type that a student is NOT opted for yet (prereqs still to fly),
# in syllabus order, at most -Max of them. Get-PlacementAssessment keeps this list for the
# board-context student, so the dropdown's "(not opted)" tags agree with the NOT_OPTED flag.
function Get-NotOptedChoices {
                param ($Student, [string]$SortieType = '', [int]$Max = 8)

                $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                if ($null -eq $Student -or $Max -le 0) { return $out.ToArray() }
                $types = Get-AllowedEventTypes $SortieType
                $done = Get-MissionDoneMap $Student
                foreach ($m in @($Student.Syllabus | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ } | Sort-Object -Property { Get-SyllabusSortKey $_ })) {
                                if ($out.Count -ge $Max) { break }
                                $name = ([string]$m.Mission).Trim()
                                if ($name -eq '' -or (Test-MissionComplete $m)) { continue }
                                if ($null -ne $types -and ([string]$m.Type).Trim() -notin $types) { continue }
                                if ((Get-NotOptedReason -Student $Student -Mission $m -DoneMap $done) -eq '') { continue }
                                $out.Add($name)
                }
                return $out.ToArray()
}

# The dropdown's entries (text) for a hardcoded line: (auto), -Eligible (events the student
# can fly there), the line's own mission -Current, -NotOpted (Get-NotOptedChoices, tagged),
# then "Type a mission...". The line's mission is listed in its own spelling, so the
# dropdown shows it even when it differs from the syllabus only in case.
function Get-MissionChoiceTexts {
                param (
                                [string[]]$Eligible = @(),
                                [string]$Current = '',
                                [string[]]$NotOpted = @()
                )

                $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                $have = @{}
                $cur = ([string]$Current).Trim()
                $out.Add($script:MissionChoice.Auto)
                foreach ($e in $Eligible) {
                                $name = ([string]$e).Trim()
                                if ($name -eq '' -or $have.ContainsKey($name.ToUpperInvariant())) { continue }
                                if ($name -ieq $cur) { $name = $cur }
                                $out.Add($name)
                                $have[$name.ToUpperInvariant()] = $true
                }
                if ($cur -ne '' -and -not $have.ContainsKey($cur.ToUpperInvariant())) {
                                $out.Add($cur)
                                $have[$cur.ToUpperInvariant()] = $true
                }
                foreach ($n in $NotOpted) {
                                $name = ([string]$n).Trim()
                                if ($name -eq '' -or $have.ContainsKey($name.ToUpperInvariant())) { continue }
                                $out.Add($name + $script:MissionChoice.NotOpted)
                                $have[$name.ToUpperInvariant()] = $true
                }
                $out.Add($script:MissionChoice.Type)
                return $out.ToArray()
}

# What a dropdown entry means: {Kind 'Auto'|'Type'|'Mission'; Mission}
function ConvertFrom-MissionChoiceText {
                param ([string]$Text)

                $t = ([string]$Text).Trim()
                if ($t -eq '' -or $t -eq $script:MissionChoice.Auto) { return [PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Auto'; Mission = '' } }
                if ($t -eq $script:MissionChoice.Type) { return [PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Type'; Mission = '' } }
                if ($t.EndsWith($script:MissionChoice.NotOpted)) { $t = $t.Substring(0, $t.Length - $script:MissionChoice.NotOpted.Length).Trim() }
                return [PSCustomObject]@{ Kind = 'Mission'; Mission = $t }
}

# Whether a mission picked by hand needs a second look before it goes on, and what to fly instead.
# -Requested: the assessment with that mission; -Auto: the assessment with (auto).
# Problems are the rule flags that come from the mission itself (not opted, not in the syllabus,
# wrong line, a checkride rule...), not ones any mission would have (turn time, absence...).
# Returns {NeedsConfirm; Problems; Suggested; SuggestedScore; Others; Mission; Title; Text; Buttons}
function Get-MissionAdvice {
                param ($Requested, $Auto, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$Mission)

                $missionRules = @('NOT_OPTED', 'MISSION_NOT_ELIGIBLE', 'MISSION_NOT_FOUND')
                $hard = @($Requested.Violations | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ -and $_.Severity -eq 'Hard' -and ($missionRules -contains $_.Rule -or ([string]$_.Mission) -ne '') })
                $problems = @($hard | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Message } | Select-Object -Unique)
                $name = if ($null -ne $Requested -and $Requested.StudentName) { [string]$Requested.StudentName } else { 'This student' }
                $first = (($name -split ',')[0]).Trim()

                $suggested = ''
                $score = $null
                if ($null -ne $Auto -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Auto.AutoMission) -and [string]$Auto.AutoMission -ine $Mission) {
                                $suggested = [string]$Auto.AutoMission
                                $score = $Auto.BestScore
                }
                # Other events that pass every rule here (not just opted ones), so "can fly" is true
                $others = @()
                if ($null -ne $Auto) {
                                $others = @(@($Auto.EventDetails) | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ -and $_.Passed -and $_.Mission -ine $suggested -and $_.Mission -ine $Mission } |
                                                ForEach-Object { [string]$_.Mission } | Select-Object -First 5)
                }

                $headline = "$Mission breaks a rule for $name on this line."
                if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { $headline = "$Mission is fine for $name on this line." }
                elseif (@($hard | Where-Object { $_.Rule -eq 'NOT_OPTED' }).Count -gt 0) { $headline = "$name isn't opted for $Mission." }
                elseif (@($hard | Where-Object { $_.Rule -eq 'MISSION_NOT_FOUND' }).Count -gt 0) { $headline = "$Mission isn't in $name's syllabus." }
                elseif (@($hard | Where-Object { $_.Rule -eq 'MISSION_NOT_ELIGIBLE' }).Count -gt 0) { $headline = "$name can't fly $Mission on this line." }

                $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                $lines.Add($headline)
                $lines.Add('')
                foreach ($p in $problems) { $lines.Add("  X  $p") }
                $lines.Add('')
                if ($suggested -ne '') {
                                $scoreText = if ($null -ne $score) { ' (score {0:+0.0;-0.0;0})' -f [double]$score } else { '' }
                                $lines.Add("Recommended: $suggested, the mission the scheduler would put here$scoreText.")
                }
                else {
                                $lines.Add("There is no mission $first can fly on this line right now.")
                }
                if ($others.Count -gt 0) { $lines.Add("Other missions $first can fly here: $($others -join ', ').") }
                $lines.Add('')
                if ($suggested -ne '') {
                                $lines.Add("Yes = put $suggested on the line (recommended)")
                                $lines.Add("No = keep $Mission anyway (it is flagged OVERRIDE on the output)")
                }
                else {
                                $lines.Add("OK = keep $Mission anyway (it is flagged OVERRIDE on the output)")
                }
                $lines.Add('Cancel = leave the mission as it was')

                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                NeedsConfirm   = ($problems.Count -gt 0)
                                Problems       = $problems
                                Suggested      = $suggested
                                SuggestedScore = $score
                                Others         = $others
                                Mission        = $Mission
                                Title          = "Check the mission for $name"
                                Text           = ($lines -join "`n")
                                Buttons        = $(if ($suggested -ne '') { 'YesNoCancel' } else { 'OKCancel' })
                }
}

# Badges and counts for a student puck on one day
function Get-StudentPuckInfo {
                param ($Student, $Board, [string]$Day)

                $badges = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.IsCap) { $badges.Add('CAP') }
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.IsInternational) { $badges.Add('INTL') }
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.OnHold) { $badges.Add('HOLD') }
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatSim) { $badges.Add('U-SIM') }
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatFlight) { $badges.Add('U-FLT') }

                $absText = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                foreach ($a in @(Get-StudentDayAbsences -Student $Student -Day $Day)) {
                                $badges.Add("ABS $($a.Times)")
                                $absText.Add("$($a.Times) $($a.Reason)".Trim())
                }

                $turns = 0
                if ($null -ne $Board) {
                                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) {
                                                if ($l.Day -ne $Day -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($l.Student)) { continue }
                                                if ($l.Student -ine [string]$Student.Name) { continue }
                                                $turns += $(if (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$l.SortieType)) { 2 } else { 1 })
                                }
                }

                $opted = @(Get-OptedEvents -SyllabusData $Student.Syllabus | Sort-Object -Property { Get-SyllabusSortKey $_ })
                $next = if ($opted.Count -gt 0) { ((@($opted | Select-Object -First 2 | ForEach-Object { $_.Mission })) -join ' / ') } else { 'complete' }
                $debt = 0.0
                if ($null -ne $Student.SimDebt -and [string]$Student.SimDebt -ne '') { [void][double]::TryParse([string]$Student.SimDebt, [ref]$debt) }

                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Name     = [string]$Student.Name
                                Badges   = $badges.ToArray()
                                Absences = $absText.ToArray()
                                Turns    = $turns
                                Next     = $next
                                SimDebt  = $debt
                                Blocked  = ((ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.OnHold))
                }
}

# A student's absences on one day ('yyyy-MM-dd'), cut to that day: {Times ('0900-1100', with
# 0000 / 2359 where it starts the day before or ends the day after); Reason}
function Get-StudentDayAbsences {
                param ($Student, [string]$Day)

                if (-not $Day) { return @() }
                $dayDate = [datetime]::ParseExact($Day, 'yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
                return @(foreach ($a in @($Student.Absences)) {
                                if ($null -eq $a -or $a.StartTime.Date -gt $dayDate -or $a.EndTime.Date -lt $dayDate) { continue }
                                $s = if ($a.StartTime.Date -lt $dayDate) { '0000' } else { $a.StartTime.ToString('HHmm') }
                                $e = if ($a.EndTime.Date -gt $dayDate) { '2359' } else { $a.EndTime.ToString('HHmm') }
                                [PSCustomObject]@{ Times = "$s-$e"; Reason = [string]$a.Reason }
                })
}

# Badges and line count for an IP puck on one day
function Get-InstructorPuckInfo {
                param ($Instructor, $Board, [string]$Day)

                $badges = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Instructor.IsExperienced) { $badges.Add('EXP') }
                if (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Instructor.IsCheck) { $badges.Add('CHK') }
                if (-not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Instructor.IsCounter -Default $true)) { $badges.Add('NC') }

                $count = 0
                $times = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                if ($null -ne $Board) {
                                foreach ($l in (Get-BoardDayLines -Board $Board -Day $Day)) {
                                                if ([string]$l.Instructor -ieq [string]$Instructor.Name -and -not (Test-IsReturnSortieType ([string]$l.SortieType))) {
                                                                $count++
                                                                $times.Add($l.ETD.ToString('HHmm'))
                                                }
                                }
                }
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Name     = [string]$Instructor.Name
                                Callsign = ("{0} {1}" -f $Instructor.Callsign, $Instructor.Num).Trim()
                                Badges   = $badges.ToArray()
                                Lines    = $count
                                Times    = $times.ToArray()
                }
}

# BOARDMODEL.PSM1 DIRECTORY:
#             The puck board's data: days, lines, pins. No WPF in here, so all of it can
#             be tested without a window.
# Get-DefaultBoardSettings / New-Board / New-BoardLine / Get-BoardLine / Get-BoardDayLines
# Undo: Save-BoardUndoPoint / Undo-Board
# Edits: Add-BoardDay / Remove-BoardDay / Add-BoardLine / Remove-BoardLine / Set-BoardLineEtd
#        Set-BoardLineType / Set-BoardInstructor / Set-BoardPin / Clear-BoardPin / Move-BoardPin
#        Set-BoardMission / Set-BoardLineField / Set-FormationPair / Unlink-ReturnLine
# Typing: ConvertTo-BoardTime / Format-BoardTime / ConvertTo-BoardSortieType / ConvertFrom-QuickEntry
#         New-BulkBoardLines (Add Bulk Lines)
# Absences: ConvertTo-ClockTime / Resolve-PastedStudents / New-StudentAbsences / Add-StudentAbsences
# Engine: ConvertTo-ScheduleRows / ConvertFrom-ScheduleRows / Get-FillOverlay / Test-BoardReadyToFill
# One day at a time: Resolve-SheetRowDays / ConvertFrom-SheetRows / Import-BoardDayLines / Get-BoardSheetState / Get-SheetBannerInfo / Get-SheetDaysToAdd
#         Set-BoardSheetSync / ConvertFrom-PublishedRows / Get-PublishedContextRows / Split-FillResult
# Files:  Save-BoardState / Open-BoardState / Get-SavedBoardDays
#         Save-BoardTemplate / Get-BoardTemplateList / Import-BoardTemplate / Copy-BoardPreviousDay
# Get-NextFlyingDay


# =================================================================================
#  BOARD AND LINES
# =================================================================================

function Get-DefaultBoardSettings {
                return @{
                                OBReturnOffsetMinutes = 180
                                ReturnSortieType      = 'O&B Return'
                                SimInstructor         = 'SIM IP'
                                UndoDepth             = 50
                }
}

function New-Board {
                param (
                                [string[]]$Days = @(),
                                [hashtable]$Settings
                )

                $s = Get-DefaultBoardSettings
                if ($null -ne $Settings) { foreach ($k in $Settings.Keys) { $s[$k] = $Settings[$k] } }

                $dayList = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                foreach ($d in $Days) { $n = ConvertTo-BoardDay $d; if ($n -and -not $dayList.Contains($n)) { $dayList.Add($n) } }
                $dayList.Sort()

                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                SchemaVersion = 1
                                Days          = $dayList
                                Lines         = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object])
                                Version       = 0
                                Undo          = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string])
                                Settings      = $s
                                # Day -> what MasterData's Schedule sheet held for that day when it was last loaded
                                # or ignored: {Fingerprint; Action 'Loaded'|'Ignored'; At}
                                SheetSync     = @{}
                }
}

# 'yyyy-MM-dd' from a date or text
function ConvertTo-BoardDay {
                param ($Day)

                if ($null -eq $Day) { return $null }
                if ($Day -is [datetime]) { return $Day.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }
                $dt = Parse-ETD $Day
                if ($null -eq $dt) { return $null }
                return $dt.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
}

function New-BoardId {
                return [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
}

function New-BoardLine {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [datetime]$ETD,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$SortieType,
                                [string]$Instructor = '',
                                [string]$Student = '',
                                [string]$Mission = '',
                                [string]$Callsign = '',
                                [string]$Num = '',
                                [string]$Notes = '',
                                [string]$Source = 'Manual',
                                [string]$Id = '',
                                [string]$LinkedLineId = '',
                                [string]$WingOfLineId = ''
                )

                if ($Id -eq '') { $Id = New-BoardId }
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Id           = $Id
                                Day          = $ETD.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
                                ETD          = $ETD
                                SortieType   = $SortieType
                                Instructor   = $Instructor
                                Student      = $Student
                                Mission      = $Mission
                                Callsign     = $Callsign
                                Num          = $Num
                                Notes        = $Notes
                                LinkedLineId = $LinkedLineId
                                WingOfLineId = $WingOfLineId
                                Source       = $Source
                }
}

function Get-BoardLine {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id)

                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Id)) { return $null }
                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) { if ($l.Id -eq $Id) { return $l } }
                return $null
}

# A day's lines in ETD order (ties keep the order they were added)
function Get-BoardDayLines {
                param ($Board, [string]$Day)

                $i = 0
                $tagged = foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) {
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Day) -or $l.Day -eq $Day) { [PSCustomObject]@{ L = $l; I = $i } }
                                $i++
                }
                return @($tagged | Sort-Object -Property @{ Expression = { $_.L.ETD } }, I | ForEach-Object { $_.L })
}

function Test-BoardLineIsReturn {
                param ($Line)
                return (Test-IsReturnSortieType ([string]$Line.SortieType))
}

function Test-BoardLineIsOB {
                param ($Line)
                return (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Line.SortieType))
}


# =================================================================================
#  UNDO
#  Each edit saves a JSON snapshot first. Version always goes up (also on undo) so
#  cached assessments are never reused after a change.
# =================================================================================

function ConvertTo-BoardSnapshot {
                param ($Board)

                $dto = [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Days  = $Board.Days.ToArray()
                                Lines = @(foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) { ConvertTo-LineDto $l })
                                Sync  = @(foreach ($d in @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $Board)) { [ordered]@{ Day = $d; Entry = $Board.SheetSync[$d] } })
                }
                return (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $dto -Depth 6 -Compress)
}

function Restore-BoardSnapshot {
                param ($Board, [string]$Json)

                $dto = ConvertFrom-Json $Json
                $Board.Days.Clear()
                foreach ($d in @($dto.Days)) { if ($d) { $Board.Days.Add([string]$d) } }
                $Board.Lines.Clear()
                foreach ($l in @($dto.Lines)) { if ($null -ne $l) { $Board.Lines.Add((ConvertFrom-LineDto $l)) } }
                if ($null -ne $Board.PSObject.Properties['SheetSync']) {
                                $Board.SheetSync = @{}
                                foreach ($e in @($dto.Sync)) { if ($null -ne $e -and $e.Day) { $Board.SheetSync[[string]$e.Day] = ConvertTo-SheetSyncEntry $e.Entry } }
                }
}

# Days with a sheet sync record, in order (empty for boards made before sync existed)
function Get-BoardSheetSyncDays {
                param ($Board)

                if ($null -eq $Board.PSObject.Properties['SheetSync'] -or $null -eq $Board.SheetSync) { return @() }
                return @($Board.SheetSync.Keys | Sort-Object)
}

function ConvertTo-SheetSyncEntry {
                param ($Entry)

                if ($null -eq $Entry) { return $null }
                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Fingerprint      = [string]$Entry.Fingerprint
                                Action           = [string]$Entry.Action
                                At               = [string]$Entry.At
                                BoardFingerprint = [string](Get-OptionalProperty $Entry 'BoardFingerprint' '')
                }
}

function Save-BoardUndoPoint {
                param ($Board)

                $Board.Undo.Add((ConvertTo-BoardSnapshot $Board))
                $depth = [int]$Board.Settings.UndoDepth
                if ($depth -lt 1) { $depth = 50 }
                while ($Board.Undo.Count -gt $depth) { $Board.Undo.RemoveAt(0) }
}

function Step-BoardVersion {
                param ($Board)
                $Board.Version = [int]$Board.Version + 1
}

function Undo-Board {
                param ($Board)

                if ($Board.Undo.Count -eq 0) { return $false }
                $json = $Board.Undo[$Board.Undo.Count - 1]
                $Board.Undo.RemoveAt($Board.Undo.Count - 1)
                Restore-BoardSnapshot -Board $Board -Json $json
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $true
}


# =================================================================================
#  EDITS
# =================================================================================

function Add-BoardDay {
                param ($Board, $Day)

                $d = ConvertTo-BoardDay $Day
                if ($null -eq $d -or $Board.Days.Contains($d)) { return $d }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $Board.Days.Add($d)
                $Board.Days.Sort()
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $d
}

function Remove-BoardDay {
                param ($Board, [string]$Day)

                if (-not $Board.Days.Contains($Day)) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                [void]$Board.Days.Remove($Day)
                if (@(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $Board) -contains $Day) { $Board.SheetSync.Remove($Day) }
                $keep = @($Board.Lines | Where-Object { $_.Day -ne $Day })
                $Board.Lines.Clear()
                foreach ($l in $keep) { $Board.Lines.Add($l) }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Adds lines (one undo step). Days are added for lines on new dates.
function Add-BoardLine {
                param (
                                $Board,
                                [array]$Line,
                                # O&B -> return links a quick-entry parse found for lines already on the board.
                                # Applied here, after the undo point, so a failed entry changes nothing and undo reverses them.
                                [array]$Link = @(),
                                [switch]$NoUndo
                )

                if (-not $NoUndo) { Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board }
                foreach ($l in $Line) {
                                if ($null -eq $l) { continue }
                                if (-not $Board.Days.Contains($l.Day)) { $Board.Days.Add($l.Day); $Board.Days.Sort() }
                                $Board.Lines.Add($l)
                }
                foreach ($k in $Link) {
                                if ($null -eq $k) { continue }
                                $ob = Get-BoardLine $Board ([string]$k.ObId)
                                if ($null -ne $ob -and -not $ob.LinkedLineId) { $ob.LinkedLineId = [string]$k.ReturnId }
                }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Removes a line. An O&B takes its linked return with it.
function Remove-BoardLine {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id, [switch]$NoUndo)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line) { return }
                if (-not $NoUndo) { Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board }

                $gone = @($Id)
                if ((Test-BoardLineIsOB $line) -and $line.LinkedLineId) { $gone += $line.LinkedLineId }
                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines.ToArray()) {
                                if ($gone -contains $l.Id) { [void]$Board.Lines.Remove($l); continue }
                                if ($gone -contains $l.LinkedLineId) { $l.LinkedLineId = '' }
                                if ($gone -contains $l.WingOfLineId) { $l.WingOfLineId = '' }
                }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# New ETD for a line. An O&B drags its return leg by the same amount.
function Set-BoardLineEtd {
                param (
                                $Board,
                                [string]$Id,
                                [datetime]$ETD
                )

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $delta = $ETD - $line.ETD
                $line.ETD = $ETD
                $line.Day = $ETD.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
                if (-not $Board.Days.Contains($line.Day)) { $Board.Days.Add($line.Day); $Board.Days.Sort() }

                if ((Test-BoardLineIsOB $line) -and $line.LinkedLineId) {
                                $ret = Get-BoardLine $Board $line.LinkedLineId
                                if ($null -ne $ret) {
                                                $ret.ETD = $ret.ETD + $delta
                                                $ret.Day = $ret.ETD.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd')
                                                if (-not $Board.Days.Contains($ret.Day)) { $Board.Days.Add($ret.Day); $Board.Days.Sort() }
                                }
                }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Changes a line's type. Becoming an O&B adds a linked return; leaving O&B removes it.
function Set-BoardLineType {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id, [string]$SortieType)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line -or $line.SortieType -eq $SortieType) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board

                $wasOB = Test-BoardLineIsOB $line
                $wasReturn = Test-BoardLineIsReturn $line
                $line.SortieType = $SortieType
                $isOB = Test-BoardLineIsOB $line

                # A return line retyped to something else is no longer anyone's return leg
                if ($wasReturn -and -not (Test-BoardLineIsReturn $line) -and $line.LinkedLineId) {
                                $ob = Get-BoardLine $Board $line.LinkedLineId
                                if ($null -ne $ob) { $ob.LinkedLineId = '' }
                                $line.LinkedLineId = ''
                }
                # OFT / IFT / O&B / Return lines can never fly formation: drop their pairings both ways
                if (-not (Test-IsWingCapableType ([string]$line.SortieType))) {
                                $line.WingOfLineId = ''
                                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines.ToArray()) { if ($l.WingOfLineId -eq $line.Id) { $l.WingOfLineId = '' } }
                }

                if ($wasOB -and -not $isOB -and $line.LinkedLineId) {
                                $retId = $line.LinkedLineId
                                $line.LinkedLineId = ''
                                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines.ToArray()) { if ($l.Id -eq $retId) { [void]$Board.Lines.Remove($l) } }
                }
                if ($isOB -and -not $wasOB) {
                                $ret = New-ReturnLineFor -Board $Board -OBLine $line
                                $Board.Lines.Add($ret)
                }
                if (Test-BoardLineIsReturn $line) { $line.Student = ''; $line.Mission = '' }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

function New-ReturnLineFor {
                param ($Board, $OBLine, [Nullable[datetime]]$ReturnETD)

                $offset = [int]$Board.Settings.OBReturnOffsetMinutes
                $etd = if ($null -ne $ReturnETD) { [datetime]$ReturnETD } else { $OBLine.ETD.AddMinutes($offset) }
                $ret = New-BoardLine -ETD $etd -SortieType ([string]$Board.Settings.ReturnSortieType) -Instructor $OBLine.Instructor -Source $OBLine.Source
                $OBLine.LinkedLineId = $ret.Id
                $ret.LinkedLineId = $OBLine.Id
                return $ret
}

# Puts an IP on a line. An O&B's IP flies the return too.
function Set-BoardInstructor {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id, [string]$Name)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $line.Instructor = $Name
                if ((Test-BoardLineIsOB $line) -and $line.LinkedLineId) {
                                $ret = Get-BoardLine $Board $line.LinkedLineId
                                if ($null -ne $ret) { $ret.Instructor = $Name }
                }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Moves an IP from one line to another (swaps if the target has one). -Copy keeps the original.
function Move-BoardInstructor {
                param ($Board, [string]$FromId, [string]$ToId, [switch]$Copy)

                $from = Get-BoardLine $Board $FromId
                $to = Get-BoardLine $Board $ToId
                if ($null -eq $from -or $null -eq $to -or $FromId -eq $ToId) { return $false }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board

                $moving = $from.Instructor
                $displaced = $to.Instructor
                $to.Instructor = $moving
                if (-not $Copy) { $from.Instructor = $displaced }
                foreach ($l in @($from, $to)) {
                                if ((Test-BoardLineIsOB $l) -and $l.LinkedLineId) {
                                                $ret = Get-BoardLine $Board $l.LinkedLineId
                                                if ($null -ne $ret) { $ret.Instructor = $l.Instructor }
                                }
                }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $true
}

# Hardcodes a student on a line. Return lines can't be pinned (they follow their O&B).
function Set-BoardPin {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id, [string]$Student, [string]$Mission = '')

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line -or (Test-BoardLineIsReturn $line)) { return $false }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                if ($line.Student -ne $Student) { $line.WingOfLineId = '' }
                $line.Student = $Student
                $line.Mission = $Mission
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $true
}

function Clear-BoardPin {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $line.Student = ''
                $line.Mission = ''
                $line.WingOfLineId = ''
                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) { if ($l.WingOfLineId -eq $Id) { $l.WingOfLineId = '' } }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Moves a pinned student to another line (swaps if that line is pinned). -Copy keeps the original.
function Move-BoardPin {
                param ($Board, [string]$FromId, [string]$ToId, [switch]$Copy)

                $from = Get-BoardLine $Board $FromId
                $to = Get-BoardLine $Board $ToId
                if ($null -eq $from -or $null -eq $to -or $FromId -eq $ToId -or (Test-BoardLineIsReturn $to)) { return $false }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board

                $s = $from.Student; $m = $from.Mission
                if ($Copy) {
                                $to.Student = $s
                                $to.Mission = ''
                }
                else {
                                $from.Student = $to.Student
                                $from.Mission = $to.Mission
                                $to.Student = $s
                                $to.Mission = $m
                }
                foreach ($l in @($from, $to)) { $l.WingOfLineId = '' }
                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) { if ($l.WingOfLineId -eq $FromId -or $l.WingOfLineId -eq $ToId) { $l.WingOfLineId = '' } }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $true
}

function Set-BoardMission {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id, [string]$Mission)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line -or [string]$line.Mission -ceq $Mission) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $line.Mission = $Mission
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

function Set-BoardLineField {
                param (
                                $Board,
                                [string]$Id,
                                [ValidateSet('Callsign', 'Num', 'Notes')] [string]$Field,
                                [string]$Value
                )

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line -or [string]$line.$Field -eq $Value) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $line.$Field = $Value
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}

# Marks a pinned line as flying wing to a pinned lead line ('' clears)
function Set-FormationPair {
                param ($Board, [string]$WingId, [string]$LeadId = '')

                $wing = Get-BoardLine $Board $WingId
                if ($null -eq $wing) { return $false }
                if ($LeadId -ne '') {
                                # OFT / IFT / O&B lines can never fly formation, as lead or wing
                                $lead = Get-BoardLine $Board $LeadId
                                if ($null -eq $lead -or $LeadId -eq $WingId) { return $false }
                                if (-not (Test-IsWingCapableType ([string]$wing.SortieType)) -or -not (Test-IsWingCapableType ([string]$lead.SortieType))) { return $false }
                }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                foreach ($l in $Board.Lines) { if ($l.WingOfLineId -eq $LeadId -and $LeadId -ne '') { $l.WingOfLineId = '' } }
                $wing.WingOfLineId = $LeadId
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
                return $true
}

function Unlink-ReturnLine {
                param ($Board, [string]$Id)

                $line = Get-BoardLine $Board $Id
                if ($null -eq $line -or -not $line.LinkedLineId) { return }
                Save-BoardUndoPoint $Board
                $other = Get-BoardLine $Board $line.LinkedLineId
                $line.LinkedLineId = ''
                if ($null -ne $other) { $other.LinkedLineId = '' }
                Step-BoardVersion $Board
}


# =================================================================================
#  TYPING TIMES AND QUICK ENTRY
# =================================================================================

# 0730 / 730 / 7:30 / 07:30 / 07.30 / 0730L / 7 -> [timespan]; $null when invalid
function ConvertTo-BoardTime {
                param ([string]$Text)

                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Text)) { return $null }
                $t = $Text.Trim()
                $h = -1; $m = -1
                if ($t -match '^(\d{1,2})[:.h](\d{2})\s*[lLzZ]?$') { $h = [int]$Matches[1]; $m = [int]$Matches[2] }
                elseif ($t -match '^(\d{3,4})\s*[lLzZ]?$') { $v = $Matches[1].PadLeft(4, '0'); $h = [int]$v.Substring(0, 2); $m = [int]$v.Substring(2, 2) }
                elseif ($t -match '^(\d{1,2})\s*[lLzZ]?$') { $h = [int]$Matches[1]; $m = 0 }
                else { return $null }
                if ($h -lt 0 -or $h -gt 23 -or $m -lt 0 -or $m -gt 59) { return $null }
                return New-TimeSpan -Hours $h -Minutes $m
}

function Format-BoardTime {
                param ($Value)

                if ($null -eq $Value) { return '' }
                if ($Value -is [timespan]) { return ('{0:00}{1:00}' -f $Value.Hours, $Value.Minutes) }
                $dt = Parse-ETD $Value
                if ($null -eq $dt) { return '' }
                return $dt.ToString('HHmm')
}

# Short names the user can type for each sortie type ($null = not a type, 'AMBIGUOUS' = SIM)
function ConvertTo-BoardSortieType {
                param ([string]$Token, $Settings)

                $returnType = 'O&B Return'
                if ($null -ne $Settings -and $Settings.ReturnSortieType) { $returnType = [string]$Settings.ReturnSortieType }
                $k = ($Token -replace '[\s\-_]', '').ToUpperInvariant()
                switch ($k) {
                                { $_ -in @('DL', 'LOCAL', 'DAYLOCAL', 'D', 'L') } { return 'Day Local' }
                                { $_ -in @('OB', 'O&B', 'ONB', 'OANDB', 'O/B') } { return 'O&B' }
                                { $_ -in @('RTN', 'RET', 'RETURN', 'R', 'O&BRETURN', 'OBRETURN', 'OBRTN', 'O&BRTN') } { return $returnType }
                                'OFT' { return 'OFT' }
                                'IFT' { return 'IFT' }
                                { $_ -in @('SIM', 'S') } { return 'AMBIGUOUS' }
                }
                return $null
}

# Parses what the user types into the quick-entry box. Several entries can be
# separated by "," or ";". Returns {Lines; Errors; Warnings}.
#   0730 DL                 Day Local at 0730
#   1015 O&B / 1015 OB 1330 O&B plus its linked return (default +3 hr, or at 1330)
#   1330 RTN                return line linked to the latest unlinked O&B that day
#   1300 OFT x2             two OFT lines
#   0800 DL Jones sp:Smith  IP Jones, student Smith hardcoded (m:FT5103 sets the mission)
function ConvertFrom-QuickEntry {
                param (
                                [string]$Text,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Day,
                                [array]$Instructors = @(),
                                [array]$Students = @(),
                                $Board,
                                $Settings
                )

                if ($null -eq $Settings) {
                                $Settings = if ($null -ne $Board) { $Board.Settings } else { Get-DefaultBoardSettings }
                }
                $dayText = ConvertTo-BoardDay $Day
                $dayDate = [datetime]::ParseExact($dayText, 'yyyy-MM-dd', [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
                $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                $links = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                $errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                $warnings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                $offset = [int]$Settings.OBReturnOffsetMinutes
                if ($offset -le 0) { $offset = 180 }

                # Multi-word type names become one token first
                $norm = $Text -replace '(?i)\bday\s+local\b', 'DL' -replace '(?i)\bo\s*&\s*b\s+(return|rtn)\b', 'RTN' -replace '(?i)\bo\s*&\s*b\b', 'O&B'

                foreach ($entry in ($norm -split '[,;\r\n]+')) {
                                $e = $entry.Trim()
                                if ($e -eq '') { continue }
                                $tokens = @($e -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })

                                $time = ConvertTo-BoardTime $tokens[0]
                                if ($null -eq $time) { $errors.Add("Invalid time '$($tokens[0])' in '$e' (use 0730, 730 or 7:30)"); continue }

                                $type = $null
                                $returnTime = $null
                                $count = 1
                                $ipText = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                                $studentText = ''
                                $missionText = ''
                                $bad = $false

                                for ($i = 1; $i -lt $tokens.Count; $i++) {
                                                $tok = $tokens[$i]
                                                if ($tok -match '^(?i)(sp|stu|student)[:=](.+)$') { $studentText = $Matches[2]; continue }
                                                if ($tok -match '^(?i)(m|msn|mission)[:=](.+)$') { $missionText = $Matches[2]; continue }
                                                if ($tok -match '^(?i)ip[:=](.+)$') { $ipText.Add($Matches[1]); continue }
                                                if ($tok -match '^(?i)x(\d)$') { $count = [int]$Matches[1]; continue }
                                                if ($null -eq $type) {
                                                                $tt = ConvertTo-BoardSortieType $tok $Settings
                                                                if ($tt -eq 'AMBIGUOUS') { $errors.Add("'$tok' is ambiguous - use OFT or IFT ('$e')"); $bad = $true; break }
                                                                if ($null -ne $tt) { $type = $tt; continue }
                                                }
                                                elseif ($type -eq 'O&B' -and $null -eq $returnTime -and $ipText.Count -eq 0) {
                                                                $rt = ConvertTo-BoardTime $tok
                                                                if ($null -ne $rt) { $returnTime = $rt; continue }
                                                }
                                                $ipText.Add($tok)
                                }
                                if ($bad) { continue }
                                if ($null -eq $type) { $errors.Add("Missing sortie type in '$e' (DL, O&B, RTN, OFT, IFT)"); continue }
                                if ($count -lt 1) { $count = 1 }

                                # Instructor: last name, full name or callsign
                                $ipName = ''
                                if ($ipText.Count -gt 0) {
                                                $raw = ($ipText -join ' ').Trim()
                                                $ip = Find-InstructorForEntry -Instructors $Instructors -Text $raw
                                                if ($null -eq $ip) { $errors.Add("IP '$raw' not found ('$e')"); continue }
                                                $ipName = [string]$ip.Name
                                }

                                $studentName = ''
                                if ($studentText -ne '') {
                                                $s = Resolve-StudentByName -Students $Students -Name ($studentText -replace '_', ' ')
                                                if ($null -eq $s) { $errors.Add("Student '$studentText' not found ('$e')"); continue }
                                                if (Test-IsReturnSortieType $type) { $warnings.Add("Return lines follow their O&B; student ignored on '$e'") }
                                                else { $studentName = [string]$s.Name }
                                }

                                $etd = $dayDate.Add($time)
                                for ($c = 0; $c -lt $count; $c++) {
                                                $line = New-BoardLine -ETD $etd -SortieType $type -Instructor $ipName -Student $(if ($c -eq 0) { $studentName } else { '' }) -Mission $(if ($c -eq 0) { $missionText } else { '' })
                                                $lines.Add($line)
                                                if ($type -eq 'O&B') {
                                                                $retEtd = if ($null -ne $returnTime) { $dayDate.Add($returnTime) } else { $etd.AddMinutes($offset) }
                                                                if ($retEtd -le $etd) { $warnings.Add("Return time $(Format-BoardTime $retEtd) is not after the O&B in '$e'") }
                                                                $lines.Add((New-ReturnLineFor -Board ([PSCustomObject]@{ Settings = $Settings }) -OBLine $line -ReturnETD $retEtd))
                                                }
                                                elseif (Test-IsReturnSortieType $type) {
                                                                $claimed = @($links | ForEach-Object { $_.ObId })
                                                                $ob = Find-UnlinkedOBForReturn -Board $Board -Pending $lines -ReturnLine $line -ClaimedIds $claimed
