                $ip = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $Instructors -Instructor $Sortie.Instructor
                $Sortie.Instructor = $ip
                $Sortie.Student = $Student
                $Sortie.Mission = $Mission
                [void](Initialize-SortieRow $Sortie)
                $Sortie.FilledBy = 'Pin'

                if ($null -ne $Mission) {
                                [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $Student -Mission $Mission -InstructorName (Get-NameText $ip) -ETD $Sortie.ETD -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Sortie $Sortie)
                                Write-Host " [PINNED] '$($Student.Name)' on '$($Mission.Mission)' (ETD: $($Sortie.ETD))" -ForegroundColor Cyan
                }
                else {
                                Write-Warning " [PINNED] '$($Student.Name)' has no mission on ETD $($Sortie.ETD)."
                }

                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Sortie.Callsign)) {
                                $Sortie.Callsign = $ip.Callsign
                                $Sortie.Num = $ip.Num
                }

                # Formation pairing only for true leads (not a line pinned as someone's wing)
                $isWing = (Test-IsPairedWing -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Schedule) -or ([string]$Sortie.Notes -like '*Wingman to*')
                if ($null -ne $Mission -and ([string]$Mission.Type) -like '*Form*' -and -not $isWing) {
                                $existingWing = Get-PinnedWingRow -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Schedule
                                $FormIndex = Pair-FormationWingman -PrimarySortie $Sortie -PrimaryStudent $Student -PrimaryMission $Mission `
                                                -Schedule $Schedule -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights `
                                                -FormIndex $FormIndex -Formations $Formations -ExistingWingSortie $existingWing
                }

                # O&B second leg
                if ($null -ne $Mission -and (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType))) {
                                Schedule-ReturnLeg -Sortie $Sortie -Student $Student -Schedule $Schedule -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights
                }

                return $FormIndex
}


# =================================================================================
#  FORMATION PAIRING
#  First tries to find another student to fly as wingman. If none is available, the
#  next open live-fly line inside the look-ahead window becomes Direct Support.
#  FormCallsigns is consecutive Lead/Wing pairs (e.g. HAZE 11, HAZE 12); each pair
#  attempt consumes two entries and advances FormIndex by 2.
# =================================================================================
function Pair-FormationWingman {
                param (
                                $PrimarySortie,
                                $PrimaryStudent,
                                $PrimaryMission,
                                [array]$Schedule,
                                [array]$Students,
                                [array]$Instructors,
                                $SoftWeights,
                                [int]$FormIndex = 0,
                                [array]$Formations = @(),
                                $ExistingWingSortie
                )

                try {
                                $LeadEntry = $null
                                $WingEntry = $null
                                $haveCallsigns = ($null -ne $Formations -and $Formations.Count -gt 0)
                                if ($haveCallsigns) {
                                                if ($FormIndex -ge $Formations.Count) { $FormIndex = 0 }
                                                $LeadEntry = $Formations[$FormIndex]
                                                $WingIndex = $FormIndex + 1
                                                if ($WingIndex -ge $Formations.Count) { $WingIndex = 0 }
                                                $WingEntry = $Formations[$WingIndex]
                                                $PrimarySortie.Callsign = $LeadEntry.Callsign
                                                $PrimarySortie.Num = $LeadEntry.Num
                                }
                                $leadName = Get-NameText $PrimaryStudent

                                # The board already paired a pinned wingman to this lead
                                if ($null -ne $ExistingWingSortie) {
                                                if ($haveCallsigns) {
                                                                $ExistingWingSortie.Callsign = $WingEntry.Callsign
                                                                $ExistingWingSortie.Num = $WingEntry.Num
                                                }
                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $ExistingWingSortie -Note "Wingman to $leadName"
                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $PrimarySortie -Note "Wingman: $(Get-NameText $ExistingWingSortie.Student)"
                                }
                                else {
                                                $FormLookAhead = Get-Weight $SoftWeights 'FormLookAhead' 22
                                                $LevelDifference = Get-Weight $SoftWeights 'LevelDifference' 0
                                                $CurrentETD = Parse-ETD $PrimarySortie.ETD
                                                $TimeWindowEnd = $CurrentETD.AddMinutes($FormLookAhead)
                                                $primaryLvl = 0
                                                [void][int]::TryParse([string]$PrimaryMission.Level, [ref]$primaryLvl)

                                                $openLines = @(foreach ($r in $Schedule) {
                                                                if (Test-SameSortie $r $PrimarySortie) { continue }
                                                                if (-not (Test-IsOpenWingLine $r)) { continue }
                                                                $rs = Parse-ETD $r.ETD
                                                                if ($null -ne $rs -and $rs -ge $CurrentETD -and $rs -le $TimeWindowEnd) { $r }
                                                })

                                                $best = $null
                                                foreach ($WingSortie in $openLines) {
                                                                $WingSortie.Instructor = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $Instructors -Instructor $WingSortie.Instructor
                                                                foreach ($FormStudent in $Students) {
                                                                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$FormStudent.Name) -or [string]$FormStudent.Name -eq $leadName) { continue }

                                                                                $TentativeWingMission = $null
                                                                                foreach ($evt in @(Get-ValidOptedEvents -Student $FormStudent -Sortie $WingSortie)) {
                                                                                                if ([string]$evt.Type -like '*Form*') { $TentativeWingMission = $evt; break }
                                                                                }
                                                                                if ($null -eq $TentativeWingMission) { continue }

                                                                                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $FormStudent -Sortie $WingSortie -Schedule $Schedule -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors `
                                                                                                -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead -Mission $TentativeWingMission -IsWingCandidate
                                                                                if (-not $hr.Passed) { continue }

                                                                                $soft = Get-EventScore -Student $FormStudent -Sortie $WingSortie -Evt $TentativeWingMission -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Instructors $Instructors
                                                                                $wingLvl = 0
                                                                                [void][int]::TryParse([string]$TentativeWingMission.Level, [ref]$wingLvl)
                                                                                $cand = [PSCustomObject]@{
                                                                                                Student = $FormStudent
                                                                                                Sortie  = $WingSortie
                                                                                                Event   = $TentativeWingMission
                                                                                                Score   = $soft.Score + (($wingLvl - $primaryLvl) * $LevelDifference)
                                                                                                Hard    = $hr
                                                                                                Soft    = $soft
                                                                                }
                                                                                if (Test-CandidateBetter $cand $best) { $best = $cand }
                                                                }
                                                }

                                                if ($null -ne $best) {
                                                                $w = $best.Sortie
                                                                $w.Student = $best.Student
                                                                $w.Mission = $best.Event
                                                                [void](Initialize-SortieRow $w)
                                                                $w.FilledBy = 'Wing'
                                                                if ($haveCallsigns) {
                                                                                $w.Callsign = $WingEntry.Callsign
                                                                                $w.Num = $WingEntry.Num
                                                                }
                                                                [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $best.Student -Mission $best.Event -InstructorName (Get-NameText $w.Instructor) -ETD $w.ETD -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Sortie $w)
                                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $w -Note "Wingman to $leadName"
                                                                foreach ($n in (Get-ChosenEventNotes -Hard $best.Hard -Evt $best.Event -Soft $best.Soft)) { Add-SortieNote -Sortie $w -Note $n }
                                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $PrimarySortie -Note "Wingman: $($best.Student.Name)"
                                                }
                                                else {
                                                                # No student wingman: claim the soonest open live-fly line as Direct Support
                                                                $ds = $openLines | Sort-Object -Property { Parse-ETD $_.ETD } | Select-Object -First 1
                                                                if ($null -ne $ds) {
                                                                                $ds.Student = 'Need Form SP'
                                                                                [void](Initialize-SortieRow $ds)
                                                                                $ds.FilledBy = 'DS'
                                                                                if ($haveCallsigns) {
                                                                                                $ds.Callsign = $WingEntry.Callsign
                                                                                                $ds.Num = $WingEntry.Num
                                                                                }
                                                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $ds -Note "Direct Support for $leadName"
                                                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $PrimarySortie -Note 'Wingman: DS'
                                                                }
                                                                else {
                                                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $PrimarySortie -Note 'Wingman: none found'
                                                                }
                                                }
                                }

                                # Always consume the full Lead/Wing pair
                                if ($haveCallsigns) {
                                                $FormIndex += 2
                                                if ($FormIndex -ge $Formations.Count) { $FormIndex = 0 }
                                }
                                return $FormIndex
                } catch {
                                Write-Warning "Error resolving formation pairing: $($_.Exception.Message)"
                                return $FormIndex
                }
}

# Hard-rule notes for the chosen event, then its soft-rule notes
function Get-ChosenEventNotes {
                param ($Hard, $Evt, $Soft)

                $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                if ($null -ne $Hard) {
                                foreach ($n in @($Hard.Notes)) { if ($n) { $out.Add($n) } }
                                $er = Find-EventResult -Hard $Hard -Evt $Evt
                                if ($null -ne $er) { foreach ($n in @($er.Notes)) { if ($n) { $out.Add($n) } } }
                }
                if ($null -ne $Soft) { foreach ($n in @($Soft.Notes)) { if ($n) { $out.Add($n) } } }
                return @($out | Select-Object -Unique)
}

function Find-EventResult {
                param ($Hard, $Evt)

                $name = Get-NameText $Evt
                foreach ($er in @($Hard.EventResults)) { if ($er.Mission -ieq $name) { return $er } }
                return $null
}


# =================================================================================
#  O&B RETURN LEG
#  Called after the O&B event has been marked complete on the student.
# =================================================================================
function Schedule-ReturnLeg {
                param (
                                $Sortie,
                                $Student,
                                [array]$Schedule,
                                [array]$Instructors = @(),
                                $SoftWeights
                )

                $OBReturn = Get-LinkedReturnRow -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Schedule -StudentName (Get-NameText $Student)
                if ($null -eq $OBReturn) {
                                $day = (Parse-ETD $Sortie.ETD)
                                Write-Warning "Could not find an empty O&B Return row on $(if ($day) { $day.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') }) for $(Get-NameText $Sortie.Instructor)."
                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note 'No O&B Return line found'
                                return
                }

                [void](Initialize-SortieRow $OBReturn)
                $OBReturn.Student = $Student
                $OBReturn.Instructor = $Sortie.Instructor
                $OBReturn.Callsign = $Sortie.Callsign
                $OBReturn.Num = $Sortie.Num
                $OBReturn.FilledBy = 'Return'
                Remove-StudentReservation -Student $Student -LineId @([string]$OBReturn.BoardLineId)

                # Select the mission the SP flies home: next valid event by Syllabus ID
                $ValidEvents = @(Get-ValidOptedEvents -Student $Student -Sortie $OBReturn -NoLookahead)
                if ($ValidEvents.Count -gt 0) {
                                $OBReturn.Mission = $ValidEvents[0]
                                [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $Student -Mission $ValidEvents[0] -InstructorName (Get-NameText $OBReturn.Instructor) -ETD $OBReturn.ETD -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Sortie $OBReturn)
                }
                else {
                                $OBReturn.Mission = $null
                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $OBReturn -Note 'No valid mission for return leg'
                }
}


# =================================================================================
#  ____   ____ _   _ _____ ____  _   _ _     ___ _   _  ____
# / ___| / ___| | | | ____|  _ \| | | | |   |_ _| \ | |/ ___|
# \___ \| |   | |_| |  _| | | | | | | | |    | ||  \| | |  _
#  ___) | |___|  _  | |___| |_| | |_| | |___ | || |\  | |_| |
# |____/ \____|_| |_|_____|____/ \___/|_____|___|_| \_|\____|
#
# Fills every line that is not hardcoded. Pinned lines are kept (rule violations
# are flagged with OVERRIDE notes). Lines are processed in ETD order; pinned lines
# that come later in the day hold the student's time as reservations, so earlier
# fills respect them.
# Returns {Schedule, Students, Overrides, Stats, Log}.
# =================================================================================
function Invoke-FillSchedule {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [array]$Schedule,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [array]$Students,
                                [array]$Instructors = @(),
                                $SoftWeights,
                                [array]$Formations = @(),
                                [scriptblock]$OnProgress,
                                [switch]$Trace
                )

                $log = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                $overrides = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                $FormLookAhead = Get-Weight $SoftWeights 'FormLookAhead' 22

                # ---------------- PREP ROWS ----------------
                $prepared = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                $idx = 0
                foreach ($row in $Schedule) {
                                [void](Initialize-SortieRow $row)
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.BoardLineId)) { $row.BoardLineId = "row$idx" }
                                $row.FilledBy = $null
                                $ip = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $Instructors -Instructor $row.Instructor
                                $row.Instructor = $ip
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.Callsign)) {
                                                $row.Callsign = $ip.Callsign
                                                $row.Num = $ip.Num
                                }
                                if (Test-IsSentinelStudent $row.Student) { $row.Student = $null }
                                if ((Get-NameText $row.Mission) -eq '') { $row.Mission = $null }
                                $key = Parse-ETD $row.ETD
                                if ($null -eq $key) { $key = [datetime]::MaxValue }
                                $prepared.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ Row = $row; Key = $key; Index = $idx })
                                $idx++
                }
                $rows = @($prepared | Sort-Object -Property Key, Index | ForEach-Object { $_.Row })

                # ---------------- PINNED LINES BECOME RESERVATIONS ----------------
                $pinStudent = @{}
                foreach ($row in $rows) {
                                $name = Get-NameText $row.Student
                                if ($name -eq '') { continue }
                                $s = Resolve-StudentByName -Students $Students -Name $name
                                if ($null -eq $s) {
                                                $log.Add("Pinned student '$name' on $($row.ETD) not found in MasterData")
                                                continue
                                }
                                $pinStudent[[string]$row.BoardLineId] = $s
                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $s -LineId ([string]$row.BoardLineId) -ETD $row.ETD -SortieType ([string]$row.SortieType) -Mission (Get-NameText $row.Mission) -Instructor (Get-NameText $row.Instructor)
                                if (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$row.SortieType)) {
                                                $ret = Get-LinkedReturnRow -Sortie $row -Schedule $rows -StudentName $name
                                                if ($null -ne $ret) {
                                                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $s -LineId ([string]$ret.BoardLineId) -ETD $ret.ETD -SortieType ([string]$ret.SortieType) -Instructor (Get-NameText $row.Instructor)
                                                }
                                }
                }

                # ---------------- MAIN LOOP ----------------
                $FormIndex = 0
                $CurrentDay = $null
                $n = $rows.Count
                $i = 0
                foreach ($Sortie in $rows) {
                                $i++
                                $day = Parse-ETD $Sortie.ETD
                                if ($null -ne $day -and $CurrentDay -ne $day.Date) {
                                                $CurrentDay = $day.Date
                                                $FormIndex = 0
                                }
                                if ([string]$Sortie.FilledBy -ne '') { continue }

                                if ($null -ne $OnProgress) {
                                                try { & $OnProgress $i $n ("{0} {1}" -f (Format-EtdShort $Sortie.ETD), $Sortie.SortieType) } catch { }
                                }
                                Write-Host "Scheduling Sortie $i of $n ($(Format-EtdShort $Sortie.ETD) $($Sortie.SortieType))"

                                # ---------------- HARDCODED (PINNED) ----------------
                                if ((Get-NameText $Sortie.Student) -ne '') {
                                                $FormIndex = Invoke-PinnedLine -Sortie $Sortie -Student $pinStudent[[string]$Sortie.BoardLineId] -Rows $rows -Students $Students `
                                                                -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Formations $Formations -FormIndex $FormIndex -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead -Overrides $overrides
                                                continue
                                }

                                # ---------------- RETURN LEG WITH NO O&B ----------------
                                if (Test-IsReturnSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType)) {
                                                $Sortie.Student = 'For Sale'
                                                $Sortie.Mission = $null
                                                $Sortie.FilledBy = 'ForSale'
                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note 'O&B Leg 1 Not Filled'
                                                continue
                                }

                                # ---------------- OPEN LINE ----------------
                                $FormIndex = Invoke-OpenLine -Sortie $Sortie -Rows $rows -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights `
                                                -Formations $Formations -FormIndex $FormIndex -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead -Trace:$Trace
                }

                $stats = [ordered]@{ Lines = $n; Pinned = 0; Filled = 0; Wing = 0; Return = 0; DS = 0; ForSale = 0; Overrides = $overrides.Count }
                foreach ($r in $rows) {
                                switch ([string]$r.FilledBy) {
                                                'Pin' { $stats.Pinned++ }
                                                'Engine' { $stats.Filled++ }
                                                'Wing' { $stats.Wing++ }
                                                'Return' { $stats.Return++ }
                                                'DS' { $stats.DS++ }
                                                'ForSale' { $stats.ForSale++ }
                                }
                }

                return [PSCustomObject]@{
                                Schedule  = $rows
                                Students  = $Students
                                Overrides = $overrides.ToArray()
                                Stats     = [PSCustomObject]$stats
                                Log       = $log.ToArray()
                }
}

# One pinned line: keep the student, pick the event, record it, flag rule breaks
# Which event a pinned student flies on a line: the explicit mission, otherwise the best-scoring
# event that passes the rules (Form events only for a wing, and preferred for a lead with a paired wing).
# Returns {Mission, Soft, Hard}. Mission is $null when nothing can be flown.
function Select-PinnedMission {
                param ($Student, $Sortie, [array]$Rows, [array]$Students, [array]$Instructors, $SoftWeights, [double]$FormLookAhead = 22)

                $isWing = Test-IsPairedWing -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Rows
                $hasWing = $null -ne (Get-PinnedWingRow -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Rows)
                $explicitName = Get-NameText $Sortie.Mission
                $missionArg = if ($explicitName -ne '') { $explicitName } else { $null }
                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Rows -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors `
                                -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead -Mission $missionArg -IsWingCandidate:$isWing -Explain

                $mission = $null
                $soft = $null
                if ($explicitName -ne '') {
                                $mission = Find-SyllabusMission -Student $Student -Mission $explicitName
                }
                else {
                                # (auto) = the best-scoring event that passes the event-level rules
                                $passed = @($hr.EventResults | Where-Object { $_.Passed })
                                $formPassed = @($passed | Where-Object { [string]$_.Event.Type -like '*Form*' })
                                $pool = if (($isWing -or $hasWing) -and $formPassed.Count -gt 0) { $formPassed } elseif ($isWing) { @() } else { $passed }
                                $best = $null
                                foreach ($er in $pool) {
                                                $sr = Get-EventScore -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Evt $er.Event -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Instructors $Instructors
                                                $cand = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = $Student; Event = $er.Event; Score = $sr.Score; Soft = $sr }
                                                if (Test-CandidateBetter $cand $best) { $best = $cand }
                                }
                                if ($null -ne $best) {
                                                $mission = $best.Event
                                                $soft = $best.Soft
                                }
                                else {
                                                $fallback = @($hr.EventResults | ForEach-Object { $_.Event })
                                                if ($isWing) { $formOnly = @($fallback | Where-Object { [string]$_.Type -like '*Form*' }); if ($formOnly.Count -gt 0) { $fallback = $formOnly } }
                                                if ($fallback.Count -gt 0) { $mission = $fallback[0] }
                                }
                }
                if ($null -ne $mission -and $null -eq $soft) {
                                $soft = Get-EventScore -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Evt $mission -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Instructors $Instructors
                }
                return [PSCustomObject]@{ Mission = $mission; Soft = $soft; Hard = $hr }
}

function Invoke-PinnedLine {
                param ($Sortie, $Student, [array]$Rows, [array]$Students, [array]$Instructors, $SoftWeights, [array]$Formations, [int]$FormIndex, [double]$FormLookAhead, $Overrides)

                $name = Get-NameText $Sortie.Student
                if ($null -eq $Student) {
                                $Sortie.FilledBy = 'Pin'
                                $msg = "student '$name' not found in MasterData"
                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note "OVERRIDE: $msg"
                                $Overrides.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ LineId = $Sortie.BoardLineId; ETD = $Sortie.ETD; Student = $name; Violations = @($msg) })
                                return $FormIndex
                }

                $release = @([string]$Sortie.BoardLineId)
                if (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType)) {
                                $ret = Get-LinkedReturnRow -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Rows -StudentName $Student.Name
                                if ($null -ne $ret) { $release += [string]$ret.BoardLineId }
                }
                Remove-StudentReservation -Student $Student -LineId $release

                $explicitName = Get-NameText $Sortie.Mission
                $pick = Select-PinnedMission -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Rows $Rows -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead
                $hr = $pick.Hard
                $mission = $pick.Mission
                $soft = $pick.Soft

                $FormIndex = Process-HardcodedSortie -Sortie $Sortie -Student $Student -Mission $mission -Schedule $Rows -Students $Students `
                                -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Formations $Formations -FormIndex $FormIndex
                if ($null -eq $mission -and $explicitName -ne '') {
                                # A typed mission that isn't in the syllabus: kept as typed. The student still flies an O&B's
                                # return leg (the next event they can fly home, or a note that there is none).
                                $Sortie.Mission = $explicitName
                                if (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType)) {
                                                Schedule-ReturnLeg -Sortie $Sortie -Student $Student -Schedule $Rows -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights
                                                $release = @([string]$Sortie.BoardLineId)
                                }
                }
                if ($null -eq $mission) {
                                # Nothing was marked complete, so keep holding the student's time on this line (and its return)
                                # or later lines could double- or triple-book them
                                foreach ($rid in $release) {
                                                $held = $Rows | Where-Object { [string]$_.BoardLineId -eq $rid } | Select-Object -First 1
                                                if ($null -ne $held) {
                                                                Add-StudentReservation -Student $Student -LineId $rid -ETD $held.ETD -SortieType ([string]$held.SortieType) -Mission $(if ($rid -eq [string]$Sortie.BoardLineId) { $explicitName } else { '' }) -Instructor (Get-NameText $Sortie.Instructor)
                                                }
                                }
                }

                foreach ($note in (Get-ChosenEventNotes -Hard $hr -Evt $mission -Soft $soft)) { Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note $note }

                $hard = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
                foreach ($v in @($hr.Violations)) { if ($v.Severity -eq 'Hard') { $hard.Add($v.Message) } }
                if ($null -ne $mission) {
                                $er = Find-EventResult -Hard $hr -Evt $mission
                                if ($null -ne $er) { foreach ($v in @($er.Violations)) { if ($v.Severity -eq 'Hard') { $hard.Add($v.Message) } } }
                }
                elseif ($explicitName -eq '') {
                                # (A typed mission that isn't in the syllabus is kept as typed; MISSION_NOT_FOUND says why)
                                $hard.Add('no eligible event - mission left blank')
                }
                $hardList = @($hard | Select-Object -Unique)
                if ($hardList.Count -gt 0) {
                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note ("OVERRIDE: " + ($hardList -join '; '))
                                $Overrides.Add([PSCustomObject]@{ LineId = $Sortie.BoardLineId; ETD = $Sortie.ETD; Student = $Student.Name; Violations = $hardList })
                }
                return $FormIndex
}

# One open line: run every student through the hard rules, score the survivors,
# put the best one on the line
function Invoke-OpenLine {
                param ($Sortie, [array]$Rows, [array]$Students, [array]$Instructors, $SoftWeights, [array]$Formations, [int]$FormIndex, [double]$FormLookAhead, [switch]$Trace)

                $lineContext = @{}
                $best = $null
                $traceList = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

                foreach ($Student in $Students) {
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Student.Name)) { continue }
                                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Schedule $Rows -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors `
                                                -FormLookAhead $FormLookAhead -LineContext $lineContext
                                if (-not $hr.Passed) { continue }

                                foreach ($er in @($hr.EventResults | Where-Object { $_.Passed })) {
                                                $sr = Get-EventScore -Student $Student -Sortie $Sortie -Evt $er.Event -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Instructors $Instructors
                                                $cand = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = $Student; Event = $er.Event; Score = $sr.Score; Soft = $sr; Hard = $hr }
                                                if ($Trace) { $traceList.Add($cand) }
                                                if (Test-CandidateBetter $cand $best) { $best = $cand }
                                }
                }

                if ($Trace) { Trace-SchedulingDecision -Sortie $Sortie -Candidates $traceList.ToArray() -Best $best }

                # ---------------- UNABLE TO FILL ----------------
                # Puts the line up for sale if we don't have any valid students to put in the line
                if ($null -eq $best) {
                                Write-Host "No available Student for $($Sortie.ETD) : $($Sortie.SortieType)"
                                $Sortie.Student = 'For Sale'
                                $Sortie.Mission = $null
                                $Sortie.FilledBy = 'ForSale'
                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note 'No Available SP'
                                if ([string]$Sortie.SortieType -notlike '*FT*') {
                                                Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note 'Potentially fill if we have another line'
                                }
                                return $FormIndex
                }

                Write-Host "The Selected Student's Score is $($best.Score)"
                $Sortie.Student = $best.Student
                $Sortie.Mission = $best.Event
                $Sortie.FilledBy = 'Engine'
                [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $best.Student -Mission $best.Event -InstructorName (Get-NameText $Sortie.Instructor) -ETD $Sortie.ETD -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -Sortie $Sortie)
                foreach ($note in (Get-ChosenEventNotes -Hard $best.Hard -Evt $best.Event -Soft $best.Soft)) { Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note $note }

                if ([string]$best.Event.Type -like '*Form*') {
                                $FormIndex = Pair-FormationWingman -PrimarySortie $Sortie -PrimaryStudent $best.Student -PrimaryMission $best.Event `
                                                -Schedule $Rows -Students $Students -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights -FormIndex $FormIndex -Formations $Formations
                }
                if (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType)) {
                                Schedule-ReturnLeg -Sortie $Sortie -Student $best.Student -Schedule $Rows -Instructors $Instructors -SoftWeights $SoftWeights
                }
                return $FormIndex
}

function Trace-SchedulingDecision {
                param (
                                $Sortie,
                                [array]$Candidates,
                                $Best
                )

                Write-Host "`n=== DIAGNOSTIC: Scheduling Decision for ETD $($Sortie.ETD) ===" -ForegroundColor Yellow
                Write-Host "Eligible candidates: $(@($Candidates).Count)"
                foreach ($c in ($Candidates | Sort-Object -Property Score -Descending)) {
                                Write-Host ("  - {0} | {1} | Score: {2}" -f $c.Student.Name, (Get-NameText $c.Event), $c.Score)
                }
                if ($null -ne $Best) {
                                Write-Host "--> WINNER: $($Best.Student.Name) on $(Get-NameText $Best.Event) with Score $($Best.Score)" -ForegroundColor Green
                }
                Write-Host "===========================================================`n" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

######## ./Modules/Syllabus.psm1.txt ########
# SYLLABUS.PSM1 DIRECTORY:
#             Everything about a student's syllabus: which events they can fly next,
#             marking events complete, sim debt, and the timeline of what they fly
# Test-MissionComplete / Get-SyllabusSortKey / Find-SyllabusMission / Get-MissionKind
# Get-OptedEvents / Get-AllowedEventTypes / Get-ValidOptedEvents
# Get-SimDebtDelta / Get-MissionSimDebtDelta / Update-StudentSimDebtFromSyllabus
# Complete-StudentMission / Undo-StudentMission / Reset-PlannedCompletions
# Get-UnsatSimKind / Get-LastSimType / Clear-CleanedUnsat / Restore-PlannedUnsat
# Add-StudentReservation / Remove-StudentReservation / Get-ReservedMissionNames
# Get-StudentTimeline
# Measure-String / Get-StringLength / Get-StringLengths / Get-StringCounts (String Tracker)


# =================================================================================
#  SYLLABUS LOOKUPS
# =================================================================================

function Test-MissionComplete {
                param ($Mission)

                if ($null -eq $Mission) { return $false }
                return (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Mission.IsComplete)
}

# SyllabusID can come in as a number or text; sort numerically when possible
function Get-SyllabusSortKey {
                param ($Mission)

                $raw = $Mission.SyllabusID
                $num = 0.0
                if ($null -ne $raw -and [double]::TryParse(([string]$raw).Trim(), [ref]$num)) { return $num }
                return [double]::MaxValue
}

function Find-SyllabusMission {
                param (
                                $Student,
                                $Mission
                )

                $name = Get-NameText $Mission
                if ($null -eq $Student -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($name)) { return $null }
                foreach ($m in @($Student.Syllabus)) {
                                if ($null -ne $m -and ([string]$m.Mission).Trim() -ieq $name) { return $m }
                }
                return $null
}

# 'Sim' for OFT/IFT syllabus events, 'Flight' for everything else
function Get-MissionKind {
                param (
                                $Mission,
                                [string]$InstructorName
                )

                $type = [string](Get-OptionalProperty $Mission 'Type' '')
                if ($type -match '(?i)^\s*(IFT|OFT)\s*$') { return 'Sim' }
                if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($type)) { return 'Flight' }
                if ($InstructorName -like '*SIM IP*') { return 'Sim' }
                return 'Flight'
}


# =================================================================================
#  OPTED EVENTS
# =================================================================================

# Finds the events a student is "opted" for: incomplete, with every prereq complete.
# -AssumeComplete treats extra missions as complete (used for O&B look-ahead).
# -ExcludeMissions drops missions already reserved on another line.
function Get-OptedEvents {
                param (
                                [AllowEmptyCollection()]
                                [array]$SyllabusData,
                                [string[]]$AssumeComplete = @(),
                                [string[]]$ExcludeMissions = @()
                )

                $completionStatus = @{}
                foreach ($row in @($SyllabusData)) {
                                if ($null -eq $row) { continue }
                                $completionStatus[([string]$row.Mission).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()] = (Test-MissionComplete $row)
                }
                foreach ($name in $AssumeComplete) {
                                if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($name)) { $completionStatus[$name.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()] = $true }
                }
                $excluded = @{}
                foreach ($name in $ExcludeMissions) {
                                if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($name)) { $excluded[$name.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()] = $true }
                }

                $optedEvents = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                foreach ($row in @($SyllabusData)) {
                                if ($null -eq $row) { continue }
                                $key = ([string]$row.Mission).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                                if ($key -eq '' -or $completionStatus[$key] -or $excluded.ContainsKey($key)) { continue }

                                $prereqsMet = $true
                                $prereqText = [string]$row.Prereqs
                                if ($prereqText.Trim() -ne '0' -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($prereqText)) {
                                                foreach ($prereq in ($prereqText -split ',')) {
                                                                $p = $prereq.Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                                                                if ($p -eq '') { continue }
                                                                if (-not $completionStatus[$p]) { $prereqsMet = $false; break }
                                                }
                                }

                                if ($prereqsMet) { $optedEvents.Add($row) }
                }

                return $optedEvents.ToArray()
}

# Which syllabus event Types may be flown on a sortie type ($null = none)
function Get-AllowedEventTypes {
                param ([string]$SortieType)

                if ($SortieType -match '(?i)O\s*&\s*B') { return @('Single', 'Formation', 'Both') }
                if ($SortieType -like '*Day Local*') { return @('Single', 'SingleSolo', 'Formation', 'FormSolo', 'Both') }
                if ($SortieType -like '*IFT*') { return @('IFT') }
                if ($SortieType -like '*OFT*') { return @('IFT', 'OFT') }
                return $null
}

# Opted events that fit the sortie type, minus missions reserved on other lines.
# For an O&B, also requires a flyable second leg after the first event.
# Never mutates the syllabus.
function Get-ValidOptedEvents {
                param (
                                $Student,
                                $Sortie,
                                [string[]]$AssumeComplete = @(),
                                [switch]$NoLookahead
                )

                if ($null -eq $Student) { return }
                $types = Get-AllowedEventTypes ([string]$Sortie.SortieType)
                if ($null -eq $types) { return }

                $lineId = [string](Get-OptionalProperty $Sortie 'BoardLineId' '')
                $reserved = @(Get-ReservedMissionNames -Student $Student -ExceptLineId $lineId)

                $all = Get-OptedEvents -SyllabusData $Student.Syllabus -AssumeComplete $AssumeComplete -ExcludeMissions $reserved
                $OptedEvents = @($all | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Type).Trim() -in $types } | Sort-Object -Property { Get-SyllabusSortKey $_ })
                if ($OptedEvents.Count -eq 0) { return }

                # O&B DOUBLE RIDE PREREQ (LOOK-AHEAD): the return leg must have an event to fly
                if (-not $NoLookahead -and (Test-IsOBSortieType ([string]$Sortie.SortieType))) {
                                $first = [string]$OptedEvents[0].Mission
                                $next = Get-OptedEvents -SyllabusData $Student.Syllabus -AssumeComplete (@($AssumeComplete) + $first) -ExcludeMissions $reserved
                                $second = @($next | Where-Object { ([string]$_.Type).Trim() -in @('Single', 'Formation', 'Both') })
                                if ($second.Count -eq 0) { return }
                }

                return $OptedEvents
}


# =================================================================================
#  SIM DEBT
#  Every flight creates "debt" that sims pay down.
# =================================================================================

function Get-SimDebtDelta {
                param (
                                [string]$MissionName,
                                [double]$SimStopMult,
                                [double]$TransSimRatio,
                                [double]$FormSimRatio
                )

                # Flights increase debt
                if ($MissionName -like '*FT5*' -or $MissionName -like '*FF5*' -or $MissionName -like '*AA5*') { return $SimStopMult }
                # Transition sims decrease debt
                if ($MissionName -like '*FI3*' -or $MissionName -like '*FE3*' -or $MissionName -like '*FI4*' -or $MissionName -like '*FE4*') { return -$TransSimRatio }
                # Formation sims decrease debt
                if ($MissionName -like '*FN3*' -or $MissionName -like '*FN4*' -or $MissionName -like '*AA4*') { return -$FormSimRatio }
                return 0.0
}

function Get-MissionSimDebtDelta {
                param (
                                [string]$MissionName,
                                $SoftWeights
                )

                if ($null -eq $SoftWeights) { return 0.0 }
                return (Get-SimDebtDelta -MissionName $MissionName `
                                -SimStopMult ([double](Get-OptionalProperty $SoftWeights 'SimStopMult' 0)) `
                                -TransSimRatio ([double](Get-OptionalProperty $SoftWeights 'TransSimRatio' 0)) `
                                -FormSimRatio ([double](Get-OptionalProperty $SoftWeights 'FormSimRatio' 0)))
}

# Recomputes SimDebt from every completed syllabus event
function Update-StudentSimDebtFromSyllabus {
                param(
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)]
                                $Student,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)]
                                $SoftWeights
                )

                if ($null -eq $Student -or $null -eq $Student.Syllabus) {
                                Write-Warning "Cannot recalculate SimDebt: student or syllabus is missing."
                                return $null
                }

                foreach ($propertyName in @('SimStopMult', 'TransSimRatio', 'FormSimRatio')) {
                                if ($null -eq $SoftWeights.$propertyName -or $SoftWeights.$propertyName -eq '') {
                                                Write-Warning "Cannot recalculate SimDebt for '$($Student.Name)': SoftWeights.$propertyName is missing."
                                                return $null
                                }
                }

                $debt = 0.0
                foreach ($mission in $Student.Syllabus) {
                                if (-not (Test-MissionComplete $mission)) { continue }
                                $missionName = [string]$mission.Mission
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($missionName)) { continue }
                                $debt += Get-MissionSimDebtDelta -MissionName $missionName -SoftWeights $SoftWeights
                }

                $Student | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'SimDebt' -Value ([math]::Round($debt, 2)) -Force
                return $Student.SimDebt
}


# =================================================================================
#  COMPLETING EVENTS
# =================================================================================

# The one place a scheduled event is written onto a student's syllabus.
# Marks it complete with the IP name and ETD, and applies its sim debt once.
# -SortieType (or -Sortie) is the line it is flown on: an unsat that line cleans up is
# cleared, and -Sortie gets a note saying so.
function Complete-StudentMission {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Mission,
                                [string]$InstructorName,
                                $ETD,
                                $SoftWeights,
                                [string]$SortieType = '',
                                $Sortie,
                                [switch]$NoSimDebt
                )

                $entry = Find-SyllabusMission -Student $Student -Mission $Mission
                if ($null -eq $entry) { return $null }

                $wasComplete = Test-MissionComplete $entry
                $entry.IsComplete = $true
                $entry.Instructor = $InstructorName
                $dt = Parse-ETD $ETD
                $entry.ETD = if ($null -ne $dt) { $dt.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') } else { [string]$ETD }

                if (-not $wasComplete -and -not $NoSimDebt -and $null -ne $SoftWeights) {
                                $current = 0.0
                                if ($null -ne $Student.SimDebt -and [string]$Student.SimDebt -ne '') { $current = [double]$Student.SimDebt }
                                $Student.SimDebt = [math]::Round($current + (Get-MissionSimDebtDelta -MissionName ([string]$entry.Mission) -SoftWeights $SoftWeights), 2)
                }

                if ($SortieType -eq '' -and $null -ne $Sortie) { $SortieType = [string]$Sortie.SortieType }
                if ($SortieType -ne '') {
                                $cleared = Clear-CleanedUnsat -Student $Student -SortieType $SortieType
                                if ($null -ne $cleared -and $null -ne $Sortie) { Add-SortieNote -Sortie $Sortie -Note $cleared }
                }

                $rev = [int](Get-OptionalProperty $Student 'SyllabusRevision' 0)
                $Student | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'SyllabusRevision' -Value ($rev + 1) -Force
                return $entry
}

# Takes a completed event back off a student's syllabus (logged incomplete, or a planned
# event being re-planned) and backs out only that event's sim debt, so the SimDebt read
# from MasterData keeps any hand adjustment. Returns $true when the event was complete.
function Undo-StudentMission {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Mission,
                                $SoftWeights
                )

                # The exact syllabus entry when one is passed, else the first with that name
                $entry = $null
                foreach ($m in @($Student.Syllabus)) { if ([object]::ReferenceEquals($m, $Mission)) { $entry = $m; break } }
                if ($null -eq $entry) { $entry = Find-SyllabusMission -Student $Student -Mission $Mission }
                if ($null -eq $entry -or -not (Test-MissionComplete $entry)) { return $false }

                $entry.IsComplete = $false
                $entry.Instructor = ''
                $entry.ETD = ''
                if ($null -ne $SoftWeights) {
                                $current = 0.0
                                if ($null -ne $Student.SimDebt -and [string]$Student.SimDebt -ne '') { $current = [double]$Student.SimDebt }
                                $Student.SimDebt = [math]::Round($current - (Get-MissionSimDebtDelta -MissionName ([string]$entry.Mission) -SoftWeights $SoftWeights), 2)
                }

                $rev = [int](Get-OptionalProperty $Student 'SyllabusRevision' 0)
                $Student | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'SyllabusRevision' -Value ($rev + 1) -Force
                return $true
}

# Clears completions dated on/after a day. A previous run that scheduled these days
# wrote them as complete; they are plans, not flown events, when the days are re-built.
# Their sim debt is backed out, and an unsat that one of those planned lines cleaned up
# (its "Clears Unsat" note in -PrevSchedule) goes back on the student.
# Returns the students that changed.
function Reset-PlannedCompletions {
                param (
                                [array]$Students,
                                [datetime]$FromDate,
                                $SoftWeights,
                                [array]$PrevSchedule = @()
                )

                $changed = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                foreach ($s in @($Students)) {
                                $hit = $false
                                foreach ($m in @($s.Syllabus)) {
                                                if (-not (Test-MissionComplete $m)) { continue }
                                                $dt = Parse-ETD $m.ETD
                                                if ($null -ne $dt -and $dt.Date -ge $FromDate.Date) {
                                                                if (Undo-StudentMission -Student $s -Mission $m -SoftWeights $SoftWeights) { $hit = $true }
                                                }
                                }
                                if ($hit) { $changed.Add($s) }
                }

                foreach ($row in @($PrevSchedule)) {
                                if ($null -eq $row) { continue }
                                $dt = Parse-ETD $row.ETD
                                if ($null -eq $dt -or $dt.Date -lt $FromDate.Date) { continue }
                                $name = Get-NameText $row.Student
                                if (Test-IsSentinelStudent $name) { continue }
                                $s = Resolve-StudentByName -Students $Students -Name $name
                                if ($null -ne $s -and (Restore-PlannedUnsat -Student $s -Notes ([string]$row.Notes)) -and -not $changed.Contains($s)) { $changed.Add($s) }
                }
                return $changed.ToArray()
}


# =================================================================================
#  UNSAT EVENTS
#  Unsat sim: no flying until a re-sim. An OFT hook needs an OFT; an IFT hook can be
#  cleaned up in an OFT or an IFT. Unsat flight: no sims until a flight.
#  UnsatSimType ('OFT' / 'IFT') says which sim was hooked; unknown is treated as OFT.
# =================================================================================

function Get-UnsatSimKind {
                param ($Student)

                $type = [string](Get-OptionalProperty $Student 'UnsatSimType' '')
                if ($type -match '(?i)^\s*IFT\s*$') { return 'IFT' }
                return 'OFT'
}

# 'OFT' / 'IFT' for the student's latest completed sim event up to -Before ('' if none).
# MasterData only holds UnsatSim TRUE/FALSE, so this stands in for the hooked sim.
function Get-LastSimType {
                param (
                                $Student,
                                [datetime]$Before = (Get-Date)
                )

                $last = $null
                $lastStart = $null
                foreach ($m in @($Student.Syllabus)) {
                                if (-not (Test-MissionComplete $m)) { continue }
                                $start = Parse-ETD $m.ETD
                                if ($null -eq $start -or $start -gt $Before) { continue }
                                if ((Get-MissionKind -Mission $m -InstructorName (Get-NameText $m.Instructor)) -ne 'Sim') { continue }
                                if ($null -eq $lastStart -or $start -gt $lastStart) { $last = $m; $lastStart = $start }
                }
                if ($null -eq $last) { return '' }
                $type = ([string]$last.Type).Trim().ToUpperInvariant()
                if ($type -in @('OFT', 'IFT')) { return $type }
                return ''
}

# Clears the unsat a line of -SortieType cleans up. Returns the note for that line, or $null.
function Clear-CleanedUnsat {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [string]$SortieType
                )

                if (Test-IsSimSortieType $SortieType) {
                                if (-not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatSim)) { return $null }
                                $kind = Get-UnsatSimKind $Student
                                if ($kind -eq 'OFT' -and $SortieType -notlike '*OFT*') { return $null }
                                $Student.UnsatSim = $false
                                return "Clears Unsat Sim ($kind)"
                }
                if (-not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatFlight)) { return $null }
                $Student.UnsatFlight = $false
                return 'Clears Unsat Flight'
}

# Puts an unsat back on the student when the planned line that cleared it is re-planned.
# Returns $true when a flag was set.
function Restore-PlannedUnsat {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [string]$Notes
                )

                $hit = $false
                if ($Notes -match 'Clears Unsat Sim \((OFT|IFT)\)' -and -not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatSim)) {
                                $Student | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'UnsatSim' -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
                                $Student | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'UnsatSimType' -NotePropertyValue $Matches[1].ToUpperInvariant() -Force
                                $hit = $true
                }
                if ($Notes -match 'Clears Unsat Flight' -and -not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $Student.UnsatFlight)) {
                                $Student | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'UnsatFlight' -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
                                $hit = $true
                }
                return $hit
}


# =================================================================================
#  RESERVATIONS
#  A hardcoded (pinned) line that has not been processed yet holds the student's
#  time so earlier lines respect it (turn time, triple turn, crew rest).
# =================================================================================

function Add-StudentReservation {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string]$LineId,
                                $ETD,
                                [string]$SortieType,
                                [string]$Mission,
                                [string]$Instructor
                )

                $start = Parse-ETD $ETD
                if ($null -eq $start) { return }
                if ($null -eq $Student.PSObject.Properties['Reservations'] -or $null -eq $Student.Reservations) {
                                $Student | Add-Member -MemberType NoteProperty -Name 'Reservations' -Value @() -Force
                }

                $kept = @($Student.Reservations | Where-Object { $_.LineId -ne $LineId })
                $kept += [PSCustomObject]@{
                                LineId     = $LineId
                                Start      = $start
                                SortieType = $SortieType
                                Mission    = $Mission
                                Instructor = $Instructor
                                IsSim      = (Test-IsSimSortieType $SortieType)
                }
                $Student.Reservations = $kept
}

function Remove-StudentReservation {
                param (
                                [Parameter(Mandatory)] $Student,
                                [string[]]$LineId
                )

                if ($null -eq $Student.PSObject.Properties['Reservations'] -or $null -eq $Student.Reservations) { return }
                $Student.Reservations = @($Student.Reservations | Where-Object { $LineId -notcontains $_.LineId })
}

function Get-ReservedMissionNames {
                param (
                                $Student,
                                [string]$ExceptLineId = ''
                )

                if ($null -eq $Student -or $null -eq $Student.PSObject.Properties['Reservations']) { return @() }
                return @($Student.Reservations |
                                Where-Object { $_.LineId -ne $ExceptLineId -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.Mission) } |
                                ForEach-Object { $_.Mission })
}


# =================================================================================
#  TIMELINE
# =================================================================================

# Every dated event a student has: completed syllabus events plus reservations,
# oldest first. -ExceptLineId leaves out the line being evaluated.
function Get-StudentTimeline {
                param (
                                $Student,
                                [string]$ExceptLineId = '',
                                [switch]$NoReservations
                )

                $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
                if ($null -eq $Student) { return }

                foreach ($m in @($Student.Syllabus)) {
                                if (-not (Test-MissionComplete $m)) { continue }
                                $start = Parse-ETD $m.ETD
                                if ($null -eq $start) { continue }
                                $ipName = Get-NameText $m.Instructor
                                $items.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                                                Start         = $start
                                                Mission       = ([string]$m.Mission).Trim()
                                                Instructor    = $ipName
                                                IsSim         = ((Get-MissionKind -Mission $m -InstructorName $ipName) -eq 'Sim')
                                                IsReservation = $false
                                                LineId        = ''
                                                SortieType    = ''
                                })
                }

                if (-not $NoReservations -and $null -ne $Student.PSObject.Properties['Reservations']) {
                                foreach ($r in @($Student.Reservations)) {
                                                if ($null -eq $r -or $r.LineId -eq $ExceptLineId) { continue }
                                                $items.Add([PSCustomObject]@{
                                                                Start         = $r.Start
                                                                Mission       = [string]$r.Mission
                                                                Instructor    = [string]$r.Instructor
                                                                IsSim         = [bool]$r.IsSim
                                                                IsReservation = $true
                                                                LineId        = $r.LineId
                                                                SortieType    = $r.SortieType
                                                })
                                }
                }

                return @($items | Sort-Object -Property Start)
}


# =================================================================================
#  STRINGS AND COUNTERS (String Tracker)
#    - Each category (FT, FF, AA) is its own sequence, in mission order: FT5001, FT5002, ...
#      even when rides from another category were flown in between
#    - Non-counters are skipped, any number in a row, unless they flew the student two
#      rides in a row (strictly back to back): then they are a counter for that student
#    - One different counter between two of an IP's rides does not break that IP's string;
#      two different counters in a row end it
#    - Sims, solos and check rides (IsCheck) are left out entirely
# =================================================================================

# Walks back one ride at a time; each step is a recursive call.
# $History is newest first: $History[0] is IP1 (current ride), $History[1] is IP2, ...
# $SkippedOne is True once a different counter has been passed over since IP1's last ride.
function Measure-String {
                param ([string[]]$History, [string[]]$NonCounters, [int]$n, [bool]$SkippedOne)

                $ip = $History[$n]  # $null once we run out of rides, which answers False to everything

                # IP1 = IPn?  True: one more ride in the string, and the skip resets
                if ($ip -eq $History[0]) { return 1 + (Measure-String $History $NonCounters ($n + 1) $false) }

                # Is IPn a non-counter?  True: skip it
                if ($ip -in $NonCounters) { return Measure-String $History $NonCounters ($n + 1) $SkippedOne }

                # First different counter: look past it
                if ($null -ne $ip -and -not $SkippedOne) { return Measure-String $History $NonCounters ($n + 1) $true }

                # Second different counter in a row, or no more rides: the string ends
                return 0
}

# Length of the last ride's string. $Sorties is IP names oldest to newest: A,A,B,A,A,A -> 5
function Get-StringLength {
                param ([string[]]$Sorties, [string[]]$NonCounters = @())

                if ($Sorties.Count -eq 0) { return 0 }
                $History = $Sorties[($Sorties.Count - 1)..0]
                if ($History[0] -in $NonCounters) { return 0 }  # a non-counter's ride is not part of a string
                return 1 + (Measure-String $History $NonCounters 1 $false)
}

# Length of every string in one category's rides (IP names in mission order). A,A,B,A,A,A -> 5, 1
function Get-StringLengths {
                param ([string[]]$Sorties, [string[]]$NonCounters = @())

                # String length at each ride, counted back from that ride
                $Length = @(for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Sorties.Count; $i++) { Get-StringLength $Sorties[0..$i] $NonCounters })

                # A string is finished at a ride when that IP's next ride starts over at 1, or the IP never flies the category again
                for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Sorties.Count; $i++) {
                                if ($Length[$i] -eq 0) { continue }  # non-counter
                                $next = $null
                                for ($j = $i + 1; $j -lt $Sorties.Count; $j++) {
                                                if ($Sorties[$j] -eq $Sorties[$i]) { $next = $j; break }
                                }
                                if ($null -eq $next -or $Length[$next] -eq 1) { $Length[$i] }
                }
}

# A student's strings and counters from their syllabus and the Instructors list.
# Returns @(5-strings, 4-strings, 3-strings, 2-strings, 1-strings, counters). Strings longer than 5 count as 5-strings.
# Counters are the unique IPs who are not non-counters.
function Get-StringCounts {
                param ([array]$Syllabus, [array]$Instructors = @())

                # Completed rides with an IP in the cockpit, by category (FT5001 -> FT, 5001) and in mission order inside each
                $Flights = @(
                                $Syllabus | Where-Object {
                                                (Test-MissionComplete $_) -and
                                                -not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $_.IsCheck) -and
                                                [string]$_.Type -notlike '*Solo*' -and
                                                (Get-MissionKind -Mission $_ -InstructorName (Get-NameText $_.Instructor)) -eq 'Flight' -and
                                                -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace((Get-NameText $_.Instructor))
                                } | ForEach-Object {
                                                $null = ([string]$_.Mission).Trim() -match '^(\D*)(\d*)'
                                                [PSCustomObject]@{
                                                                Category = $Matches[1].ToUpper()
                                                                Number   = if ($Matches[2] -ne '') { [double]$Matches[2] } else { [double]::MaxValue }
                                                                ID       = Get-SyllabusSortKey $_
                                                                IP       = Get-BaseName (Get-NameText $_.Instructor)
                                                }
                                } | Sort-Object Category, Number, ID
                )

                # IPs who flew the student two rides in a row in a category (strictly back to back, not zippered)
                $BackToBack = @(
                                for ($i = 1; $i -lt $Flights.Count; $i++) {
                                                if ($Flights[$i].Category -eq $Flights[$i - 1].Category -and $Flights[$i].IP -eq $Flights[$i - 1].IP) { $Flights[$i].IP }
                                }
                )

                # Non-counters from the Instructors sheet (a blank IsCounter counts as a counter), except back-to-back ones
                $NonCounters = @(
                                $Instructors | Where-Object { -not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $_.IsCounter -Default $true) } |
                                                ForEach-Object { Get-BaseName (Get-NameText $_.Name) } |
                                                Where-Object { $_ -notin $BackToBack }
                )

                # Strings, counted inside each category
                $Strings = @{ 5 = 0; 4 = 0; 3 = 0; 2 = 0; 1 = 0 }
                foreach ($Group in ($Flights | Group-Object Category)) {
                                foreach ($Len in (Get-StringLengths ([string[]]@($Group.Group | ForEach-Object { $_.IP })) $NonCounters)) {
                                                $Strings[[Math]::Min($Len, 5)]++
                                }
                }

                $Counters = @($Flights | ForEach-Object { $_.IP } | Where-Object { $_ -notin $NonCounters } | Sort-Object -Unique).Count

                return @($Strings[5], $Strings[4], $Strings[3], $Strings[2], $Strings[1], $Counters)
}

######## ./Modules/SyllabusImport.psm1.txt ########
# SYLLABUSIMPORT.PSM1 DIRECTORY:
#             "Update Syllabi": reads a training file (the day's flying schedule or the Big
#             Board), works out which one it is, and brings each FAIS student's syllabus in
#             line with it: on the board, on their OutputSchedule tab and in their SimDebt
# Read-TrainingFile / Get-SheetBlock / ConvertTo-TrainingEtd
# Find-DailyScheduleHeadings / Read-DailyScheduleSheet / Find-BigBoardHeadings / Read-BigBoardSheet / Get-BigBoardInstructor
# ConvertTo-NameWords / ConvertTo-PersonName / Get-GivenNameMatch / Get-PersonNameMatch
# New-PersonIndex / Find-PersonMatch / Resolve-TrainingStudents / Resolve-TrainingInstructor
# Get-SyllabusUpdatePlan / Get-SyllabusTargetResult / New-SyllabusChange
# Update-SyllabusTabTargets / Invoke-SyllabusUpdate / Save-SyllabusUpdate / Format-SyllabusUpdateSummary
#
# The rules:
#  - Flying schedule (its Flying and Sims tabs): a student's line with a Line Status of CM or
#    EXEC marks its mission complete with the line's IP and ETD; INC or CX makes sure it is not
#    complete. Any other status (or none) changes nothing.
#  - Big Board: anything in an event's columns marks that event complete with the entry's IP and
#    date; nothing there makes sure it is not complete. An event FAIS has planned for later than
#    now is left alone (the Big Board can't show it yet).
#  - Only events in the student's syllabus change; every other event or column is ignored.


# What a line's status on the flying schedule means for its event
$script:CompleteStatuses = @('CM', 'EXEC')
$script:NotCompleteStatuses = @('INC', 'CX')

# Flying schedule headings (letters and digits only, lower case), best first
$script:DailyScheduleHeadings = [ordered]@{
                Student    = @('student', 'studentname')
                Mission    = @('mission', 'eventname', 'event')
                Instructor = @('instructor', 'simulatorinstructor', 'simip', 'ipname')
                ETD        = @('etd', 'starttime', 'startdatetime', 'start')
                Status     = @('linestatus', 'scheduledlinestatus')
}

# Big Board columns that describe the student rather than an event
$script:BigBoardInfoHeadings = @('track', 'org', 'organization', 'class', 'flight')


# =================================================================================
#  READING THE FILE
# =================================================================================

# Reads a training file and works out what it is. Returns
#   {Path; Kind ('DailySchedule' / 'BigBoard' / ''); Label; Day; Sheets; Events; Facts; People; Error}
# Each fact: {Student; Mission; Complete; Explicit; Status; Instructor; ETD ([datetime] or $null)}
#   Explicit is $false only for the Big Board's empty columns (they never take back an event
#   FAIS has planned for later). People: everyone the file lists, matched to students later.
function Read-TrainingFile {
                param ([string]$Path)

                $result = [PSCustomObject]@{ Path = $Path; Kind = ''; Label = ''; Day = $null; Sheets = @(); Events = @(); Facts = @(); People = @(); Error = '' }
                $fileName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName([string]$Path)
                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
                                $result.Error = "$Path was not found."
                                return $result
                }

                $book = Open-FaisWorkbookForRead -Path $Path
                try {
                                if ($null -eq $book.Package) {
                                                $result.Error = "Could not open $fileName ($($book.Error)). Pick the .xlsx file."
                                                return $result
                                }
                                $sheets = @($book.Package.Workbook.Worksheets | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.Dimension })

                                # The flying schedule: every tab with Student, Mission and Line Status columns (Flying, Sims)
                                $tabs = @(foreach ($ws in $sheets) {
                                                $headings = Find-DailyScheduleHeadings $ws
                                                if ($null -ne $headings) { Read-DailyScheduleSheet -Worksheet $ws -Headings $headings }
                                })
                                if ($tabs.Count -gt 0) {
                                                $result.Kind = 'DailySchedule'
                                                $result.Sheets = @($tabs | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
                                                $result.Facts = @($tabs | ForEach-Object { $_.Facts })
                                                $result.People = @($tabs | ForEach-Object { $_.People } | Sort-Object -Unique)
                                                $days = @($tabs | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.Day } | ForEach-Object { $_.Day })
                                                if ($days.Count -gt 0) { $result.Day = $days[0] }
                                                $result.Label = if ($null -ne $result.Day) { "Flying schedule for $($result.Day.ToString('ddd dd MMM yyyy'))" } else { 'Flying schedule' }
                                                return $result
                                }

                                foreach ($ws in $sheets) {
                                                $headings = Find-BigBoardHeadings $ws
                                                if ($null -eq $headings) { continue }
                                                $board = Read-BigBoardSheet -Worksheet $ws -Headings $headings
