                                $adams.UnsatFlightInMasterData | Should -BeFalse
                                $lee = Get-IStudent 'Lee, Ann'
                                $lee.UnsatFlight | Should -BeTrue
                                $lee.UnsatSimType | Should -Be ''
                                $lee.UnsatFlightInMasterData | Should -BeTrue
                                $adams.SimDebt | Should -Be 1.5
                }
}

Describe 'Get-PendingStudentAbsences' {
                It 'lists only the absences added this run that MasterData does not have yet, each once' {
                                $read = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = 'A'; StartTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 08:00'; EndTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 09:00'; Reason = '' }
                                $saved = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = 'A'; StartTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 10:00'; EndTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 11:00'; Reason = ''; InMasterData = $true }
                                $new = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = 'A'; StartTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 12:00'; EndTime = [datetime]'2026-03-03 13:00'; Reason = ''; InMasterData = $false }
                                $a = New-TestStudent -Name 'A' -Absences @($read, $saved, $new)
                                $pending = @(Get-PendingStudentAbsences -Students @($a, (Copy-StudentForEval $a), $null, (New-TestStudent -Name 'B')))
                                $pending.Count | Should -Be 1
                                [object]::ReferenceEquals($pending[0], $new) | Should -BeTrue
                }
}

Describe 'Add Student Absence: lines on the StudentAbsences sheet' -Skip:(-not $script:HasExcel) {
                BeforeAll {
                                function New-TAbsence {
                                                param ([string]$Student, [string]$From, [string]$To, [string]$Reason = '')
                                                return [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = $Student; StartTime = [datetime]$From; EndTime = [datetime]$To; Reason = $Reason; InMasterData = $false }
                                }
                                $script:AbsStudents = @((New-TStudentRow -Name 'Adams, Al' -Key 1), (New-TStudentRow -Name 'Brown, Bea' -Key 2))
                                $script:OldAbsence = [PSCustomObject]@{ Student = 'Adams, Al'; StartTime = '2026-03-02 08:00'; EndTime = '2026-03-02 09:00'; Reason = 'Old'; IsActive = $true }
                }

                It 'adds a line under the last one with IsActive TRUE, and IngestData gives it to the student' {
                                $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-MD.xlsx'
                                New-TMasterData -Path $md -Students $script:AbsStudents -Absences @($script:OldAbsence)
                                Add-MasterDataAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Absences @((New-TAbsence 'Brown, Bea' '2026-03-03 13:00' '2026-03-03 15:30' ' Dentist '), (New-TAbsence 'Adams, Al' '2026-03-03 22:00' '2026-03-04 06:00')) 6>$null
                                $rows = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences')
                                $rows.Count | Should -Be 3
                                $rows[0].Reason | Should -Be 'Old'
                                $rows[1].Student | Should -Be 'Brown, Bea'
                                $rows[1].Reason | Should -Be 'Dentist'
                                ConvertTo-FaisBool $rows[1].IsActive | Should -BeTrue
                                (Parse-ETD $rows[2].EndTime) | Should -Be ([datetime]'2026-03-04 06:00')
                                [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$rows[2].Reason) | Should -BeTrue

                                $ing = IngestData -excelInputPath $md -excelOutputPath (Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-Out.xlsx') 3>$null 6>$null
                                $brown = $ing.Students | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Brown, Bea' }
                                @($brown.Absences).Count | Should -Be 1
                                $brown.Absences[0].StartTime | Should -Be ([datetime]'2026-03-03 13:00')
                                $brown.Absences[0].EndTime | Should -Be ([datetime]'2026-03-03 15:30')
                                $brown.Absences[0].Reason | Should -Be 'Dentist'
                                @(($ing.Students | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Adams, Al' }).Absences).Count | Should -Be 2
                }

                It 'fills in blank lines formatted ahead of time, keeping their date format' {
                                $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-Formatted.xlsx'
                                New-TMasterData -Path $md -Students $script:AbsStudents -Absences @($script:OldAbsence)
                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $md
                                $ws = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets['StudentAbsences']
                                foreach ($r in 3..6) { foreach ($c in 2..3) { $ws.Cells[$r, $c].Style.Numberformat.Format = 'd mmm yy hh:mm' } }
                                Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg
                                Add-MasterDataAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Absences @(New-TAbsence 'Brown, Bea' '2026-03-03 13:00' '2026-03-03 15:30') 6>$null
                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $md
                                try {
                                                $ws = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets['StudentAbsences']
                                                $ws.Cells[3, 1].Value | Should -Be 'Brown, Bea'
                                                $ws.Cells[3, 2].Style.Numberformat.Format | Should -Be 'd mmm yy hh:mm'
                                                $ws.Cells[4, 1].Value | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
                                }
                                finally { Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
                }

                It 'adds the sheet, with its headings, when MasterData has none' {
                                $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-NoSheet.xlsx'
                                New-TMasterData -Path $md -Students $script:AbsStudents
                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $md
                                $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets.Delete('StudentAbsences')
                                Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg
                                Add-MasterDataAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Absences @(New-TAbsence 'Adams, Al' '2026-03-03 08:00' '2026-03-03 09:00' 'Leave') 6>$null
                                $rows = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences')
                                @($rows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name) | Should -Be @('Student', 'StartTime', 'EndTime', 'Reason', 'IsActive')
                                $rows.Count | Should -Be 1
                                $rows[0].Student | Should -Be 'Adams, Al'
                }

                It 'throws, and saves nothing, when a heading IngestData reads is missing' {
                                $path = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-NoActive.xlsx'
                                @([PSCustomObject][ordered]@{ Student = 'Adams, Al'; StartTime = '2026-03-02 08:00'; EndTime = '2026-03-02 09:00' }) | Export-Excel -Path $path -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences' 3>$null
                                $before = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
                                { Add-MasterDataAbsences -MasterDataPath $path -Absences @(New-TAbsence 'Brown, Bea' '2026-03-03 13:00' '2026-03-03 14:00') 6>$null } | Should -Throw "*no 'IsActive' heading*"
                                [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path) | Should -Be $before
                }

                It 'Save-StudentAbsences saves what MasterData does not have yet and marks it saved; a missing file keeps it for Export' {
                                $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-Save.xlsx'
                                New-TMasterData -Path $md -Students $script:AbsStudents -Absences @($script:OldAbsence)
                                $a = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al'
                                $b = New-TestStudent -Name 'Brown, Bea'
                                $made = New-StudentAbsences -Students @('Adams, Al', 'Brown, Bea') -Day '2026-03-03' -From '1300' -To '0230 PM' -Reason 'Brief'
                                [void](Add-StudentAbsences -Absences $made.Absences -Students @($a, $b))

                                $r = Save-StudentAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Students @($a, $b) 6>$null
                                $r.Saved | Should -BeTrue
                                $r.Count | Should -Be 2
                                @(Get-PendingStudentAbsences -Students @($a, $b)).Count | Should -Be 0
                                @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences' | ForEach-Object { $_.Student }) | Should -Be @('Adams, Al', 'Adams, Al', 'Brown, Bea')
                                (Save-StudentAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Students @($a, $b) 6>$null).Count | Should -Be 0 -Because 'nothing is left to save'

                                $later = New-StudentAbsences -Students @('Brown, Bea') -Day '2026-03-04' -From '0800' -To '0900'
                                [void](Add-StudentAbsences -Absences $later.Absences -Students @($b))
                                $gone = Save-StudentAbsences -MasterDataPath (Join-Path $TestDrive 'nope.xlsx') -Students @($a, $b) 6>$null
                                $gone.Saved | Should -BeFalse
                                $gone.Message | Should -Be 'MasterData.xlsx was not found'
                                @(Get-PendingStudentAbsences -Students @($a, $b)).Count | Should -Be 1
                }

                It 'Export writes an absence that could not be saved before, with everything else' {
                                $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-Export-MD.xlsx'
                                $out = Join-Path $TestDrive 'Abs-Export-Out.xlsx'
                                New-TMasterData -Path $md -Students $script:AbsStudents -Absences @($script:OldAbsence)
                                $a = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done 'FI3101|2026-02-20 08:00'
                                $made = New-StudentAbsences -Students @('Adams, Al') -Day '2026-03-03' -From '1500' -To '1600' -Reason 'Medical'
                                [void](Add-StudentAbsences -Absences $made.Absences -Students @($a))
                                $fill = [PSCustomObject]@{ Schedule = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-03-03 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5001'); Students = @(Copy-StudentForEval $a) }
                                Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $fill -OutputPath $out -MasterDataPath $md 3>$null 6>$null | Should -BeTrue
                                $rows = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences')
                                $rows.Count | Should -Be 2
                                $rows[1].Reason | Should -Be 'Medical'
                                $a.Absences[0].InMasterData | Should -BeTrue
                }
}

######## ./Tests/DataUpload.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for ATIS.xlsx: Export-AtisWorkbook and its call from Export-FaisOutput
# (Modules\DataUpload.psm1). Needs ImportExcel; skipped without it.
# Day 1 is Wed 2026-10-21, day 2 is Thu 2026-10-22.

BeforeDiscovery {
                $script:NoExcel = $null -eq (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name ImportExcel)
}

BeforeAll {
                . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
                Import-FaisModules
                Import-Module ImportExcel

                $script:Day1 = Get-DaySheetName -Date ([datetime]'2026-10-21')
                $script:Day2 = Get-DaySheetName -Date ([datetime]'2026-10-22')

                # A MasterSchedule-shaped row (what ConvertTo-ExportRows returns)
                function New-AtisRow {
                                param (
                                                [string]$ETD,
                                                [string]$SortieType = 'Day Local',
                                                [string]$Instructor = 'Jones, Bob',
                                                [string]$Student = ''
                                )
                                [PSCustomObject]@{
                                                ETD        = $ETD
                                                Instructor = $Instructor
                                                SortieType = $SortieType
                                                Student    = $Student
                                                Mission    = ''
                                                Callsign   = ''
                                                Num        = ''
                                                Notes      = ''
                                }
                }

                # Students column of a tab, top to bottom
                function Get-TabStudents {
                                param ([string]$Path, [string]$Sheet)
                                return @(Import-Excel -Path $Path -WorksheetName $Sheet | ForEach-Object { $_.Student })
                }

                # Data rows (row 1 is the header) whose top border is Thick on every column
                function Get-ThickRows {
                                param ([string]$Path, [string]$Sheet)
                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $Path
                                try {
                                                $ws = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets[$Sheet]
                                                $lastCol = $ws.Dimension.End.Column
                                                return @(for ($r = 2; $r -le $ws.Dimension.End.Row; $r++) {
                                                                $thick = @(for ($c = 1; $c -le $lastCol; $c++) { $ws.Cells[$r, $c].Style.Border.Top.Style -eq [OfficeOpenXml.Style.ExcelBorderStyle]::Thick })
                                                                if ($thick -notcontains $false) { $r }
                                                })
                                }
                                finally { Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
                }

                function Get-TabNames {
                                param ([string]$Path)
                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $Path
                                try { return @($pkg.Workbook.Worksheets | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) }
                                finally { Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
                }
}

Describe 'Export-AtisWorkbook' -Skip:$script:NoExcel {
                BeforeEach {
                                $script:Path = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("FAIS_atis_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8) + '.xlsx')
                }
                AfterEach {
                                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:Path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                }

                It 'lists the flights in ETD order, then the sims in ETD order' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 13:00:00' -SortieType 'OFT' -Instructor 'SIM IP' -Student 'Sim 1300'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 09:00:00' -Student 'Flt 0900'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:45:00' -SortieType 'IFT' -Instructor 'SIM IP' -Student 'Sim 0745'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Flt 0730'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 10:15:00' -SortieType 'O&B' -Student 'Flt 1015'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @('Flt 0730', 'Flt 0900', 'Flt 1015', 'Sim 0745', 'Sim 1300')
                }

                It 'keeps the MasterSchedule order for lines at the same time' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Student 'Lead'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Student 'Wing'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Instructor 'Adams, Al' -Student 'Third'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @('Lead', 'Wing', 'Third')
                }

                It 'puts a thick border across every column between the flights and the sims, and nowhere else' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'F1'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 09:00:00' -Student 'F2'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 08:00:00' -SortieType 'OFT' -Student 'S1'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 10:00:00' -SortieType 'IFT' -Student 'S2'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                # Header, F1, F2, then S1 on row 4
                                Get-ThickRows $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @(4)
                }

                It 'draws no border on a day with only flights or only sims' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'F1'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 09:00:00' -Student 'F2'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 08:00:00' -SortieType 'OFT' -Student 'S1'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 10:00:00' -SortieType 'IFT' -Student 'S2'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-ThickRows $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
                                Get-ThickRows $script:Path $script:Day2 | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
                }

                It 'writes one tab per day with only that day''s lines, in the MasterSchedule columns' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 07:30:00' -Student 'Thu'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Wed'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-TabNames $script:Path | Should -Be @($script:Day1, $script:Day2)
                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @('Wed')
                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day2 | Should -Be @('Thu')
                                $cols = @((Import-Excel -Path $script:Path -WorksheetName $script:Day1)[0].PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
                                $cols | Should -Be @('ETD', 'Instructor', 'SortieType', 'Student', 'Mission', 'Callsign', 'Num', 'Notes')
                }

                It 'rebuilds a re-exported day (no old lines or border) and keeps the other days' {
                                $first = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Old F'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 08:00:00' -SortieType 'OFT' -Student 'Old S'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 07:30:00' -Student 'Thu'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $first -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @(New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 09:00:00' -Student 'New F') -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @('New F')
                                Get-ThickRows $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day2 | Should -Be @('Thu')
                }

                It 'keeps the day tabs in date order, with other tabs left in front' {
                                @([PSCustomObject]@{ Note = 'mine' }) | Export-Excel -Path $script:Path -WorksheetName 'Notes'
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @(New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 07:30:00' -Student 'Thu') -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @(New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Wed') -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                Get-TabNames $script:Path | Should -Be @('Notes', $script:Day1, $script:Day2)
                }

                It 'opens on the first day just exported (and only that tab is selected)' {
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @(New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Wed') -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @(New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-22 07:30:00' -Student 'Thu') -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null

                                $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $script:Path
                                try {
                                                $selected = @($pkg.Workbook.Worksheets | Where-Object { $_.View.TabSelected } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
                                                $active = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets | Where-Object { $_.Index - 1 -eq $pkg.Workbook.View.ActiveTab } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }
                                }
                                finally { Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
                                $selected | Should -Be @($script:Day2)
                                $active | Should -Be $script:Day2
                }

                It 'leaves lines with no ETD off, with a warning' {
                                $rows = @(
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -Student 'Wed'
                                                New-AtisRow -ETD '' -Student 'Nowhere'
                                )
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData $rows -FilePath $script:Path -WarningVariable warned -WarningAction SilentlyContinue 6>$null

                                Get-TabStudents $script:Path $script:Day1 | Should -Be @('Wed')
                                "$warned" | Should -Match '1 line\(s\) have no ETD'
                }

                It 'writes no file for an empty schedule' {
                                Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData @() -FilePath $script:Path 6>$null
                                Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:Path | Should -BeFalse
                }
}

Describe 'Export-FaisOutput writes ATIS' -Skip:$script:NoExcel {
                BeforeEach {
                                $script:Dir = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("FAIS_out_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
                                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $script:Dir -Force | Out-Null
                                $script:Fill = [PSCustomObject]@{
                                                Schedule = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:45' -SortieType 'IFT'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-21 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob'
                                                )
                                                Students = @()
                                }
                                # Export always writes MasterData too (nothing to change here: no students)
                                $script:MD = Join-Path $script:Dir 'MasterData.xlsx'
                                @([PSCustomObject][ordered]@{ SPKey = 1; SPName = 'Nobody, No' }) | Export-Excel -Path $script:MD -WorksheetName 'Students' 3>$null
                }
                AfterEach {
                                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script:Dir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
                }

                It 'writes ATIS.xlsx next to OutputSchedule when -AtisPath is given' {
                                $atis = Join-Path $script:Dir 'ATIS.xlsx'
                                Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $script:Fill -OutputPath (Join-Path $script:Dir 'OutputSchedule.xlsx') -MasterDataPath $script:MD -AtisPath $atis 3>$null 6>$null | Should -BeTrue

                                @(Import-Excel -Path $atis -WorksheetName $script:Day1 | ForEach-Object { $_.SortieType }) | Should -Be @('Day Local', 'IFT')
                }

                It 'skips ATIS when WriteAtis is off' {
                                $atis = Join-Path $script:Dir 'ATIS.xlsx'
                                Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $script:Fill -OutputPath (Join-Path $script:Dir 'OutputSchedule.xlsx') -MasterDataPath $script:MD -AtisPath $atis -Settings @{ WriteAtis = $false } 3>$null 6>$null | Should -BeTrue

                                Test-Path -LiteralPath $atis | Should -BeFalse
                }

                It 'writes nothing anywhere when ATIS can''t be written' {
                                $atis = Join-Path $script:Dir 'ATIS.xlsx'
                                $out = Join-Path $script:Dir 'OutputSchedule.xlsx'
                                [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($atis, 'not a workbook')
                                $mdBefore = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($script:MD)

                                Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $script:Fill -OutputPath $out -MasterDataPath $script:MD -AtisPath $atis 3>$null 6>$null | Should -BeFalse
                                Test-Path -LiteralPath $out | Should -BeFalse
                                [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($script:MD) | Should -Be $mdBefore
                                [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($atis) | Should -BeExactly 'not a workbook'
                }
}

######## ./Tests/ExcelFiles.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for Modules\ExcelFiles.psm1 (save and close workbooks before FAIS reads or writes).
# Real Excel is not needed: a fake Excel object stands in for the COM one.

BeforeAll {
    . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
    Import-FaisModules

    # A fake open workbook. -Lock holds the file open the way Excel does.
    function New-FakeWorkbook {
        param ([string]$FullName, [bool]$Saved = $true, [bool]$ReadOnly = $false, [string]$Dir = 'x', [switch]$Lock, [int]$BusyCalls = 0)
        $wb = [PSCustomObject]@{
            Name      = @(($FullName -replace '/', '\') -split '\\')[-1]
            FullName  = $FullName
            Path      = $Dir
            Saved     = $Saved
            ReadOnly  = $ReadOnly
            SaveCount = 0
            Closed    = $false
            Busy      = $BusyCalls
            Stream    = $null
        }
        if ($Lock) { $wb.Stream = [System.IO.File]::Open($FullName, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None') }
        $wb | Add-Member -MemberType ScriptMethod -Name Save -Value {
            if ($this.Busy -gt 0) {
                $this.Busy--
                $ex = New-Object System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException('busy', -2147418111)
                throw $ex
            }
            $this.SaveCount++
            $this.Saved = $true
        }
        $wb | Add-Member -MemberType ScriptMethod -Name Close -Value {
            param($save)
            $this.Closed = $true
            if ($null -ne $this.Stream) { $this.Stream.Close(); $this.Stream = $null }
        }
        return $wb
    }

    function New-FakeExcel {
        param ([array]$Workbooks)
        return [PSCustomObject]@{ Workbooks = $Workbooks }
    }

    function New-TFile {
        param ([string]$Name)
        $p = Join-Path $TestDrive $Name
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, 'x')
        return $p
    }
}

Describe 'Test-FileWritable / Wait-FileWritable' {
    It 'a missing file is writable' {
        Test-FileWritable (Join-Path $TestDrive 'nope.xlsx') | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'a file held open is not writable, and is again once released' {
        $p = New-TFile 'held.xlsx'
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($p, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        try { Test-FileWritable $p | Should -BeFalse }
        finally { $fs.Close() }
        Test-FileWritable $p | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'Wait-FileWritable gives up when the prompt says no' {
        $p = New-TFile 'held2.xlsx'
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($p, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        try { Wait-FileWritable -Path $p -Prompt { param($x) $false } | Should -BeFalse }
        finally { $fs.Close() }
    }
}

Describe 'Find-FaisOpenWorkbook' {
    It 'matches the full path, case-insensitively' {
        $p = New-TFile 'MasterData.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p.ToUpperInvariant()
        $other = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName (Join-Path $TestDrive 'Other.xlsx')
        $found = Find-FaisOpenWorkbook -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($other, $wb)) -Path $p
        [object]::ReferenceEquals($found, $wb) | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'matches a OneDrive workbook (web address) by file name' {
        $p = New-TFile 'OutputSchedule.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName 'https://d.docs.live.net/abc/Desktop/OutputSchedule.xlsx'
        $wb.Name = 'OutputSchedule.xlsx'
        $found = Find-FaisOpenWorkbook -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb)) -Path $p
        [object]::ReferenceEquals($found, $wb) | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'ignores a same-named workbook from another folder while this file is free' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Same.xlsx'
        $elsewhere = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName 'Z:\Backups\Same.xlsx'
        $elsewhere.Name = 'Same.xlsx'
        Find-FaisOpenWorkbook -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($elsewhere)) -Path $p | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'takes a same-named workbook when this file is locked (mapped drive vs UNC path)' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Mapped.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName '\\server\share\Mapped.xlsx'
        $wb.Name = 'Mapped.xlsx'
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($p, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        try {
            $found = Find-FaisOpenWorkbook -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb)) -Path $p
            [object]::ReferenceEquals($found, $wb) | Should -BeTrue
        }
        finally { $fs.Close() }
    }

    It 'no Excel means nothing found' {
        Find-FaisOpenWorkbook -ExcelApp $null -Path (New-TFile 'n.xlsx') | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
}

Describe 'Save-FaisWorkbook' {
    It 'saves a workbook with unsaved changes and keeps it open' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Dirty.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $r.WasOpen | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Saved | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $wb.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
        $wb.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Message | Should -BeExactly 'Dirty.xlsx saved in Excel.'
    }

    It 'with -Close saves, closes and waits until the file is free' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Locked.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false -Lock
        Test-FileWritable $p | Should -BeFalse
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -Close -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $r.Saved | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        $wb.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        Test-FileWritable $p | Should -BeTrue
        $r.Message | Should -BeExactly 'Locked.xlsx saved and closed in Excel.'
    }

    It 'does not save a workbook that has no changes' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Clean.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $true
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -Close -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $wb.SaveCount | Should -Be 0
        $r.Saved | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Closed | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'leaves a read-only workbook with changes open (closing would lose them)' {
        $p = New-TFile 'RO.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false -ReadOnly $true
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -Close -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $wb.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $wb.SaveCount | Should -Be 0
        $r.Message | Should -BeLike '*read-only*left it open*'
    }

    It 'retries while Excel is busy, then saves' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Busy.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false -BusyCalls 2
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $r.Saved | Should -BeTrue
        $wb.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
    }

    It 'reports (does not throw) when Excel stays busy' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Stuck.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false -BusyCalls 99
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -Close -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb))
        $r.Saved | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Message | Should -BeLike 'Could not save Stuck.xlsx in Excel: Excel is busy*'
    }

    It 'a file Excel does not have open is reported as not open' {
        $p = New-TFile 'NotOpen.xlsx'
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path $p -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @())
        $r.WasOpen | Should -BeFalse
        $r.Message | Should -BeExactly ''
    }

    It 'without Excel (or off Windows) it does nothing' {
        $r = Save-FaisWorkbook -Path (New-TFile 'NoExcel.xlsx')
        $r.WasOpen | Should -BeFalse
    }
}

Describe 'Close-FaisExcelFiles' {
    It 'saves and closes only the listed files' {
        $a = New-TFile 'A.xlsx'; $b = New-TFile 'B.xlsx'; $c = New-TFile 'C.xlsx'
        $wa = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $a -Saved $false
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $b
        $wc = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $c -Saved $false
        $res = @(Close-FaisExcelFiles -Path @($a, $b, (Join-Path $TestDrive 'missing.xlsx')) -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wa, $wb, $wc)) -Quiet)
        $res.Count | Should -Be 2
        $wa.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        $wa.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
        $wb.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        $wc.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $wc.SaveCount | Should -Be 0
    }

    It '-SaveOnly saves but keeps the workbooks open' {
        $a = New-TFile 'SA.xlsx'
        $wa = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $a -Saved $false
        [void](Close-FaisExcelFiles -Path @($a) -SaveOnly -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wa)) -Quiet)
        $wa.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
        $wa.Closed | Should -BeFalse
    }

    It '-All also closes other saved workbooks, but never one that was never saved' {
        $a = New-TFile 'AllA.xlsx'
        $wa = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $a
        $other = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName (Join-Path $TestDrive 'Budget.xlsx') -Saved $false
        $book1 = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName 'Book1' -Saved $false -Dir ''
        $book1.Name = 'Book1'
        $personal = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName 'C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Excel\XLSTART\PERSONAL.XLSB'
        $res = @(Close-FaisExcelFiles -Path @($a) -All -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wa, $other, $book1, $personal)) -Quiet)
        $personal.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        $wa.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        $other.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
        $other.Closed | Should -BeTrue
        $book1.Closed | Should -BeFalse
        @($res | Where-Object { $_.Message -like '*never been saved*' }).Count | Should -Be 1
    }

    It 'without Excel returns nothing' {
        @(Close-FaisExcelFiles -Path @((New-TFile 'q.xlsx')) -Quiet).Count | Should -Be 0
    }
}

Describe 'Request-FaisFileWritable' {
    It 'a free file is writable straight away' {
        Request-FaisFileWritable -Path (New-TFile 'free.xlsx') -Prompt { param($x) $false } | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'a file open in Excel is saved, closed, recorded for reopening and then writable' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Out.xlsx'
        $wb = New-FakeWorkbook -FullName $p -Saved $false -Lock
        $closed = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
        $ok = Request-FaisFileWritable -Path $p -Prompt { param($x) $false } -Closed $closed -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @($wb)) 6>$null
        $ok | Should -BeTrue
        $wb.SaveCount | Should -Be 1
        ($closed -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $p
    }

    It 'falls back to the prompt when something else holds the file' {
        $p = New-TFile 'Other.xlsx'
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($p, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        $script:asked = 0
        try {
            $ok = Request-FaisFileWritable -Path $p -Prompt { param($x) $script:asked++; $false } -ExcelApp (New-FakeExcel @()) 6>$null
            $ok | Should -BeFalse
            $script:asked | Should -Be 1
        }
        finally { $fs.Close() }
    }
}

######## ./Tests/Export.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for writing the schedule out one day at a time (Modules\DataUpload.psm1).
# Workbooks are built in TestDrive. Dates: Mon 2026-10-19 (past), Tue 2026-10-20 (today), Wed 2026-10-21.

BeforeAll {
    . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
    Import-FaisModules
    Import-Module ImportExcel -ErrorAction Stop 3>$null

    $script:Today = [datetime]'2026-10-20 15:00'

    function New-XR {
        param ([string]$At, [string]$Student = 'For Sale', [string]$Mission = '', [string]$IP = 'Jones, Bob', [string]$Type = 'Day Local')
        [PSCustomObject]@{ ETD = ([datetime]$At).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'); Instructor = $IP; SortieType = $Type; Student = $Student; Mission = $Mission; Callsign = 'TALON'; Num = 31; Notes = '' }
    }

    function New-Output {
        param ([string]$Name)
        $p = Join-Path $TestDrive $Name
        if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
        @(
            New-XR '2026-10-19 07:30' -Student 'Old, Ollie' -Mission 'FT5001'
            New-XR '2026-10-20 07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5001'
            New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5102'
            New-XR '2026-10-21 08:00' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -Mission 'FT5001'
        ) | Export-Excel -Path $p -WorksheetName 'MasterSchedule' 3>$null
        return $p
    }

    function New-Master {
        param ([string]$Name)
        $p = Join-Path $TestDrive $Name
        if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
        @(
            [PSCustomObject]@{ SPKey = 1; SPName = 'Adams, Al'; SimDebt = 0 }
            [PSCustomObject]@{ SPKey = 2; SPName = 'Brown, Bea'; SimDebt = 0 }
        ) | Export-Excel -Path $p -WorksheetName 'Students' 3>$null
        return $p
    }

    function New-Fill {
        param ([array]$Rows, [string[]]$Days)
        $a = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -SimDebt 2.5
        $b = New-TestStudent -Name 'Brown, Bea' -SimDebt 1
        return [PSCustomObject]@{ Schedule = $Rows; Students = @($a, $b); Days = $Days }
    }

    function Get-MSDays { param ([string]$Path) @(Import-Excel -Path $Path -WorksheetName 'MasterSchedule' | ForEach-Object { ([datetime]$_.ETD).ToString('MMdd HHmm') + ' ' + $_.Student }) -join ',' }
}

Describe 'Merge-MasterScheduleRows' {
    It 'replaces the exported days, keeps the others, and drops days before -KeepFromDay' {
        $existing = @((New-XR '2026-10-19 07:30' -Student 'Old'), (New-XR '2026-10-20 07:30' -Student 'A'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'B'))
        $new = @(New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00' -Student 'C')
        $m = @(Merge-MasterScheduleRows -Existing $existing -New $new -Days @('2026-10-21') -KeepFromDay '2026-10-20')
        (@($m | ForEach-Object { $_.Student }) -join ',') | Should -BeExactly 'A,C'
    }

    It 'with no -KeepFromDay keeps every other day' {
        $existing = @((New-XR '2026-10-19 07:30' -Student 'Old'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'B'))
        @(Merge-MasterScheduleRows -Existing $existing -New @() -Days @('2026-10-21')).Count | Should -Be 1
    }
}

Describe 'Export-FaisOutput one day at a time' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Out = New-Output 'OutputSchedule.xlsx'
        $script:MD = New-Master 'MasterData.xlsx'
        $rows = @((New-XR '2026-10-21 07:45' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -Mission 'FT5102'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00'))
        $script:Ok = Export-FaisOutput -FillResult (New-Fill $rows @('2026-10-21')) -OutputPath $script:Out -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Today $script:Today -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null
    }

    It 'reports success' {
        $script:Ok | Should -BeTrue
    }

    It 'replaces Wednesday, keeps today, and drops the past day' {
        Get-MSDays $script:Out | Should -BeExactly '1020 0730 Adams, Al,1021 0745 Brown, Bea,1021 0900 For Sale'
    }

    It 'keeps MasterSchedule first and writes the student tabs' {
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $script:Out
        try {
            $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets[1].Name | Should -BeExactly 'MasterSchedule'
            $null -ne $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets['Adams, Al'] | Should -BeTrue
        } finally { Close-ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
    }

    It 'writes SimDebt into the column headed SimDebt' {
        $s = @(Import-Excel -Path $script:MD -WorksheetName 'Students')
        ($s | Where-Object { $_.SPName -eq 'Adams, Al' }).SimDebt | Should -Be 2.5
        ($s | Where-Object { $_.SPName -eq 'Brown, Bea' }).SimDebt | Should -Be 1
        @($s[0].PSObject.Properties.Name) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly 'SPKey,SPName,SimDebt'
    }

    It 'exporting the same day again replaces it (no duplicates)' {
        $rows = @(New-XR '2026-10-21 10:00' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5102')
        [void](Export-FaisOutput -FillResult (New-Fill $rows @('2026-10-21')) -OutputPath $script:Out -Today $script:Today -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null)
        Get-MSDays $script:Out | Should -BeExactly '1020 0730 Adams, Al,1021 1000 Adams, Al'
    }

    It 'only writes rows of the exported days even if the fill held context rows' {
        $p = New-Output 'ctx.xlsx'
        $fill = New-Fill @((New-XR '2026-10-20 08:00' -Student 'Brown, Bea'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'Context, Row')) @('2026-10-20')
        [void](Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $fill -OutputPath $p -Today $script:Today -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null)
        Get-MSDays $p | Should -BeExactly '1020 0800 Brown, Bea,1021 0730 Adams, Al,1021 0800 Brown, Bea'
    }

    It 'KeepPastDays keeps that many days before today' {
        $p = New-Output 'keep.xlsx'
        [void](Export-FaisOutput -FillResult (New-Fill @(New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00') @('2026-10-21')) -OutputPath $p -Today $script:Today -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false; KeepPastDays = 1 } 6>$null 3>$null)
        Get-MSDays $p | Should -BeLike '1019 0730 Old, Ollie,*'
    }

    It 'writes a new OutputSchedule when there is none' {
        $p = Join-Path $TestDrive 'brandnew.xlsx'
        [void](Export-FaisOutput -FillResult (New-Fill @(New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00') @('2026-10-21')) -OutputPath $p -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Today $script:Today -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null)
        Get-MSDays $p | Should -BeExactly '1021 0900 For Sale'
    }

    It 'writes ATIS for the exported days only' {
        $p = New-Output 'atisout.xlsx'
        $atis = Join-Path $TestDrive 'ATIS.xlsx'
        $fill = New-Fill @((New-XR '2026-10-20 08:00' -Student 'Brown, Bea'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'Context, Row')) @('2026-10-20')
        Export-FaisOutput -FillResult $fill -OutputPath $p -MasterDataPath $script:MD -AtisPath $atis -Today $script:Today -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null | Should -BeTrue
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $atis
        try { @($pkg.Workbook.Worksheets | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly (Get-DaySheetName -Date ([datetime]'2026-10-20')) }
        finally { Close-ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave }
    }

    It 'writes nothing and returns $false when the file stays locked' {
        $p = New-Output 'locked.xlsx'
        $before = Get-MSDays $p
        $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($p, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        try {
            $ok = Export-FaisOutput -FillResult (New-Fill @(New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00') @('2026-10-21')) -OutputPath $p -MasterDataPath $script:MD -Today $script:Today -LockedPrompt { param($x) $false } -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null 2>$null
        } finally { $fs.Close() }
        $ok | Should -BeFalse
        Get-MSDays $p | Should -BeExactly $before
    }
}

Describe 'Teams day sheets' {
    It 'a re-exported day replaces its sheet instead of adding to it' {
        $dir = Join-Path $TestDrive 'teams'
        Export-DailyScheduleSheets -ScheduleData @((New-XR '2026-10-21 07:30' -Student 'A'), (New-XR '2026-10-21 08:00' -Student 'B')) -TargetFolder $dir -FileName 'Teams' 6>$null 3>$null
        Export-DailyScheduleSheets -ScheduleData @(New-XR '2026-10-21 09:00' -Student 'C') -TargetFolder $dir -FileName 'Teams' 6>$null 3>$null
        $rows = @(Import-Excel -Path (Join-Path $dir 'Teams.xlsx') -WorksheetName (Get-DaySheetName -Date ([datetime]'2026-10-21')))
        (@($rows | ForEach-Object { $_.Student }) -join ',') | Should -BeExactly 'C'
    }
}

######## ./Tests/FillSchedule.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for the fill engine: Invoke-FillSchedule, Process-HardcodedSortie,
# Pair-FormationWingman and Schedule-ReturnLeg (Modules\SchedulingEngine.psm1).
# Day 1 is Tue 2026-10-20, day 2 is Wed 2026-10-21.

BeforeAll {
                . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
                Import-FaisModules

                # Everything flown except the formation block (only FF5201 / FF5202 remain)
                $script:FormDone = @(
                                'FI3101|2026-10-10 08:00'
                                'FE3102|2026-10-11 08:00'
                                'FT5001|2026-10-12 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FT5102|2026-10-13 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FT5103|2026-10-14 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FN3201|2026-10-15 08:00'
                                'FT5104|2026-10-16 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FT5190|2026-10-17 08:00|Leech, Tom'
                )
                # Ready for the checkride: FF5201 (ID 7) and FT5190 (ID 10, IsCheck) remain on a Day Local
                $script:CheckDone = @(
                                'FI3101|2026-10-10 08:00'
                                'FE3102|2026-10-11 08:00'
                                'FT5001|2026-10-12 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FT5102|2026-10-13 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FT5103|2026-10-14 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                                'FN3201|2026-10-15 08:00'
                                'FT5104|2026-10-16 08:00|Ortiz, Sam'
                )

                function Invoke-TFill {
                                param (
                                                [array]$Schedule,
                                                [array]$Students,
                                                $Formations,
                                                [scriptblock]$OnProgress
                                )
                                if ($null -eq $Formations) { $Formations = New-TestFormations }
                                $splat = @{
                                                Schedule    = $Schedule
                                                Students    = $Students
                                                Instructors = (New-TestInstructors)
                                                SoftWeights = (New-TestSoftWeights)
                                                Formations  = $Formations
                                }
                                if ($null -ne $OnProgress) { $splat['OnProgress'] = $OnProgress }
                                $result = Invoke-FillSchedule @splat 3>$null 6>$null
                                return $result
                }

                function Get-TRow {
                                param ($Result, [string]$Id)
                                foreach ($r in $Result.Schedule) { if ([string]$r.BoardLineId -eq $Id) { return $r } }
                                return $null
                }

                function Get-TNotes {
                                param ($Row)
                                if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$Row.Notes)) { return @() }
                                return @(([string]$Row.Notes) -split '\s*\|\s*' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
                }

                function Get-TEntry {
                                param ($Student, [string]$Mission)
                                return (Find-SyllabusMission -Student $Student -Mission $Mission)
                }

                function Get-TStudent {
                                param ($Result, [string]$Name)
                                foreach ($s in $Result.Students) { if ([string]$s.Name -eq $Name) { return $s } }
                                return $null
                }

                # Completed events on one day, as 'HHmm Mission'
                function Get-TDayEvents {
                                param ($Student, [string]$Day)
                                return @($Student.Syllabus | Where-Object { $_.IsComplete -and ([string]$_.ETD).StartsWith($Day) } |
                                                Sort-Object -Property ETD | ForEach-Object { '{0} {1}' -f ([datetime]$_.ETD).ToString('HHmm'), $_.Mission })
                }

                # Everything a fill decides, as text, so two runs can be compared
                function Get-TSnapshot {
                                param ($Result)
                                $lines = foreach ($r in $Result.Schedule) {
                                                '{0}|{1}|{2}|{3}|{4}|{5}|{6}|{7}|{8}' -f $r.BoardLineId, $r.ETD, (Get-NameText $r.Instructor), (Get-NameText $r.Student), (Get-NameText $r.Mission), $r.FilledBy, $r.Callsign, $r.Num, $r.Notes
                                }
                                $studs = foreach ($s in ($Result.Students | Sort-Object -Property Name)) {
                                                '{0}|{1}|{2}' -f $s.Name, $s.SimDebt, ((@($s.Syllabus | Where-Object { $_.IsComplete } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Mission)@$($_.ETD)/$($_.Instructor)" })) -join ',')
                                }
                                $ovr = foreach ($o in $Result.Overrides) { 'OVR {0}|{1}|{2}' -f $o.LineId, $o.Student, (@($o.Violations) -join ';') }
                                return ((@($lines) + @($studs) + @($ovr) + @(($Result.Stats | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))) -join "`n")
                }

                # Mixed day: pin, engine O&B + return, formation pair (twice), For Sale, unknown pin
                function New-TMixedStudents {
                                return @(
                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Cole, Cy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-14 08:00')
                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done $script:FormDone
                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Brown, Bea' -Done $script:FormDone
                                )
                }
                function New-TMixedRows {
                                return @(
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FT5001'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 06:00' -SortieType 'O&B' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'OB1' -LinkedLineId 'RT1'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -SortieType 'O&B Return' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'RT1'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'A1'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:10' -Instructor 'Leech, Tom' -Id 'A2'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 16:30' -SortieType 'OFT' -Id 'S1'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 15:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'U1' -Student 'Nobody, Ned'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 13:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'C1'
                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 13:10' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'C2'
                                )
                }
}

Describe 'Invoke-FillSchedule' {

                Context 'pinned lines' {

                                It 'keeps a pinned student and marks the mission complete with the IP name and ETD' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FT5001')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $row = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                [object]::ReferenceEquals($row.Student, $students[0]) | Should -BeTrue
                                                Get-NameText $row.Mission | Should -Be 'FT5001'
                                                Get-NameText $row.Instructor | Should -Be 'Jones, Bob'
                                                $row.FilledBy | Should -Be 'Pin'
                                                $row.Callsign | Should -Be 'TALON'
                                                $row.Num | Should -Be 31
                                                $row.Notes | Should -BeNullOrEmpty

                                                $e = Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5001'
                                                $e.IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                                $e.Instructor | Should -BeExactly 'Jones, Bob'
                                                $e.ETD | Should -Be '2026-10-20 07:30:00'
                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 0
                                }

                                It 'resolves a pin typed as a unique last name' {
                                                $students = @(
                                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
                                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Baker, Bo' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
                                                )
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able' -Mission 'FT5001')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Student | Should -Be 'Able, Amy'
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5001').IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[1] 'FT5001').IsComplete | Should -BeFalse
                                }

                                It "gives an '(auto)' pin the best-scoring passing event, not the lowest syllabus ID" {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Chk, Carl'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:10' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'L1'
                                                )

                                                # Guard: both FF5201 (ID 7) and FT5190 (ID 10) pass on this line
                                                $probeStudent = Copy-StudentForEval $students[0]
                                                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $probeStudent -Sortie $rows[0] -Schedule $rows -Students @($probeStudent) -Instructors (New-TestInstructors) -Explain
                                                $passed = @($hr.PassedEvents | ForEach-Object { $_.Mission })
                                                $passed | Should -Contain 'FF5201'
                                                $passed | Should -Contain 'FT5190'

                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students
                                                $row = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                Get-NameText $row.Mission | Should -Be 'FT5190'
                                                $row.FilledBy | Should -Be 'Pin'
                                                @(Get-TNotes $row) | Should -Contain 'Checkride! Requires Formal'
                                                $row.Notes | Should -Not -BeLike '*OVERRIDE*'
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5190').Instructor | Should -Be 'Jones, Bob'
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FF5201').IsComplete | Should -BeFalse
                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 0
                                }

                                It "gives an '(auto)' pin the same event the engine picks on an open line" {
                                                $pinStudents = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $pinRows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Chk, Carl'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:10' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'L1'
                                                )
                                                $openStudents = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $openRows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P1'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:10' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'L1'
                                                )
                                                $pin = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $pinRows -Students $pinStudents
                                                $open = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $openRows -Students $openStudents

                                                (Get-TRow $open 'P1').FilledBy | Should -Be 'Engine'
                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $open 'P1').Student | Should -Be 'Chk, Carl'
                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $pin 'P1').Mission | Should -Be (Get-NameText (Get-TRow $open 'P1').Mission)
                                }

                                It "treats an empty-string pin mission like '(auto)'" {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:30' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission '')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Mission | Should -Be 'FT5001'
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5001').IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 0
                                }

                                It "skips events that fail event-level rules for an '(auto)' pin (checkride with a non-Check IP)" {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Chk, Carl'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:10' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'L1'
                                                )
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p1 = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                Get-NameText $p1.Mission | Should -Be 'FF5201'
                                                $p1.Callsign | Should -Be 'HAZE'
                                                $p1.Num | Should -Be 11
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain 'Wingman: DS'
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain 'Direct Support Required'
                                                $p1.Notes | Should -Not -BeLike '*OVERRIDE*'

                                                $l1 = Get-TRow $r 'L1'
                                                $l1.Student | Should -Be 'Need Form SP'
                                                $l1.FilledBy | Should -Be 'DS'
                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 0
                                }

                                It "falls back to the first event and flags it when no event passes for an '(auto)' pin" {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Chk, Carl')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p1 = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                Get-NameText $p1.Mission | Should -Be 'FF5201'
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain 'Wingman: none found'
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain 'OVERRIDE: No open Day Local line within 22 min for a wingman/DS'
                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 1
                                                @($r.Overrides[0].Violations) | Should -Be @('No open Day Local line within 22 min for a wingman/DS')
                                }

                                It 'keeps an explicit pinned mission that is not eligible, with an OVERRIDE note and an Overrides entry' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FT5103')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p1 = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                Get-NameText $p1.Mission | Should -Be 'FT5103'
                                                $p1.FilledBy | Should -Be 'Pin'
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain "OVERRIDE: Not opted for FT5103: FT5102 isn't complete yet"
                                                @(Get-TNotes $p1) | Should -Contain 'Solo Flight'
                                                (Get-TNotes $p1)[-1] | Should -BeLike 'OVERRIDE: *'

                                                $e = Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5103'
                                                $e.IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                                $e.Instructor | Should -Be 'Lee, Ann'

                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 1
                                                $o = $r.Overrides[0]
                                                $o.LineId | Should -Be 'P1'
                                                $o.ETD | Should -Be '2026-10-20 07:00:00'
                                                $o.Student | Should -Be 'Able, Amy'
                                                @($o.Violations) | Should -Be @("Not opted for FT5103: FT5102 isn't complete yet")
                                }

                                It 'flags a pinned checkride with a non-Check IP' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Chk, Carl' -Done $script:CheckDone)
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Chk, Carl' -Mission 'FT5190')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p1 = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                Get-NameText $p1.Mission | Should -Be 'FT5190'
                                                $p1.Notes | Should -Be "OVERRIDE: Checkride needs a Check IP (Lee, Ann isn't)"
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5190').IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                }

                                It 'flags a pinned event on the wrong line type' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FE3102')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Notes | Should -Be "OVERRIDE: FE3102 isn't eligible here (Type OFT not allowed on Day Local)"
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FE3102').IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                }

                                It 'joins several hard-rule breaks into one OVERRIDE note, on both pins of a short turn' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00') -OnHold)
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P2' -Student 'Able, Amy'
                                                )
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                # P1 sees P2 as a reservation (no mission yet); P2 sees P1's completed FT5001
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Notes | Should -Be 'OVERRIDE: Student is on hold; Turn time 2.0 hr < 3.25 hr minimum (vs 0900)'
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'P2').Notes | Should -Be 'OVERRIDE: Student is on hold; Turn time 2.0 hr < 3.25 hr minimum (vs 0700 FT5001)'
                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Mission | Should -Be 'FT5001'
                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'P2').Mission | Should -Be 'FT5102'

                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 2
                                                @($r.Overrides | ForEach-Object { $_.LineId }) | Should -Be @('P1', 'P2')
                                                @($r.Overrides[1].Violations) | Should -Be @('Student is on hold', 'Turn time 2.0 hr < 3.25 hr minimum (vs 0700 FT5001)')
                                                $r.Stats.Overrides | Should -Be 2
                                }

                                It 'flags an unknown pinned student, keeps the line, and logs it' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 12:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P3' -Student 'Nobody, Ned' -Mission 'FT5001')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p3 = Get-TRow $r 'P3'
                                                $p3.Student | Should -Be 'Nobody, Ned'
                                                $p3.FilledBy | Should -Be 'Pin'
                                                $p3.Notes | Should -Be "OVERRIDE: student 'Nobody, Ned' not found in MasterData"
                                                (Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5001').IsComplete | Should -BeFalse

                                                @($r.Overrides) | Should -HaveCount 1
                                                $r.Overrides[0].Student | Should -Be 'Nobody, Ned'
                                                $r.Overrides[0].LineId | Should -Be 'P3'
                                                @($r.Overrides[0].Violations) | Should -Be @("student 'Nobody, Ned' not found in MasterData")
                                                @($r.Log) | Should -Contain "Pinned student 'Nobody, Ned' on 2026-10-20 12:00:00 not found in MasterData"
                                }

                                It 'flags a pinned mission that is not in the syllabus and keeps the typed mission text' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FX9999')
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                $p1 = Get-TRow $r 'P1'
                                                $p1.Mission | Should -Be 'FX9999'
                                                $p1.Notes | Should -BeLike "OVERRIDE: FX9999 isn't in Able, Amy's syllabus*"
                                                @($r.Overrides[0].Violations) | Should -Contain "FX9999 isn't in Able, Amy's syllabus"
                                                $students[0].SimDebt | Should -Be 0
                                }

                                It 'flags the same mission pinned on two lines and applies its SimDebt once' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'P1' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FT5001'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 11:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P2' -Student 'Able, Amy' -Mission 'FT5001'
                                                )
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                (Get-TRow $r 'P1').Notes | Should -Be "OVERRIDE: FT5001 isn't eligible here (already pinned on another line)"
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'P2').Notes | Should -Be "OVERRIDE: Not opted for FT5001: already complete"
                                                $students[0].SimDebt | Should -Be 1
                                }
                }

                Context 'engine picks and reservations' {

                                It 'marks engine picks complete so no student gets a turn under 3.25 hr (old $SelectedMission bug)' {
                                                $students = @(
                                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
                                                                New-TestStudent -Name 'Baker, Bo' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-14 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-10-15 08:00|Jones, Bob')
                                                )
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'L1'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:30' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'L2'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:30' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'L3'
                                                )
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                (Get-TRow $r 'L1').FilledBy | Should -Be 'Engine'
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'L2').FilledBy | Should -Be 'Engine'
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'L3').Student | Should -Be 'For Sale'
                                                @(Get-TDayEvents $students[0] '2026-10-20') | Should -HaveCount 1
                                                @(Get-TDayEvents $students[1] '2026-10-20') | Should -HaveCount 1

                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'L1').Student | Should -Be 'Able, Amy'
                                                $e = Get-TEntry $students[0] 'FT5001'
                                                $e.IsComplete | Should -BeTrue
                                                $e.Instructor | Should -Be 'Jones, Bob'
                                                $e.ETD | Should -Be '2026-10-20 07:30:00'

                                                # The completed pick is what the hard rules now see
                                                $probe = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:30' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'PX'
                                                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $students[0] -Sortie $probe -Instructors (New-TestInstructors) -Explain
                                                @($hr.Violations | ForEach-Object { $_.Message }) | Should -Contain 'Turn time 2.0 hr < 3.25 hr minimum (vs 0730 FT5001)'
                                }

                                It 'does not triple-turn a student the engine already scheduled twice' {
                                                $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Able, Amy' -Done @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'))
                                                $rows = @(
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'L1'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 10:30' -SortieType 'OFT' -Id 'L2'
                                                                New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 14:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'L3'
                                                )
                                                $r = Invoke-TFill -Schedule $rows -Students $students

                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'L1').Mission | Should -Be 'FT5001'
                                                Get-NameText (Get-TRow $r 'L2').Mission | Should -Be 'FE3102'
                                                (Get-TRow $r 'L3').Student | Should -Be 'For Sale'
                                                @(Get-TDayEvents $students[0] '2026-10-20') | Should -Be @('0700 FT5001', '1030 FE3102')

                                                $probe = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 14:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'PX'
                                                $hr = Test-HardRules -Student $students[0] -Sortie $probe -Instructors (New-TestInstructors) -Explain
                                                @($hr.Violations | ForEach-Object { $_.Message }) | Should -Contain 'Already has 2 events today (0700 FT5001, 1030 FE3102) - triple turn'
                                }

                                It 'lets a LATER pinned line block an earlier fill that would break turn time' {
                                                # Control: without the pin the student gets the 0800 line
