Describe 'HardRules legacy wrapper' {
                It 'exists and keeps the legacy bool result and side effects (OptedEvents, Sortie.Mission, PendingNote)' {
                                Get-Command -Name 'HardRules' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Should -Not -BeNullOrEmpty -Because 'the plan keeps a HardRules wrapper with the legacy bool result'
                                $s = New-TestStudent -Name 'A' -Done 'FI3101|2026-02-23 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-02-24 08:00|Jones, Bob', 'FT5102|2026-02-25 08:00|Jones, Bob'
                                $row = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-03-03 08:00' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann'
                                $row.Instructor = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $script:IPs -Instructor $row.Instructor
                                $ok = HardRules -Student $s -Sortie $row -Schedule @($row) -Students @($s) -FormLookAhead 22
                                $ok | Should -BeTrue
                                Get-MissionNames $s.OptedEvents | Should -Be @('FT5103')
                                (Get-NameText $row.Mission) | Should -Be 'FT5103'
                                $s.PendingNote | Should -Be 'Solo Flight | Need IP in Continuity to Brief'
                }
}

######## ./Tests/Invoke-SelfTest.ps1.txt ########
# FAIS self-test for the Windows machine. Needs no Pester and touches no real files.
#
#   powershell.exe -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Tests\Invoke-SelfTest.ps1
#
# Checks, under the real Windows PowerShell 5.1:
#   - the scheduling engine, board model and placement checks (synthetic students)
#   - Excel round trip through ImportExcel (temp files only), when ImportExcel is installed:
#     MasterSchedule + student tabs, the Schedule sheet reader, exporting one day at a time
#   - the puck board: the XAML loads, every template builds, and the real window is driven
#     off-screen through pin / move / undo / ETD / fill / export (a window may flash briefly)
# Exit code 0 = everything passed. -SkipWindow skips the window part.
param (
    [switch]$SkipWindow
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Fixtures\New-FaisTestData.ps1')
Import-FaisModules -IncludeUI

$script:Passed = 0
$script:Failed = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

# Runs one check; the scriptblock's last output must be $true
function Assert-That {
    param ([string]$Name, [scriptblock]$Test)

    try {
        $out = @(& $Test)
        $ok = ($out.Count -gt 0 -and $out[$out.Count - 1] -eq $true)
    }
    catch {
        $ok = $false
        $Name = "$Name  ($($_.Exception.Message))"
    }
    if ($ok) {
        $script:Passed++
        Write-Host "  PASS  $Name" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    else {
        $script:Failed.Add($Name)
        Write-Host "  FAIL  $Name" -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}

function Get-Row {
    param ($Result, [string]$Id)
    return ($Result.Schedule | Where-Object { $_.BoardLineId -eq $Id } | Select-Object -First 1)
}

$ips = New-TestInstructors
$sw = New-TestSoftWeights
$forms = New-TestFormations
$formDone = @('FI3101|2026-10-10 08:00', 'FE3102|2026-10-11 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-10-12 08:00|Ortiz, Sam', 'FT5102|2026-10-13 08:00|Ortiz, Sam',
    'FT5103|2026-10-14 08:00|Ortiz, Sam', 'FN3201|2026-10-15 08:00')
$work = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("FAIS_selftest_" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $work -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "`nFAIS self-test  (PowerShell $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion), $([System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.GetApartmentState()))" -ForegroundColor Cyan


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`nTyping lines" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Assert-That 'ETD 730 / 7:30 / 0730L read as 07:30' {
    (ConvertTo-BoardTime '730').TotalMinutes -eq 450 -and (ConvertTo-BoardTime '7:30').TotalMinutes -eq 450 -and (ConvertTo-BoardTime '0730L').TotalMinutes -eq 450
}
Assert-That 'ETD 2500 is rejected' { $null -eq (ConvertTo-BoardTime '2500') }
Assert-That "quick entry '0730 DL, 1015 O&B, 1300 OFT x2' makes 5 lines with a linked return at 1315" {
    $q = ConvertFrom-QuickEntry -Text '0730 DL, 1015 O&B, 1300 OFT x2' -Day '2026-10-20' -Instructors $ips -Students @()
    $ob = $q.Lines | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'O&B' }
    $ret = $q.Lines | Where-Object { $_.Id -eq $ob.LinkedLineId }
    $q.Errors.Count -eq 0 -and @($q.Lines).Count -eq 5 -and $ret.SortieType -eq 'O&B Return' -and $ret.ETD.ToString('HHmm') -eq '1315'
}
Assert-That "'0900 DL Lee' picks Lee, Ann (not Leech, Tom)" {
    (ConvertFrom-QuickEntry -Text '0900 DL Lee' -Day '2026-10-20' -Instructors $ips -Students @()).Lines[0].Instructor -eq 'Lee, Ann'
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`nHard rules and scoring" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Assert-That 'turn time message' {
    $s = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-10-20 07:30|Jones, Bob'
    $row = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob'
    $r = Test-HardRules -Student $s -Sortie $row -Students @($s) -Instructors $ips -Explain
    @($r.Violations | ForEach-Object { $_.Message }) -contains 'Turn time 1.5 hr < 3.25 hr minimum (vs 0730 FT5001)'
}
Assert-That '-Explain lists every broken rule (hold + turn time)' {
    $s = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -OnHold -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-10-20 07:30|Jones, Bob'
    $row = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob'
    $codes = @((Test-HardRules -Student $s -Sortie $row -Students @($s) -Instructors $ips -Explain).Violations | ForEach-Object { $_.Rule })
    ($codes -contains 'ON_HOLD') -and ($codes -contains 'TURN_TIME')
}
Assert-That 'the rules do not change the student' {
    $s = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'
    $before = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $s -Depth 6
    [void](Test-HardRules -Student $s -Sortie (New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -SortieType 'O&B' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob') -Students @($s) -Instructors $ips -Explain)
    (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $s -Depth 6) -eq $before
}
Assert-That 'a non-counter IP scores Non-Counter' {
    $s = New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00', 'FT5001|2026-10-16 08:00|Jones, Bob'
    $row = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 09:00' -Instructor 'Leech, Tom'
    $row.Instructor = Resolve-SortieInstructor -Instructors $ips -Instructor $row.Instructor
    $row.Mission = Find-SyllabusMission -Student $s -Mission 'FT5102'
    (SoftRules -Student $s -Config $sw -Sortie $row -Instructors $ips -Detailed).Breakdown['Non-Counter'] -eq -15
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`nFilling the schedule" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$students = @(
    New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done $formDone
    New-TestStudent -Name 'Brown, Bea' -Done $formDone
    New-TestStudent -Name 'Cruz, Cy' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'
)
$rows = @(
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:30' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'A' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FF5201'
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:40' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann' -Id 'B'
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 07:45' -SortieType 'IFT' -Id 'S'
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 10:15' -SortieType 'O&B' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'O' -LinkedLineId 'R'
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 13:15' -SortieType 'O&B Return' -Instructor 'Ortiz, Sam' -Id 'R' -LinkedLineId 'O'
    New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 15:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'Z'
)
$copyA = @(Copy-StudentList $students)
$copyB = @(Copy-StudentList $students)
$fill = Invoke-FillSchedule -Schedule @($rows | ForEach-Object { $_.PSObject.Copy() }) -Students $copyA -Instructors $ips -SoftWeights $sw -Formations $forms 6>$null
$fill2 = Invoke-FillSchedule -Schedule @($rows | ForEach-Object { $_.PSObject.Copy() }) -Students $copyB -Instructors $ips -SoftWeights $sw -Formations $forms 6>$null

Assert-That 'the hardcoded formation lead stays and gets HAZE 11' { (Get-NameText (Get-Row $fill 'A').Student) -eq 'Adams, Al' -and (Get-Row $fill 'A').Num -eq 11 }
Assert-That 'a Day Local line becomes the wingman (HAZE 12)' { (Get-Row $fill 'B').FilledBy -eq 'Wing' -and (Get-Row $fill 'B').Num -eq 12 }
Assert-That 'the IFT line is never the wingman' { (Get-Row $fill 'S').FilledBy -notin @('Wing', 'DS') }
Assert-That 'the O&B return leg follows its O&B' {
    $o = Get-Row $fill 'O'; $r = Get-Row $fill 'R'
    ($o.FilledBy -eq 'ForSale' -and $r.FilledBy -eq 'ForSale') -or ((Get-NameText $r.Student) -eq (Get-NameText $o.Student) -and $r.FilledBy -eq 'Return')
}
Assert-That 'picked students are marked complete (no double booking)' {
    $names = @($fill.Schedule | Where-Object { $_.FilledBy -in @('Pin', 'Engine', 'Wing') } | ForEach-Object { "$(Get-NameText $_.Student)|$(Get-NameText $_.Mission)" })
    @($names | Select-Object -Unique).Count -eq $names.Count
}
Assert-That 'two runs give the same schedule' {
    $a = @($fill.Schedule | ForEach-Object { "$($_.BoardLineId)|$(Get-NameText $_.Student)|$(Get-NameText $_.Mission)|$($_.Notes)" }) -join "`n"
    $b = @($fill2.Schedule | ForEach-Object { "$($_.BoardLineId)|$(Get-NameText $_.Student)|$(Get-NameText $_.Mission)|$($_.Notes)" }) -join "`n"
    $a -eq $b
}
Assert-That 'a pin that breaks a rule is kept and flagged OVERRIDE' {
    $s = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -OnHold -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
    $r = Invoke-FillSchedule -Schedule @(New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-20 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'P' -Student 'Adams, Al') -Students $s -Instructors $ips -SoftWeights $sw 6>$null
    (Get-Row $r 'P').Notes -like '*OVERRIDE: Student is on hold*'
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host "`nBoard and placement checks" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$board = New-Board -Days '2026-10-20'
Add-BoardLine -Board $board -Line (ConvertFrom-QuickEntry -Text '0730 DL Jones, 0900 DL Lee, 1300 IFT' -Day '2026-10-20' -Instructors $ips -Students @()).Lines
$bl = @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $board -Day '2026-10-20')
[void](Set-BoardPin -Board $board -Id $bl[0].Id -Student 'Adams, Al')
$data = @{ Students = $students; Instructors = $ips; SoftWeights = $sw; Formations = $forms }
Assert-That 'a student 1.5 hr after their own pin is flagged red' {
    $a = Get-PlacementAssessment -Board $board -LineId $bl[1].Id -StudentName 'Adams, Al' -Data $data
    $a.Status -eq 'Hard' -and @($a.Violations | Where-Object { $_.Rule -eq 'TURN_TIME' }).Count -eq 1
}
Assert-That 'the pop-up text has + / - reasons' {
    $a = Get-PlacementAssessment -Board $board -LineId $bl[0].Id -StudentName 'Adams, Al' -Data $data
    @(Get-AssessmentLines $a | Where-Object { $_.Kind -eq 'Plus' -or $_.Kind -eq 'Minus' }).Count -gt 0
}
Assert-That 'IFT lines cannot be paired as a wingman' { -not (Set-FormationPair -Board $board -WingId $bl[2].Id -LeadId $bl[0].Id) }
Assert-That 'undo puts the board back' {
    $n = $board.Lines.Count
    Remove-BoardLine -Board $board -Id $bl[1].Id
    $removed = ($board.Lines.Count -eq $n - 1)
    [void](Undo-Board $board)
    $removed -and $board.Lines.Count -eq $n
}
Assert-That 'the board saves and reloads exactly' {
    Save-BoardState -Board $board -Dir $work
    $back = Open-BoardState -Dir $work -Days @('2026-10-20')
    $a = (ConvertTo-ScheduleRows -Board $board | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4)
    $b = (ConvertTo-ScheduleRows -Board $back | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4)
    $a -eq $b
}

Write-Host "`nExcel round trip (temp files)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name ImportExcel) {

    Assert-That 'MasterSchedule + student tabs are written' {

        Set-MasterScheduleFirst -FilePath $xlsx 6>$null
        Test-Path $xlsx
    }
    Assert-That "a student's tab reads back with the same completions" {
        $tab = @(Import-Excel -Path $xlsx -WorksheetName 'Adams, Al')
        $done = @($tab | Where-Object { ConvertTo-FaisBool $_.IsComplete } | ForEach-Object { $_.Mission })
        $want = @($copyA[0].Syllabus | Where-Object { Test-MissionComplete $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Mission })
        ($done -join ',') -eq ($want -join ',') -and $null -ne $tab[0].PSObject.Properties['OptingEvents']
    }
    Assert-That "a second export updates the tab in place (a hand-added column stays)" {
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $xlsx
        $ws = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets['Adams, Al']
        $ws.Cells[1, 20].Value = 'MyNotes'
        $ws.Cells[2, 20].Value = 'keep me'
        Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg
        $next = @($copyA[0].Syllabus | Where-Object { -not (Test-MissionComplete $_) })[0]
        [void](Complete-StudentMission -Student $copyA[0] -Mission $next -InstructorName 'Jones, Bob' -ETD '2026-12-01 07:30')
        Export-StudentSyllabusTabs -Students $copyA -FilePath $xlsx 6>$null
        $tab = @(Import-Excel -Path $xlsx -WorksheetName 'Adams, Al')
        $row = $tab | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq $next.Mission }
        $tab[0].MyNotes -eq 'keep me' -and (ConvertTo-FaisBool $row.IsComplete) -and $tab.Count -eq @($copyA[0].Syllabus).Count
    }
    Assert-That 'MasterSchedule reads back for the hook / incomplete menu' {
        $prev = @(DownloadPrevSchedule -Students $copyA -Instructors $ips -excelOutputPath $xlsx)
        $prev.Count -eq @($fill.Schedule).Count -and @($prev | Where-Object { $_.Student -isnot [string] -and $null -ne $_.Student }).Count -gt 0
    }
    Assert-That 'ATIS has a tab for the day: flights by ETD, then the IFT under a thick border' {
        $atis = Join-Path $work 'ATIS.xlsx'
        Export-AtisWorkbook -ScheduleData (ConvertTo-ExportRows -Schedule $fill.Schedule) -FilePath $atis 6>$null
        $sheet = Get-DaySheetName -Date ([datetime]'2026-10-20')
        $types = @(Import-Excel -Path $atis -WorksheetName $sheet | ForEach-Object { $_.SortieType })
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $atis
        $simRow = [array]::IndexOf($types, 'IFT') + 2
        $thick = $pkg.Workbook.Worksheets[$sheet].Cells[$simRow, 1].Style.Border.Top.Style -eq [OfficeOpenXml.Style.ExcelBorderStyle]::Thick
        Close-ExcelPackage -ExcelPackage $pkg -NoSave
        $types.Count -eq @($fill.Schedule).Count -and $types[$types.Count - 1] -eq 'IFT' -and $thick
    }
    $md = Join-Path $work 'MasterData.xlsx'
    Assert-That 'Schedule sheet: headings, a blank row, a date row and time-only cells all read' {
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $md -Create
        $ws = Add-Worksheet -ExcelPackage $pkg -WorksheetName 'Schedule'
        $cells = @(@('Type', 'Time', 'IP'), @('Wednesday, October 21, 2026'), @('DL', '0730', 'Jones, Bob'), @(), @('OFT', '1300'))
        for ($r = 0; $r -lt $cells.Count; $r++) { for ($c = 0; $c -lt @($cells[$r]).Count; $c++) { $ws.Cells[($r + 1), ($c + 1)].Value = $cells[$r][$c] } }
        $st = Add-Worksheet -ExcelPackage $pkg -WorksheetName 'Students'
        $st.Cells[1, 1].Value = 'SPKey'; $st.Cells[1, 2].Value = 'SPName'; $st.Cells[1, 3].Value = 'SimDebt'
        $st.Cells[2, 1].Value = 1; $st.Cells[2, 2].Value = 'Adams, Al'; $st.Cells[2, 3].Value = 0
        Close-ExcelPackage $pkg
        $read = Read-ScheduleSheet -Path $md
        $read.Error -eq '' -and @($read.Rows).Count -eq 2 -and $read.Rows[0].ETD -eq '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -and $read.Rows[1].ETD -eq '2026-10-21 13:00:00' -and $read.Rows[1].Instructor -eq 'SIM IP'
    }
    Assert-That 'exporting one day keeps the other days in MasterSchedule, and SimDebt goes to the SimDebt column' {
        $days = @($fill.Schedule | ForEach-Object { (Parse-ETD $_.ETD).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } | Sort-Object -Unique)
        $other = New-TestRow -ETD '2026-10-22 08:00' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -Mission 'FF5201'
        $ok = Export-FaisOutput -FillResult ([PSCustomObject]@{ Schedule = @($other); Students = $copyA; Days = @('2026-10-22') }) -OutputPath $xlsx -MasterDataPath $md -Today ([datetime]'2026-10-20') -Settings @{ ReopenExcel = $false } 6>$null 3>$null
        $back = @(Import-Excel -Path $xlsx -WorksheetName 'MasterSchedule' | ForEach-Object { (Parse-ETD $_.ETD).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } | Sort-Object -Unique)
        $debt = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'Students')[0].SimDebt
        $ok -and (($back -join ',') -eq ((@($days) + '2026-10-22' | Sort-Object -Unique) -join ',')) -and [double]$debt -eq [double]$copyA[0].SimDebt
    }
    Assert-That 'Add Student Absence: a line goes on the StudentAbsences sheet (added with its headings when missing), active, at the times typed' {
        $absStudent = @(Copy-StudentList $copyA)[0]
        $made = New-StudentAbsences -Students @($absStudent.Name) -Day '2026-10-21' -From '0900' -To '0130 PM' -Reason 'Dentist'
        [void](Add-StudentAbsences -Absences $made.Absences -Students @($absStudent))
        $saved = Save-StudentAbsences -MasterDataPath $md -Students @($absStudent) 6>$null
        $row = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'StudentAbsences')[0]
        $saved.Saved -and $row.Student -eq $absStudent.Name -and (Parse-ETD $row.EndTime) -eq [datetime]'2026-10-21 13:30' -and $row.Reason -eq 'Dentist' -and
            (ConvertTo-FaisBool $row.IsActive) -and @(Get-PendingStudentAbsences -Students @($absStudent)).Count -eq 0
    }
    Assert-That 'Update Syllabi: a flying schedule CM completes an event and CX takes one back, on the tab (a hand-added column stays) and in SimDebt' {
        $sched = Join-Path $work 'FlyingSchedule.xlsx'
        $upd = @(Copy-StudentList $copyA)
        $open = @($upd[0].Syllabus | Where-Object { -not (Test-MissionComplete $_) })[0].Mission
        $flown = @($upd[0].Syllabus | Where-Object { Test-MissionComplete $_ })[0].Mission
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $sched -Create
        $ws = Add-Worksheet -ExcelPackage $pkg -WorksheetName 'Flying (21-Oct-2026)'
        $cells = @(@('Line', 'ETD', 'Student', 'Mission', 'Instructor', 'Line Status'), @('1', '0730', 'Adams, Al [2d Lt]', $open, 'Jones, Bob [Maj]', 'CM'), @('2', '1000', 'Adams, Al [2d Lt]', $flown, 'Lee, Ann [Capt]', 'CX'))
        for ($r = 0; $r -lt $cells.Count; $r++) { for ($c = 0; $c -lt $cells[$r].Count; $c++) { $ws.Cells[($r + 1), ($c + 1)].Value = $cells[$r][$c] } }
        Close-ExcelPackage $pkg
        $read = Read-TrainingFile -Path $sched
        $plan = Get-SyllabusUpdatePlan -File $read -Students $upd -Instructors $ips -OutputPath $xlsx -SoftWeights $sw
        $mem = @(Invoke-SyllabusUpdate -Targets $plan.Targets -SoftWeights $sw)
        $saved = Save-SyllabusUpdate -Targets $plan.Targets -MemoryChanges $mem -OutputPath $xlsx -MasterDataPath $md -SoftWeights $sw 6>$null
        $tab = @(Import-Excel -Path $xlsx -WorksheetName 'Adams, Al')
        $a = $tab | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq $open }
        $b = $tab | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq $flown }
        $debt = @(Import-Excel -Path $md -WorksheetName 'Students')[0].SimDebt
        $read.Kind -eq 'DailySchedule' -and $saved.Saved -and @($plan.Changes).Count -eq 2 -and (ConvertTo-FaisBool $a.IsComplete) -and $a.Instructor -eq 'Jones, Bob' -and
            $a.ETD -eq '2026-10-21 07:30:00' -and -not (ConvertTo-FaisBool $b.IsComplete) -and $tab[0].MyNotes -eq 'keep me' -and [double]$debt -eq [double]$upd[0].SimDebt
    }
    Assert-That 'Update Syllabi: a Big Board is recognized, each event block read (date, IP; empty = not complete) and its First Last name matched' {
        $bb = Join-Path $work 'BigBoard.xlsx'
        $pkg = Open-ExcelPackage -Path $bb -Create
        $ws = Add-Worksheet -ExcelPackage $pkg -WorksheetName 'Big Board'
        $put = @{ C2 = 'Scheduling Aid for Organization E FLT'; B5 = 'Student Name'; C5 = 'Track'; D5 = 'Org'; F5 = 'Class'; G5 = 'BA101'; K5 = 'FT5001'; O5 = 'FT5102'
            B6 = 'Al Adams'; G6 = '07-24-2026-1500'; I6 = 'Complete'; K6 = '10-16-2026-0915'; L6 = 'Complete'; M6 = 'G'; N6 = 'Jones, Bob' }
        foreach ($k in $put.Keys) { $ws.Cells[$k].Value = $put[$k] }
        foreach ($m in @('D5:E5', 'G5:J5', 'K5:N5', 'O5:R5', 'G6:H6')) { $ws.Cells[$m].Merge = $true }
        Close-ExcelPackage $pkg
        $read = Read-TrainingFile -Path $bb
        $f = $read.Facts | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq 'FT5001' }
        $g = $read.Facts | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq 'FT5102' }
        $read.Kind -eq 'BigBoard' -and (@($read.Events) -join ',') -eq 'BA101,FT5001,FT5102' -and $f.Complete -and $f.Instructor -eq 'Jones, Bob' -and
            $f.ETD -eq [datetime]'2026-10-16 09:15' -and -not $g.Complete -and (Resolve-TrainingStudents -Names $read.People -Students $copyA).Map['Al Adams'].Name -eq 'Adams, Al'
    }
}
else {
    Write-Host "  SKIP  ImportExcel is not installed" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host "`nPuck board window" -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($SkipWindow) {
    Write-Host "  SKIP  -SkipWindow" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
elseif ([System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() -ne [System.Threading.ApartmentState]::STA) {
    $script:Failed.Add('window checks need STA: run powershell.exe -STA -File .\Tests\Invoke-SelfTest.ps1')
    Write-Host "  FAIL  window checks need STA: run powershell.exe -STA -File .\Tests\Invoke-SelfTest.ps1" -ForegroundColor Red
}
else {
    Initialize-PuckBoardAssemblies
    Assert-That 'PuckBoard.xaml loads and every template builds' {
        $root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
        [xml]$x = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'Modules\PuckBoard.xaml') -Raw -Encoding UTF8
        $w = [System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader]::Load((New-Object System.Xml.XmlNodeReader $x))
        $built = foreach ($k in @('LineRowTemplate', 'IPPuckTemplate', 'StudentPuckTemplate', 'LineHeaderTemplate')) { $null -ne $w.FindResource($k).LoadContent() }
        @($built | Where-Object { -not $_ }).Count -eq 0
    }
    $windowData = @{
        Students       = @(Copy-StudentList $students)
        Instructors    = $ips
        SoftWeights    = $sw
        Formations     = $forms
        PrevSchedule   = @()
        ScheduleSheet  = $null
    }
    $problems = @(Test-PuckBoardWindow -Data $windowData -Day '2026-10-21' -WorkDir $work)
    foreach ($p in $problems) { $script:Failed.Add("window: $p"); Write-Host "  FAIL  window: $p" -ForegroundColor Red }
    if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { $script:Passed++; Write-Host "  PASS  the board window ran pin / move / undo / ETD / type / mission / notes / checks / fill / export with no binding errors" -ForegroundColor Green }
}

######## ./Tests/OneDay.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for working one day at a time (Modules\BoardModel.psm1):
# loading a day from MasterData's Schedule sheet or the last exported schedule, tracking
# whether the sheet changed since, and filling one day with the other exported days as context.
# Dates: Tue 2026-10-20 (D1), Wed 2026-10-21 (D2), Thu 2026-10-22 (D3).

BeforeAll {
    . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
    Import-FaisModules

    $script:D1 = '2026-10-20'
    $script:D2 = '2026-10-21'
    $script:D3 = '2026-10-22'
    $script:IPs = New-TestInstructors

    # A Read-ScheduleSheet row
    function New-SR {
        param ([string]$Day, [string]$Time, [string]$Type = 'Day Local', [string]$IP = 'Jones, Bob', [string]$Student = $null, [string]$Mission = $null, [string]$Notes = $null)
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            ETD = $(if ($Day) { "$Day $($Time):00" } else { $null }); Day = $Day; Time = $Time; TimeOnly = (-not $Day)
            Instructor = $IP; SortieType = $Type; Student = $(if ($Student) { $Student } else { $null }); Mission = $(if ($Mission) { $Mission } else { $null })
            Callsign = $null; Num = $null; Notes = $(if ($Notes) { $Notes } else { $null }); SheetRow = 1
        }
    }

    # A row as DownloadPrevSchedule gives it back from the exported MasterSchedule
    function New-PR {
        param ([string]$At, [string]$Type = 'Day Local', [string]$IP = 'Jones, Bob', [string]$Student = 'For Sale', [string]$Mission = '', [string]$Notes = '', [string]$Callsign = 'TALON', $Num = 31)
        [PSCustomObject]@{ ETD = ([datetime]$At).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'); Instructor = $IP; SortieType = $Type; Student = $Student; Mission = $Mission; Callsign = $Callsign; Num = $Num; Notes = $Notes }
    }

    function Get-DayIds { param ($Board, [string]$Day) @($Board.Lines | Where-Object { $_.Day -eq $Day } | ForEach-Object { $_.Id }) }
}

Describe 'ConvertFrom-SheetRows' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Rows = @(
            New-SR $script:D1 '07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5103' -Notes 'brief 0630'
            New-SR $script:D1 '10:15' -Type 'O&B' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam'
            New-SR $script:D1 '13:15' -Type 'O&B Return' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam'
            New-SR $script:D2 '08:00'
            New-SR '' '15:00' -Type 'IFT' -IP 'SIM IP'
        )
    }

    It 'takes only the asked day' {
        $l = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D1)
        $l.Count | Should -Be 3
        @($l | Where-Object { $_.Day -ne $script:D1 }).Count | Should -Be 0
    }

    It 'adds the rows with no date onto that day with -IncludeTimeOnly' {
        $l = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D2 -IncludeTimeOnly)
        $l.Count | Should -Be 2
        ($l | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'IFT' }).ETD | Should -Be ([datetime]"$($script:D2) 15:00")
        ($l | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'IFT' }).Instructor | Should -BeExactly ''
        $script:Rows[4].ETD | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because 'the sheet rows are not changed'
    }

    It '-FromDay moves another day''s rows (or the no-date rows) onto -Day' {
        $l = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D3 -FromDay $script:D2)
        $l.Count | Should -Be 1
        $l[0].ETD | Should -Be ([datetime]"$($script:D3) 08:00")
        $n = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D3 -FromDay '')
        $n.Count | Should -Be 1
        $n[0].SortieType | Should -BeExactly 'IFT'
    }

    It 'Resolve-SheetRowDays dates the no-date rows on the day being built' {
        $r = @(Resolve-SheetRowDays -Rows $script:Rows -DefaultDay $script:D1)
        $r.Count | Should -Be 5
        $r[4].Day | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
        $r[4].ETD | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1) 15:00:00"
        $r[4].TimeOnly | Should -BeTrue
        [object]::ReferenceEquals($r[0], $script:Rows[0]) | Should -BeTrue
        $script:Rows[4].Day | Should -BeExactly ''
        @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $r -Day $script:D1).Count | Should -Be 4
    }

    It 'hardcodes students only with -KeepStudents, and links the O&B to its return' {
        $plain = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D1)
        $plain[0].Student | Should -BeExactly ''
        $kept = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Rows -Day $script:D1 -KeepStudents -KeepNotes)
        $kept[0].Student | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        $kept[0].Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5103'
        $kept[0].Notes | Should -BeExactly 'brief 0630'
        $ob = $kept | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'O&B' }
        $ret = $kept | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'O&B Return' }
        $ob.LinkedLineId | Should -BeExactly $ret.Id
        $ret.LinkedLineId | Should -BeExactly $ob.Id
    }
}

Describe 'Import-BoardDayLines' {
    It 'replaces one day only, as one undo step, and records the sheet sync' {
        $b = New-Board -Days @($script:D1, $script:D2)
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local'
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D2) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local'
        ) -NoUndo
        $keep = Get-DayIds $b $script:D2
        $before = ConvertTo-BoardSnapshot $b
        $new = @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows @((New-SR $script:D1 '08:00'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00')) -Day $script:D1)
        $r = Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Lines $new -Replace -Sync (New-SheetSyncEntry -Fingerprint 'abc')
        $r.Added | Should -Be 2
        $r.Removed | Should -Be 1
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1) | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '0800,0900'
        (Get-DayIds $b $script:D2) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly ($keep -join ',')
        $b.SheetSync[$script:D1].Fingerprint | Should -BeExactly 'abc'
        [void](Undo-Board $b)
        (ConvertTo-BoardSnapshot $b) | Should -BeExactly $before
        @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $b).Count | Should -Be 0
    }

    It 'without -Replace adds to the day, and adds a new day tab' {
        $b = New-Board -Days @($script:D1)
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local') -NoUndo
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Lines @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows @(New-SR $script:D1 '08:00') -Day $script:D1))
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1).Count | Should -Be 2
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D3 -Lines @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows @(New-SR $script:D3 '08:00') -Day $script:D3))
        ($b.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D3)"
    }

    It 'clears links that pointed at a replaced line' {
        $b = New-Board -Days @($script:D1)
        $lead = New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Student 'Adams, Al'
        $b.Lines.Add($lead)
        $wingNextDay = New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D2) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -WingOfLineId $lead.Id
        $b.Lines.Add($wingNextDay); $b.Days.Add($script:D2)
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Lines @() -Replace)
        $wingNextDay.WingOfLineId | Should -BeExactly ''
    }
}

Describe 'Sheet sync state and banner' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Sheet = @(
            New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'
            New-SR $script:D1 '08:00'
            New-SR $script:D2 '07:30'
            New-SR $script:D3 '07:30'
            New-SR '2026-10-19' '07:30'
        )
        function New-SyncBoard {
            $b = New-Board -Days @($script:D1, $script:D2)
            return $b
        }
    }

    It 'an empty board day with sheet lines is EmptyDay; a day the sheet lacks is NoSheetLines' {
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1).State | Should -BeExactly 'EmptyDay'
        (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day '2026-10-23').State | Should -BeExactly 'NoSheetLines'
    }

    It 'after loading it is InSync; a sheet change is Outdated while the day is untouched, Changed once it is edited' {
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        $st = Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Lines @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1) -Sync (New-SheetSyncEntry $st.Fingerprint))
        (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1).State | Should -BeExactly 'InSync'
        $b.SheetSync[$script:D1].BoardFingerprint | Should -BeExactly (Get-BoardDayFingerprint -Board $b -Day $script:D1)
        $edited = @($script:Sheet | ForEach-Object { $_.PSObject.Copy() })
        $edited[1].Instructor = 'Lee, Ann'
        $s2 = Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $edited -Day $script:D1
        $s2.State | Should -BeExactly 'Outdated'
        $s2.SheetCount | Should -Be 2
        $s2.BoardCount | Should -Be 2
        $line = @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1)[0]
        Set-BoardInstructor -Board $b -Id $line.Id -Name 'Ortiz, Sam'
        (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $edited -Day $script:D1).State | Should -BeExactly 'Changed'
    }

    It 'the board fingerprint sees edits but not new line ids' {
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Lines @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1))
        $fp = Get-BoardDayFingerprint -Board $b -Day $script:D1
        $b2 = New-SyncBoard
        [void](Import-BoardDayLines -Board $b2 -Day $script:D1 -Lines @(ConvertFrom-SheetRows -Rows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1))
        Get-BoardDayFingerprint -Board $b2 -Day $script:D1 | Should -BeExactly $fp
        Set-BoardLineField -Board $b2 -Id @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $b2 -Day $script:D1)[0].Id -Field 'Notes' -Value 'x'
        Get-BoardDayFingerprint -Board $b2 -Day $script:D1 | Should -Not -BeExactly $fp
        Get-BoardDayFingerprint -Board $b2 -Day '2026-10-30' | Should -BeExactly ''
    }

    It 'a day built by hand is New until the user loads or keeps it' {
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 06:00") -SortieType 'Day Local') -NoUndo
        $st = Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1
        $st.State | Should -BeExactly 'New'
        Set-BoardSheetSync -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Entry (New-SheetSyncEntry -Fingerprint $st.Fingerprint -Action 'Ignored')
        (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D1).State | Should -BeExactly 'InSync'
    }

    It 'the banner names the active day first, then other board days, then later sheet days' {
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 06:00") -SortieType 'Day Local'
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D2) 06:00") -SortieType 'Day Local'
        ) -NoUndo
        $i = Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -ActiveDay $script:D2
        $i.Day | Should -BeExactly $script:D2
        $i.State | Should -BeExactly 'New'
        $i.Text | Should -BeLike "*1 line(s) for Wed 21 Oct that are not on the board*"
        foreach ($d in @($script:D1, $script:D2)) {
            $st = Get-BoardSheetState -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Day $d
            Set-BoardSheetSync -Board $b -Day $d -Entry (New-SheetSyncEntry -Fingerprint $st.Fingerprint -Action 'Ignored')
        }
        $o = Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -ActiveDay $script:D2
        $o.State | Should -BeExactly 'OtherDay'
        $o.Day | Should -BeExactly $script:D3 -Because 'Mon 19 Oct is before the board and is not suggested'
        $o.ActionText | Should -BeExactly 'Add Thu 22 Oct to the board'
        Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -ActiveDay $script:D2 -Ignore @("$($o.Day)|$($o.Fingerprint)") | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'no sheet rows, no banner' {
        Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board (New-SyncBoard) -SheetRows @() | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'the days to add are the sheet days from the board''s first day on that are not on the board yet' {
        $add = @(Get-SheetDaysToAdd -Board (New-SyncBoard) -SheetRows $script:Sheet)
        ($add | ForEach-Object { $_.Day }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly $script:D3 -Because 'Tue and Wed are on the board and Mon 19 Oct is before it'
        $add[0].Count | Should -Be 1
        $add[0].Fingerprint | Should -BeExactly (Get-ScheduleDayFingerprint -Rows $script:Sheet -Day $script:D3)
        @(Get-SheetDaysToAdd -Board (New-SyncBoard) -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Ignore @("$($script:D3)|$($add[0].Fingerprint)")).Count | Should -Be 0
        $several = @(Get-SheetDaysToAdd -Board (New-Board -Days @('2026-10-19')) -SheetRows $script:Sheet | ForEach-Object { $_.Day })
        $several -join ',' | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2),$($script:D3)" -Because 'every later day comes, in date order'
        @(Get-SheetDaysToAdd -Board (New-SyncBoard) -SheetRows @(New-SR '' '07:30')).Count | Should -Be 0 -Because 'rows with no date go on the first day, not a day of their own'
    }

    It 'a sheet with only days before the board''s first day says why nothing loaded, while that day is empty' {
        $b = New-Board -Days @('2026-10-23')
        $i = Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -ActiveDay '2026-10-23'
        $i.State | Should -BeExactly 'PastDay'
        $i.Day | Should -BeExactly $script:D3 -Because 'the latest of the earlier days is offered'
        $i.TargetDay | Should -BeExactly '2026-10-23'
        $i.Text | Should -BeLike "*only has lines for days before Fri 23 Oct (the board's first day): 1 line(s) for Thu 22 Oct. They were not loaded."
        $i.ActionText | Should -BeExactly 'Put them on Fri 23 Oct'
        Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet -Ignore @("$($i.Day)|$($i.Fingerprint)") | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]'2026-10-23 06:00') -SortieType 'Day Local') -NoUndo
        Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board $b -SheetRows $script:Sheet | Should -BeNullOrEmpty -Because 'a first day with lines needs no explaining'
        $withLater = @($script:Sheet) + @(New-SR '2026-10-26' '07:30')
        (Get-SheetBannerInfo -Board (New-Board -Days @('2026-10-23')) -SheetRows $withLater).State | Should -BeExactly 'OtherDay' -Because 'a later sheet day is the news, not the earlier ones'
    }

    It 'the sync record is saved with the day, reopened, and dropped with the day' {
        $dir = Join-Path $TestDrive 'sync'
        $b = New-SyncBoard
        Set-BoardSheetSync -Board $b -Day $script:D1 -Entry (New-SheetSyncEntry -Fingerprint 'f1')
        Save-BoardState -Board $b -Dir $dir
        $re = Open-BoardState -Dir $dir -Days @($script:D1, $script:D2)
        $re.SheetSync[$script:D1].Fingerprint | Should -BeExactly 'f1'
        $re.SheetSync[$script:D1].Action | Should -BeExactly 'Loaded'
        @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $re) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
        Remove-BoardDay -Board $re -Day $script:D1
        @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $re).Count | Should -Be 0
        [void](Undo-Board $re)
        $re.SheetSync[$script:D1].Fingerprint | Should -BeExactly 'f1'
    }

    It 'a board file saved before sync existed still opens' {
        $dir = Join-Path $TestDrive 'oldfile'
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $dir "$($script:D1).json"), '{"SchemaVersion":1,"Day":"2026-10-20","Lines":[{"Id":"a1","ETD":"2026-10-20T07:30","SortieType":"Day Local","Instructor":"","Student":"","Mission":"","Callsign":"","Num":"","Notes":"","LinkedLineId":"","WingOfLineId":"","Source":"Manual"}]}')
        $re = Open-BoardState -Dir $dir -Days @($script:D1)
        $re.Lines.Count | Should -Be 1
        @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $re).Count | Should -Be 0
    }
}

Describe 'Loading a day from the last exported schedule' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Pub = @(
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 07:30" -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FF5201' -Notes 'Wingman: Brown, Bea' -Callsign 'HAZE' -Num 11
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 07:40" -IP 'Lee, Ann' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -Mission 'FF5201' -Notes 'Wingman to Adams, Al | Less than 3.5 hr TT' -Callsign 'HAZE' -Num 12
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 09:00" -IP 'Leech, Tom' -Notes 'No Available SP'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 10:15" -Type 'O&B' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam' -Student 'Cruz, Cy' -Mission 'FT5102'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 13:15" -Type 'O&B Return' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam' -Student 'Cruz, Cy' -Mission 'FT5103'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 13:00" -Type 'IFT' -IP 'SIM IP' -Student 'Dunn, Di' -Mission 'FN3201'
            New-PR "$($script:D3) 07:30" -Student 'Dunn, Di' -Mission 'FT5104'
        )
        $script:L = @(ConvertFrom-PublishedRows -Rows $script:Pub -Day $script:D2)
        function Get-L { param ([string]$Hhmm) $script:L | Where-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') -eq $Hhmm } }
    }

    It 'brings back that day only' {
        $script:L.Count | Should -Be 6
        @(Get-PublishedDays -Rows $script:Pub) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D2),$($script:D3)"
    }

    It 'keeps every student and mission hardcoded where they were' {
        (Get-L '0730').Student | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        (Get-L '0730').Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FF5201'
        (Get-L '1015').Student | Should -BeExactly 'Cruz, Cy'
        (Get-L '1300').Student | Should -BeExactly 'Dunn, Di'
        (Get-L '1300').Instructor | Should -BeExactly '' -Because 'SIM IP is the board''s blank sim IP'
    }

    It '-TargetDay puts the day''s lines on another day' {
        $moved = @(ConvertFrom-PublishedRows -Rows $script:Pub -Day $script:D2 -TargetDay $script:D3)
        $moved.Count | Should -Be 6
        @($moved | Where-Object { $_.Day -ne $script:D3 }).Count | Should -Be 0
    }

    It 'For Sale comes back as an open line' {
        (Get-L '0900').Student | Should -BeExactly ''
        (Get-L '0900').Instructor | Should -BeExactly 'Leech, Tom'
    }

    It 'pairs the wingman with the lead and links the O&B with its return' {
        (Get-L '0740').WingOfLineId | Should -BeExactly (Get-L '0730').Id
        (Get-L '1015').LinkedLineId | Should -BeExactly (Get-L '1315').Id
        (Get-L '1315').Student | Should -BeExactly '' -Because 'return legs follow their O&B'
    }

    It 'leaves notes and callsigns for the next fill to write' {
        @($script:L | Where-Object { $_.Notes -or $_.Callsign -or $_.Num }).Count | Should -Be 0
    }
}

Describe 'Get-PublishedContextRows' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Pub = @(
            New-PR "$($script:D1) 07:30" -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5001'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 07:30" -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FF5201' -Notes 'Wingman: Brown, Bea'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 07:40" -IP 'Lee, Ann' -Student 'Brown, Bea' -Mission 'FF5201' -Notes 'Wingman to Adams, Al | x'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 09:00" -Student 'For Sale'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 09:30" -Student 'Need Form SP'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 10:15" -Type 'O&B' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam' -Student 'Cruz, Cy' -Mission 'FT5102'
            New-PR "$($script:D2) 13:15" -Type 'O&B Return' -IP 'Ortiz, Sam' -Student 'Cruz, Cy' -Mission 'FT5103'
            New-PR "$($script:D3) 07:30" -Student 'Dunn, Di' -Mission 'FT5104'
        )
    }

    It 'takes exported days on/after -FromDay that are not being filled' {
        $c = @(Get-PublishedContextRows -Rows $script:Pub -FromDay $script:D1 -ExcludeDays @($script:D2))
        (@($c | ForEach-Object { ([datetime]$_.ETD).ToString('MMdd HHmm') }) -join ',') | Should -BeExactly '1020 0730,1022 0730'
        @(Get-PublishedContextRows -Rows $script:Pub -FromDay $script:D2 -ExcludeDays @($script:D2)).Count | Should -Be 1
    }

    It 'leaves out For Sale / direct support, blanks return legs and keeps unique ids' {
        $c = @(Get-PublishedContextRows -Rows $script:Pub -FromDay $script:D2 -ExcludeDays @($script:D3))
        $c.Count | Should -Be 4
        ($c | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'O&B Return' }).Student | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        ($c | Where-Object { $_.SortieType -eq 'O&B Return' }).Mission | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
        @($c | ForEach-Object { $_.BoardLineId } | Select-Object -Unique).Count | Should -Be 4
    }

    It 'keeps the wing pairing so the lead does not take a new wingman' {
        $c = @(Get-PublishedContextRows -Rows $script:Pub -FromDay $script:D2 -ExcludeDays @($script:D3))
        $lead = $c | Where-Object { (Get-NameText $_.Student) -eq 'Adams, Al' }
        $wing = $c | Where-Object { (Get-NameText $_.Student) -eq 'Brown, Bea' }
        $wing.WingOfLineId | Should -BeExactly $lead.BoardLineId
        $wing.Notes | Should -BeExactly 'Wingman to Adams, Al'
        $lead.Notes | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }
}

Describe 'Filling one day with the exported days as context' {
    BeforeAll {
        $script:Sw = New-TestSoftWeights
        $done = @('FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00')
        # Wednesday is already exported: Adams flies FT5001 then
        $script:Pub = @(New-PR "$($script:D2) 07:30" -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5001')
        $script:Board = New-Board -Days @($script:D1)
        $script:Open = New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 09:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob'
        Add-BoardLine -Board $script:Board -Line @($script:Open) -NoUndo

        $students = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done $done)
        $rows = @(ConvertTo-ScheduleRows -Board $script:Board -Days @($script:D1)) + @(Get-PublishedContextRows -Rows $script:Pub -FromDay $script:D1 -ExcludeDays @($script:D1))
        $fill = Invoke-FillSchedule -Schedule $rows -Students $students -Instructors $script:IPs -SoftWeights $script:Sw 6>$null
        $script:R = Split-FillResult -FillResult $fill -Days @($script:D1)

        $alone = @(New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done $done)
        $fillAlone = Invoke-FillSchedule -Schedule @(ConvertTo-ScheduleRows -Board $script:Board -Days @($script:D1)) -Students $alone -Instructors $script:IPs -SoftWeights $script:Sw 6>$null
        $script:Alone = Split-FillResult -FillResult $fillAlone -Days @($script:D1)
    }

    It 'without context the open Tuesday line would take Wednesday''s event' {
        $row = $script:Alone.Schedule[0]
        (Get-NameText $row.Student) | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        (Get-NameText $row.Mission) | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
    }

    It 'with context Tuesday does not double-book Wednesday''s event' {
        $row = $script:R.Schedule[0]
        "$(Get-NameText $row.Student)|$(Get-NameText $row.Mission)" | Should -Not -BeExactly 'Adams, Al|FT5001'
    }

    It 'the exported Wednesday line stays as it was, with no override' {
        $ctx = $script:R.Context[0]
        (Get-NameText $ctx.Student) | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        (Get-NameText $ctx.Mission) | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
        $ctx.FilledBy | Should -BeExactly 'Pin'
        @($script:R.ContextOverrides).Count | Should -Be 0
    }

    It 'the students carry Wednesday''s event, so their tabs match the exported schedule' {
        $m = $script:R.Students[0].Syllabus | Where-Object { $_.Mission -eq 'FT5001' }
        Test-MissionComplete $m | Should -BeTrue
        (Parse-ETD $m.ETD).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') | Should -BeExactly $script:D2
    }

    It 'Split-FillResult counts the filled days only' {
        $script:R.Stats.Lines | Should -Be 1
        $script:R.Stats.Pinned | Should -Be 0
        @($script:R.Schedule).Count | Should -Be 1
        @($script:R.Context).Count | Should -Be 1
        ($script:R.Days -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
    }
}

Describe 'Test-BoardReadyToFill -Days' {
    It 'only checks the days being filled' {
        $b = New-Board -Days @($script:D1, $script:D2)
        Add-BoardLine -Board $b -Line @(New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 07:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob') -NoUndo
        @(Test-BoardReadyToFill -Board $b -Instructors $script:IPs) -join '|' | Should -BeLike "*$($script:D2) has no lines*"
        @(Test-BoardReadyToFill -Board $b -Instructors $script:IPs -Days @($script:D1)).Count | Should -Be 0
    }
}

######## ./Tests/PuckBoardLogic.Tests.ps1.txt ########
# Pester 5 tests for the puck board's one-day-at-a-time logic (Modules\PuckBoard.psm1) without
# a window: the WPF-only helpers are mocked and the controls are plain objects. The real window
# is driven by Tests\Invoke-SelfTest.ps1 on Windows.
# Dates: Tue 2026-10-20 (D1), Wed 2026-10-21 (D2), Thu 2026-10-22 (D3).

BeforeAll {
    . "$PSScriptRoot/Fixtures/New-FaisTestData.ps1"
    Import-FaisModules -IncludeUI

    $script:D1 = '2026-10-20'
    $script:D2 = '2026-10-21'
    $script:D3 = '2026-10-22'

    function New-SR {
        param ([string]$Day, [string]$Time, [string]$Type = 'Day Local', [string]$IP = 'Jones, Bob', [string]$Student = $null)
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            ETD = "$Day $($Time):00"; Day = $Day; Time = $Time; TimeOnly = $false; Instructor = $IP; SortieType = $Type
            Student = $(if ($Student) { $Student } else { $null }); Mission = $null; Callsign = $null; Num = $null; Notes = $null; SheetRow = 1
        }
    }

    function New-Sheet {
        param ([array]$Rows, [string[]]$Skipped = @())
        [PSCustomObject]@{ Path = ''; Worksheet = 'Schedule'; Found = $true; Error = ''; Layout = 'test'; HeaderRow = 1; Rows = $Rows; Skipped = $Skipped; ReadAt = (Get-Date) }
    }

    # A board state with plain objects standing in for the WPF controls
    function Initialize-TestBoard {
        param ([string[]]$Days, $Sheet, [array]$PrevSchedule = @(), [string]$Active)

        $students = @(
            New-TestStudent -Name 'Adams, Al' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'
            New-TestStudent -Name 'Brown, Bea' -Done 'FI3101|2026-10-15 08:00'
        )
        $data = @{ Students = $students; Instructors = (New-TestInstructors); SoftWeights = (New-TestSoftWeights); Formations = (New-TestFormations)
            PrevSchedule = $PrevSchedule; ScheduleSheet = $Sheet; MasterDataPath = ''; OutputPath = '' }
        $board = New-Board -Days $Days
        InModuleScope PuckBoard -Parameters @{ Board = $board; Data = $data; Active = $(if ($Active) { $Active } else { $Days[0] }) } {
            param ($Board, $Data, $Active)
            $o = { param($h) [PSCustomObject]$h }
            $script:PB = @{
                Window = $null; Board = $Board; Data = $Data; Settings = (Get-DefaultBoardSettings)
                C = @{
                    SheetBanner = (& $o @{ Visibility = 'Collapsed' }); SheetBannerText = (& $o @{ Text = '' })
                    SheetBannerLoadButton = (& $o @{ Content = '' }); SheetBannerIgnoreButton = (& $o @{ Content = '' })
                    FillDayButton = (& $o @{ Content = ''; Visibility = 'Visible' }); FillAllButton = (& $o @{ Content = ''; Visibility = 'Visible' })
                    BackToEditButton = (& $o @{ Visibility = 'Collapsed' })
                    RefillButton = (& $o @{ Visibility = 'Collapsed' }); ExportButton = (& $o @{ Visibility = 'Collapsed' })
                    ModeBanner = (& $o @{ Visibility = 'Collapsed' }); ModeBannerText = (& $o @{ Text = '' })
                    StatusText = (& $o @{ Text = '' }); CountsText = (& $o @{ Text = '' })
                }
                DayColls = @{}; Assess = @{}; RowAssess = @{}; Queue = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string])
                Commands = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]); Drag = $null; Heat = $null; Mode = 'Edit'; Overlay = $null
                FillResult = $null; Result = $null; Busy = $false; Draining = $false; Filling = $false; LastFocusDay = $Active
                FillDays = @(); SheetIgnore = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]); SheetBannerInfo = $null
                SheetStamp = ''; SheetPending = ''; SheetAutoPending = $false; ActiveDay = $Active; StatusLog = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string])
                SaveTimer = (& $o @{ }); SheetTimer = (& $o @{ })
            }
            $script:PB.SheetTimer | Add-Member -MemberType ScriptMethod -Name Stop -Value { }
        }
    }

    function Get-PB { InModuleScope PuckBoard { $script:PB } }
}

Describe 'Puck board, one day at a time (no window)' {
    BeforeEach {
        # The WPF-only pieces
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBTabs { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBDay { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBPools { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Restore-PBFocus { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBFocusState { $null }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Request-PBAutosave { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Start-PBAssessQueue { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-BusyOverlay { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Hide-BusyOverlay { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Invoke-PBDoEvents { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Close-PBPopup { }
        # Mock bodies run in the test's scope; the board state lives in the module's
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBActiveDay { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { $script:PB.ActiveDay } }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Select-PBDay { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($d) $script:PB.ActiveDay = $d } $Day }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Set-PBStatus { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($t, $k) $script:PB.C.StatusText.Text = $t; $script:PB.StatusLog.Add("$k|$t") } $Text $Kind }
    }

    It 'opening the board loads the sheet onto an empty day and leaves the banner off' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00')))
        $msg = InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup }
        $pb = Get-PB
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1).Count | Should -Be 2
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].Student | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        $msg | Should -BeLike 'Loaded Tue 20 Oct (2 line(s)) from MasterData*'
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed'
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'a saved sheet change updates an untouched day by itself, but only asks for an edited one' {
        $rows = @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00'))
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet $rows)
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })

        $pb = Get-PB
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:45'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00'))
        $done = @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate })
        $done.Count | Should -Be 1
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1) | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '0745,0900'

        $l = @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1)[0]
        Set-BoardInstructor -Board $pb.Board -Id $l.Id -Name 'Lee, Ann'
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '08:00'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00'))
        @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate }).Count | Should -Be 0
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Update-PBSheetBanner }
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Visible'
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo.State | Should -BeExactly 'Changed'
        $pb.C.SheetBannerLoadButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Replace Tue 20 Oct with the sheet'
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].Instructor | Should -BeExactly 'Lee, Ann' -Because 'the edited day was not replaced'

        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetBannerLoad }
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1) | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') + ' ' + $_.Instructor }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '0800 Jones, Bob,0900 Jones, Bob'
        [void](Undo-Board $pb.Board)
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].Instructor | Should -BeExactly 'Lee, Ann' -Because 'Ctrl+Z takes the replacement back'
    }

    It 'the sheet tick reads, then auto-updates only in edit mode and when nobody is typing in a row' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })
        $pb = Get-PB
        # A MasterData file that has not changed since it was read: the tick only applies what is pending
        $md = Join-Path $TestDrive 'MasterData.xlsx'
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($md, 'x')
        $pb.Data.MasterDataPath = $md
        $pb.SheetStamp = InModuleScope PuckBoard -Parameters @{ P = $md } { param($P) Get-PBFileStamp $P }
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:40')
        $pb.SheetAutoPending = $true
        $pb.Mode = 'Review'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetTick }
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].ETD.ToString('HHmm') | Should -BeExactly '0730' -Because 'review mode waits'
        $pb.Mode = 'Edit'
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBFocusState { @{ LineId = 'x'; Tag = 'EtdBox' } }
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetTick }
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].ETD.ToString('HHmm') | Should -BeExactly '0730' -Because 'typing in a row waits'
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBFocusState { $null }
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetTick }
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].ETD.ToString('HHmm') | Should -BeExactly '0740'
        $pb.SheetAutoPending | Should -BeFalse
        $pb.C.StatusText.Text | Should -BeLike 'MasterData was saved: updated Tue 20 Oct*'
    }

    It 'opening the board gives each sheet day from the first day on a tab of its own, with its lines' {
        $rows = @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al'), (New-SR $script:D1 '09:00'), (New-SR $script:D2 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D3 '08:00'), (New-SR $script:D3 '08:30'), (New-SR '2026-10-19' '07:30'))
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet $rows)
        $msg = InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup }
        $pb = Get-PB
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2),$($script:D3)" -Because 'Mon 19 Oct is before the board and is left off'
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1).Count | Should -Be 2
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D2).Count | Should -Be 1
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D3).Count | Should -Be 2
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D1))[0].Student | Should -BeExactly 'Adams, Al'
        $msg | Should -BeLike 'Loaded Tue 20 Oct (2 line(s)), Wed 21 Oct (1 line(s)), Thu 22 Oct (2 line(s)) from MasterData*'
        $pb.ActiveDay | Should -BeExactly $script:D1 -Because 'the board stays on its first day'
        foreach ($d in @($script:D1, $script:D2, $script:D3)) { (Get-BoardSheetState -Board $pb.Board -SheetRows $rows -Day $d).State | Should -BeExactly 'InSync' }
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo | Should -BeNullOrEmpty
    }

    It 'a new day on the sheet gets its own tab when MasterData is saved' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })
        $pb = Get-PB
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '08:00'))
        $done = @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate })
        $done -join ', ' | Should -BeExactly 'Wed 21 Oct (1 line(s))'
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2)"
        $pb.ActiveDay | Should -BeExactly $script:D1 -Because 'a background update does not change the day on screen'
    }

    It 'a removed sheet day stays off when MasterData is saved, until its lines on the sheet change' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '08:00')))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })
        $pb = Get-PB
        $pb.Settings.BoardDir = $TestDrive
        $saved = Join-Path $TestDrive "$($script:D2).json"
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($saved, '{}')
        InModuleScope PuckBoard -Parameters @{ D = $script:D2 } { param($D) Remove-PBDay $D }
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
        Test-Path -LiteralPath $saved | Should -BeFalse -Because 'its autosave goes with it'
        @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate }).Count | Should -Be 0
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '08:15'))
        @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate }).Count | Should -Be 1
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2)" -Because 'the sheet changed for that day'
    }

    It 'a sheet with only days before the board says so, and can put them on the first day' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D2) -Sheet (New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30' -Student 'Adams, Al'), (New-SR $script:D1 '08:10')))
        $msg = InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup }
        $pb = Get-PB
        $msg | Should -BeExactly ''
        $pb.Board.Lines.Count | Should -Be 0
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Visible'
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo.State | Should -BeExactly 'PastDay'
        $pb.C.SheetBannerText.Text | Should -BeLike "*only has lines for days before Wed 21 Oct*2 line(s) for Tue 20 Oct. They were not loaded."
        $pb.C.SheetBannerLoadButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Put them on Wed 21 Oct'
        $pb.C.SheetBannerIgnoreButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Not now'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetBannerLoad }
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D2 -Because 'the earlier day is not added'
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $pb.Board -Day $script:D2) | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') + ' ' + $_.Student }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '0730 Adams, Al,0810 '
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed'
    }

    It '"Not now" on the earlier-days banner hides it until those lines change' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D2) -Sheet (New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })
        $pb = Get-PB
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetBannerIgnore }
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed'
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:45')
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Update-PBSheetBanner }
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo.State | Should -BeExactly 'PastDay'
    }

    It 'the banner offers a later sheet day read before the board could add it, and "Not now" hides it until that day changes' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetStartup })
        $pb = Get-PB
        # Read (in review mode, say) but not applied yet
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '07:30'))
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Update-PBSheetBanner }
        $pb.SheetBannerInfo.State | Should -BeExactly 'OtherDay'
        $pb.C.SheetBannerIgnoreButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Not now'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetBannerIgnore }
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed'
        @(InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetAutoUpdate }).Count | Should -Be 0 -Because 'a day waved off is not added by itself either'
        $pb.Data.ScheduleSheet = New-Sheet @((New-SR $script:D1 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '07:30'), (New-SR $script:D2 '08:00'))
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Update-PBSheetBanner }
        $pb.C.SheetBanner.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Visible'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBSheetBannerLoad }
        ($pb.Board.Days.ToArray() -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2)"
        $pb.ActiveDay | Should -BeExactly $script:D2 -Because 'the loaded day is brought on screen'
    }

    It 'loading an exported day puts everyone back hardcoded and reports it' {
        $pub = @(
            [PSCustomObject]@{ ETD = "$($script:D1) 07:30:00"; Instructor = 'Jones, Bob'; SortieType = 'Day Local'; Student = 'Adams, Al'; Mission = 'FT5001'; Callsign = 'TALON'; Num = 31; Notes = '' }
            [PSCustomObject]@{ ETD = "$($script:D1) 09:00:00"; Instructor = 'Lee, Ann'; SortieType = 'Day Local'; Student = 'For Sale'; Mission = ''; Callsign = 'TALON'; Num = 32; Notes = 'No Available SP' }
        )
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet $null -PrevSchedule $pub
        $res = InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBLoadDay -Source 'Exported' -SourceDay '2026-10-20' -TargetDay '2026-10-20' -Replace -KeepStudents }
        $res.Added | Should -Be 2
        $res.Students | Should -Be 1
        $pb = Get-PB
        $pb.C.StatusText.Text | Should -BeLike 'Loaded 2 line(s) onto Tue 20 Oct from the last exported schedule, 1 with students hardcoded*'
        @(Get-BoardSheetSyncDays $pb.Board).Count | Should -Be 0 -Because 'the exported schedule is not the sheet'
    }

    It 'a sheet day with unreadable rows says so when loaded' {
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @(New-SR $script:D1 '07:30') -Skipped @('row 9: no sortie type'))
        [void](InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBLoadDay -Source 'Sheet' -SourceDay '2026-10-20' -TargetDay '2026-10-20' -Replace -KeepStudents })
        $pb = Get-PB
        $pb.StatusLog[-1] | Should -BeLike 'Warn|*1 sheet row(s) could not be read*'
    }

    It '"Fill this day" fills and reviews just the day on screen, with exported days as context' {
        $pub = @([PSCustomObject]@{ ETD = "$($script:D2) 07:30:00"; Instructor = 'Jones, Bob'; SortieType = 'Day Local'; Student = 'Adams, Al'; Mission = 'FT5001'; Callsign = 'TALON'; Num = 31; Notes = '' })
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1, $script:D2) -Sheet $null -PrevSchedule $pub -Active $script:D1
        $pb = Get-PB
        Add-BoardLine -Board $pb.Board -Line @(
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 09:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob'
            New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D2) 10:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Lee, Ann'
        ) -NoUndo
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Update-PBFillScope }
        $pb.C.FillDayButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Fill Tue 20 Oct'
        $pb.C.FillAllButton.Content | Should -BeExactly 'Fill all 2 days'
        $pb.C.FillAllButton.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Visible'

        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBFill -Scope Day } 6>$null
        $pb.Mode | Should -BeExactly 'Review'
        ($pb.FillDays -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D1
        @($pb.FillResult.Schedule).Count | Should -Be 1
        @($pb.FillResult.Context).Count | Should -Be 1 -Because 'the exported Wednesday rode along'
        $row = $pb.FillResult.Schedule[0]
        "$(Get-NameText $row.Student)|$(Get-NameText $row.Mission)" | Should -Not -BeExactly 'Adams, Al|FT5001'
        $pb.C.ModeBannerText.Text | Should -BeLike 'REVIEW (Tue 20 Oct)*Export writes Tue 20 Oct*'
        $pb.C.FillDayButton.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed' -Because 'both fill buttons hide while reviewing'
        $pb.C.FillAllButton.Visibility | Should -BeExactly 'Collapsed'

        # Re-fill repeats the same day even after switching tabs
        $pb.ActiveDay = $script:D2
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBFill -Refill } 6>$null
        ($pb.FillDays -join ',') | Should -BeExactly $script:D1

        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Exit-PBReview }
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Invoke-PBFill -Scope All } 6>$null
        ($pb.FillDays -join ',') | Should -BeExactly "$($script:D1),$($script:D2)"
        @($pb.FillResult.Context).Count | Should -Be 0 -Because 'Wednesday is filled now, not context'
    }

    It 'Format-PBDays names one day or a range' {
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Format-PBDays @('2026-10-21') } | Should -BeExactly 'Wed 21 Oct'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Format-PBDays @('2026-10-22', '2026-10-20', '2026-10-21') } | Should -BeExactly 'Tue 20 Oct - Thu 22 Oct (3 days)'
        InModuleScope PuckBoard { Format-PBDays @() } | Should -BeExactly 'no days'
    }
}


Describe 'Puck board: missions picked by hand, Add Bulk Lines, Update Syllabi (no window)' {
    BeforeEach {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBTabs { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBDay { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBPools { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Restore-PBFocus { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBFocusState { $null }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Request-PBAutosave { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Start-PBAssessQueue { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Close-PBPopup { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBPlacementPopup { }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Get-PBActiveDay { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { $script:PB.ActiveDay } }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Set-PBStatus { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($t, $k) $script:PB.C.StatusText.Text = $t; $script:PB.StatusLog.Add("$k|$t") } $Text $Kind }
        Clear-AssessmentCache

        # Adams has flown FI3101 only: opted for FT5001 (Day Local) and FE3102 (OFT), not FT5102
        Initialize-TestBoard -Days @($script:D1) -Sheet (New-Sheet @())
        $script:Board = (Get-PB).Board
        Add-BoardLine -Board $script:Board -Line @(New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 07:30") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Id 'L1') -NoUndo

        function Invoke-Choose {
            param ([string]$Choice)
            & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($c) Invoke-PBChooseMission -LineId 'L1' -Choice $c } $Choice
        }
        function Get-L1Mission { [string](Get-BoardLine $script:Board 'L1').Mission }
        function Get-LastStatus { @((Get-PB).StatusLog)[-1] }
    }

    It 'a mission the student is not opted for: Yes puts the recommended mission on instead' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { 'Yes' }
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5102 (not opted)'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter {
            $Title -eq 'Check the mission for Adams, Al' -and $Buttons -eq 'YesNoCancel' -and $Text -like "Adams, Al isn't opted for FT5102.*Not opted for FT5102: FT5001 isn't complete yet*"
        }
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly '|Mission set to FT5001.'
    }

    It 'No keeps the mission the user picked, flagged' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { 'No' }
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5102 (not opted)'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5102'
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly 'Warn|FT5102 kept - it is flagged OVERRIDE on the output.'
        $a = Get-PlacementAssessment -Board $script:Board -LineId 'L1' -StudentName 'Adams, Al' -MissionName 'FT5102' -Data (Get-PB).Data
        $a.Status | Should -BeExactly 'Hard'
        @($a.Violations | ForEach-Object { $_.Rule }) | Should -Contain 'NOT_OPTED'
    }

    It 'Cancel changes nothing' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { 'Cancel' }
        $v = $script:Board.Version
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5102 (not opted)'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly ''
        $script:Board.Version | Should -Be $v
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly '|Mission left as it was.'
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Update-PBDay -Times 1 -Because 'the dropdown is put back'
    }

    It 'the right mission goes straight on, no questions' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { throw 'should not ask' }
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5001'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
        Invoke-Choose '(auto)'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly ''
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage -Times 0 -Exactly
    }

    It 'Type a mission...: takes what is typed, in the syllabus spelling' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Read-PBText { ' ft5001 ' }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { throw 'should not ask' }
        Invoke-Choose 'Type a mission...'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
    }

    It 'Type a mission...: a mission not in the syllabus is explained, and kept on No' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Read-PBText { 'XX1234' }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { 'No' }
        Invoke-Choose 'Type a mission...'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'XX1234'
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $Text -like "XX1234 isn't in Adams, Al's syllabus.*Yes = put FT5001 on the line*" }
    }

    It 'Type a mission...: cancelling the prompt changes nothing' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Read-PBText { '' }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { throw 'should not ask' }
        $v = $script:Board.Version
        Invoke-Choose 'Type a mission...'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly ''
        $script:Board.Version | Should -Be $v
    }

    It 'the dropdown lists the missions the student is not opted for, once the line is checked' {
        $texts = @(& (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($b) Get-PBMissionChoices (Get-BoardLine $b 'L1') } $script:Board)
        ($texts -join '|') | Should -BeExactly '(auto)|FT5001|Type a mission...' -Because 'until the check is in, only MasterData''s opted events'
        & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($b) $script:PB.Assess['L1'] = Get-PlacementAssessment -Board $b -LineId 'L1' -StudentName 'Adams, Al' -Data $script:PB.Data } $script:Board
        $texts = @(& (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($b) Get-PBMissionChoices (Get-BoardLine $b 'L1') } $script:Board)
        $texts[0] | Should -BeExactly '(auto)'
        $texts[1] | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
        $texts | Should -Contain 'FT5102 (not opted)'
        $texts[-1] | Should -BeExactly 'Type a mission...'
    }

    It 'a pick in the dropdown becomes a command only when it changes something: <Why>' -TestCases @(
        @{ Why = '(auto) on an (auto) line'; Value = '(auto)'; Raw = ''; Enabled = $true; Want = $false }
        @{ Why = 'the line''s own mission again'; Value = 'FT5102'; Raw = 'FT5102'; Enabled = $true; Want = $false }
        @{ Why = 'a different mission'; Value = 'FT5001'; Raw = ''; Enabled = $true; Want = $true }
        @{ Why = 'a not-opted mission'; Value = 'FT5102 (not opted)'; Raw = 'FT5001'; Enabled = $true; Want = $true }
        @{ Why = 'back to (auto)'; Value = '(auto)'; Raw = 'FT5001'; Enabled = $true; Want = $true }
        @{ Why = 'Type a mission... always asks'; Value = 'Type a mission...'; Raw = 'FT5001'; Enabled = $true; Want = $true }
        @{ Why = 'a case-only fix'; Value = 'FT5001'; Raw = 'ft5001'; Enabled = $true; Want = $true }
        @{ Why = 'a disabled row'; Value = 'FT5001'; Raw = ''; Enabled = $false; Want = $false }
        @{ Why = 'text not in the list'; Value = 'XX9999'; Raw = ''; Enabled = $true; Want = $false }
    ) {
        $vm = [PSCustomObject]@{ LineId = 'L1'; MissionRaw = $Raw; MissionEnabled = $Enabled
            MissionOptions = @('(auto)', 'FT5001', 'ft5001', 'FT5102', 'FT5102 (not opted)', 'Type a mission...') }
        $cmd = & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($v, $t) Get-PBMissionCommand -VM $v -Value $t } $vm $Value
        ($null -ne $cmd) | Should -Be $Want
        if ($Want) { $cmd.Cmd | Should -BeExactly 'ChooseMission'; $cmd.LineId | Should -BeExactly 'L1'; $cmd.Value | Should -BeExactly $Value }
    }

    It 'the ChooseMission command runs the pick' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { throw 'should not ask' }
        & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { Invoke-PBCommand @{ Cmd = 'ChooseMission'; LineId = 'L1'; Value = 'FT5001' } }
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
    }

    It 'a kept rule break says so on the status bar, after the pop-up' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { 'No' }
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBPlacementPopup { & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { Set-PBStatus 'Adams, Al -> 0730 Day Local: FT5102, 1 rule flag' 'Hard' } }
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5102 (not opted)'
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly 'Warn|FT5102 kept - it is flagged OVERRIDE on the output.'
    }

    It 'a case-only change of the mission is saved' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBMessage { throw 'should not ask' }
        Set-BoardMission -Board $script:Board -Id 'L1' -Mission 'ft5001'
        Invoke-Choose 'FT5001'
        Get-L1Mission | Should -BeExactly 'FT5001'
    }

    It 'a typed line with a student and a mission shows the rule check' {
        $typed = New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 09:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Student 'Adams, Al' -Mission 'FT5102' -Id 'Q1'
        & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($l) Invoke-PBCommand @{ Cmd = 'AddLines'; Lines = @($l); Status = 'Added 1 line(s).' } } $typed
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBPlacementPopup -Times 1 -Exactly -ParameterFilter { $LineId -eq 'Q1' }
        $plain = New-BoardLine -ETD ([datetime]"$($script:D1) 10:00") -SortieType 'Day Local' -Instructor 'Jones, Bob' -Id 'Q2'
        & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { param($l) Invoke-PBCommand @{ Cmd = 'AddLines'; Lines = @($l); Status = 'Added 1 line(s).' } } $plain
        Should -Invoke -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBPlacementPopup -Times 1 -Exactly -Because 'a line with no student needs no check'
    }

    It 'Add Bulk Lines puts the lines on the day as one undo step' {
        $ok = & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { Add-PBBulkLines -Day '2026-10-20' -StartTime '0800' -Count '5' }
        $ok | Should -BeTrue
        (@(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $script:Board -Day $script:D1) | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne 'L1' } | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '0800,0803,0806,0809,0812'
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly '|Added 5 Day Local lines on Tue 20 Oct: 0800 to 0812, every 3 min.'
        Undo-Board $script:Board | Should -BeTrue
        @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $script:Board -Day $script:D1).Count | Should -Be 1
    }

    It 'Add Bulk Lines with a bad box says so and adds nothing' {
        $v = $script:Board.Version
        $ok = & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { Add-PBBulkLines -Day '2026-10-20' -StartTime '0800' -Count 'lots' }
        $ok | Should -BeFalse
        $script:Board.Version | Should -Be $v
        Get-LastStatus | Should -BeExactly 'Warn|Number of lines must be a whole number from 1 to 60.'
    }

    It 'the Add Bulk Lines button uses what the dialog asked for, and nothing when it is cancelled' {
        Mock -ModuleName PuckBoard Show-PBBulkLinesDialog { @{ StartTime = '1000'; Count = '2'; Every = '10'; SortieType = 'O&B' } }
        & (Get-Module PuckBoard) { Invoke-PBBulkLines }
        $new = @(Get-BoardDayLines -Board $script:Board -Day $script:D1 | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne 'L1' })
        ($new | ForEach-Object { $_.ETD.ToString('HHmm') + ' ' + $_.SortieType }) -join ',' | Should -BeExactly '1000 O&B,1010 O&B,1300 O&B Return,1310 O&B Return'
